Course to Steer, klasik seyrüseferde akı.en: In traditional navigation, the course to steer is the basic method of finding the course by which the current is actually allowed for, keeping the ship on the intended track.

Cross Bearings ile Fix, klasik seyrüsefe.en: A fix by cross bearings gives a quick, visual and reliable position in traditional navigation; when used with suitable objects and simultaneous bearings it is one of the most accurate terrestrial fixing methods.

Çünkü LOP, objeden gemiye doğru çizilir.en: Because the LOP is drawn from the object towards the ship

Dead Reckoning ve Estimated Position, kl.en: Dead reckoning and the estimated position are basic position-fixing methods used at all times in traditional navigation; they keep the ship from being without a position even when no fix can be obtained.

Değerlendirme (5–15 dakika) aşamasında,.en: In the Assessment stage (5–15 minutes) the cause of the loss of stability is sought. There are three main possible causes: flooding, cargo shift or excessive free surface effect. Identifying the cause determines the corrective action to be taken.

Departure değeri daima deniz mili cinsin.en: Departure is always expressed in nautical miles, and its sign shows whether the ship is moving east or west. This directional information is used directly in course calculations and in the relationship with the change of longitude.

Departure kullanılarak D.Long hesaplanır.en: D.Long is calculated using the departure

Departure, geminin doğu–batı doğrultusun.en: Departure is the actual distance the ship covers in the east–west direction and is expressed in nautical miles. The change of longitude, on the other hand, is expressed in degrees and minutes. The two quantities are not directly equal; the conversion between them is made with the cosine of the latitude concerned.

Dik seyir üçgeninden Course ve Distance.en: Course and Distance are calculated from the right-angled sailing triangle

Distance Off by Horizontal Angle, klasik.en: Distance off by horizontal angle gives a range from a single measurement in traditional navigation and is effective especially in coastal waters with good visibility.

Distance Off by Vertical Angle, klasik s.en: Distance off by vertical angle gives a reliable range from a single measurement in traditional navigation and is especially important for coastal safety.

Dünya yüzeyi, küçük alan için düzlemsel.en: The Earth's surface is treated as flat over a small area

Düşey açı küçüldükçe mesafe artar.en: The smaller the vertical angle, the greater the distance

En az iki sabit obje gerekir.en: At least two fixed objects are needed

En az iki sabit obje seçilir.en: At least two fixed objects are chosen

Enlem arttıkça meridyenler birbirine yak.en: As latitude increases the meridians converge. Mean latitude sailing tries to allow for this convergence by using the mean latitude.

Enlemler aynı isimde alınır.en: The latitudes are taken with the same name

Enlemler aynı isimde olmalıdır.en: The latitudes must have the same name

Fix by Cross Bearings, klasik seyrüsefer.en: A fix by cross bearings is a quick, reliable and basic position-fixing method in traditional navigation and is regarded as the reference for all other fixing techniques.

Full Load Arrival (Tam Yüklü Varış) duru.en: The Full Load Arrival condition is the scenario in which the ship, carrying the same cargo, reaches the port of arrival after consuming fuel, fresh water and stores during the passage. In this condition the fuel tanks are usually down to the 10% reserve. Fuel consumption can change the position of the ship's centre of gravity considerably; depending on where the fuel tanks are, KG may rise or fall. The arrival condition must therefore meet the stability criteria in its own right.

Full Load Departure (Tam Yüklü Kalkış) d.en: The Full Load Departure condition is the scenario in which the ship leaves port at maximum cargo capacity with 100% fuel and fresh water and all stores fully loaded. It usually corresponds to the highest displacement and, because the VCG (vertical centre of gravity) potential is highest, it is a critical scenario for stability. In the full load departure condition the draft and trim must not exceed the load line limits, and all IMO stability criteria must be met.

Gemi 045°T’nin güvenli tarafında kaldığı.en: The ship is safe as long as she stays on the safe side of 045°T

Gemi bu hattın güvenli tarafında kalır.en: The ship stays on the safe side of this line

Gemi, bu tabana karşı θ açısını görür.en: From the ship, this baseline subtends the angle θ

Gemi, pruvasını rüzgâra çevirse bile yan.en: Leeway occurs even if the ship heads into the wind

Geminin Course ve Distance’ı hesaplanır.en: The ship's Course and Distance are calculated

Göksel kürede gözlemcinin bulunduğu nokt.en: On the celestial sphere the observer's position is taken as the centre, the point directly overhead as the zenith and the point opposite as the nadir. The intersection of the plane tangent at the observer with the sphere forms the horizon. The points where the Earth's axis of rotation meets the sphere are the celestial poles, and the intersection of the plane of the equator with the sphere is the celestial equator.

Göz yüksekliği, objenin tabanı deniz sev.en: The height of eye is subtracted if the base of the object is at sea level

Greenwich meridyeni sabit referans kabul.en: The Greenwich meridian is taken as the fixed reference. The position of a celestial body is expressed by its Greenwich Hour Angle (GHA), and its position relative to the observer's meridian by the Local Hour Angle (LHA). The angular difference between the two meridians is the longitude.

Greenwich zamanı ile yerel zaman arasınd.en: The difference between Greenwich time and local time changes the position of the celestial body. This difference is used both in finding longitude and as an input to the Hc and azimuth calculations. In this way the chain time difference → angular difference → change of position is clearly established.

Güneş gözlemi yapılırken sextant dik tut.en: When observing the Sun the sextant is held vertical. The index arm is moved until the Sun's lower limb touches the horizon. As the ship rises and falls in the swell, the moments of contact are watched several times and an average point of contact is chosen. When the measurement is complete, Hs = 46° 12.4′ is read from the sextant and the time of the observation is taken from the chronometer at the same moment. This value is not yet a position; the use of the sextant ends here. Everything done after this is the correction and interpretation of this measurement. If the sextant is not used correctly, the result will not be reliable however carefully the calculations are done.

Güneş’in deklinasyonu (δ) ve zenit uzakl.en: The Sun's declination (δ) and its zenith distance are interpreted together. The Sun crosses the meridian either north or south of the observer; this decides the sign rule, and the latitude is obtained directly.

Güneş’in yükselip alçaldığı yay izlenir;.en: The arc along which the Sun rises and falls is watched; local noon is the moment of greatest altitude. This moment is found not from the clock but as the point at which the altitude reaches its maximum. Longitude is not needed at this stage.

Günlük İzleme kapsamında, 12 veya 24 saa.en: In daily monitoring, all tanks are sounded at 12- or 24-hour intervals, the fuel reports are updated, the stability calculation is renewed on the loading computer and the noon report data are prepared. A daily stability update allows the ship's safety condition to be monitored continuously throughout the passage.

GZ eğrisi, geminin pozitif stabilite men.en: The GZ curve gives clear information about the ship's range of positive stability and its stability reserve. These two concepts express the safety margin the ship has left against capsizing, especially at large angles.

Harita düzeltmeleri, basılı bir deniz ha.en: Chart correction is the manual entry on a printed chart of changes in the marine environment that have occurred since the chart was published. A chart starts to become out of date the moment it is printed, because the maritime infrastructure is not fixed. Buoys are moved, the characters of lights are changed, new wrecks are found, depths are resurveyed and some areas are legally restricted or released. The chart does not reflect these changes by itself. An uncorrected chart is therefore not valid for navigation even if correct courses and calculations are laid off on it.

Harita düzeltmeleri, resmî olarak yayıml.en: Charts are corrected using the officially published Notices to Mariners. These notices state clearly which chart is affected, the type of change, its geographical position and how it is to be shown on the chart. Every correction is numbered and dated. For a chart to be valid, all corrections up to the latest published Notice to Mariners must have been entered on it.

Harita ölçeği, deniz haritasının neyi ay.en: Chart scale is the basic structure that determines what a chart shows in detail and what it deliberately leaves out. In navigation, scale is not only a mathematical ratio; it is a practical filter that decides which information is sufficient for making decisions, which is deliberately left out, and which chart is to be used at which stage. The same route looks different on charts of different scales, because a chart reinterprets reality according to its scale. Scale therefore answers the question “which decision is this chart right for?” before the question “how accurate is this chart?”.

Harita ölçeği, tek başına seyri güvenli.en: Chart scale alone does not make navigation safe, but choosing the wrong scale makes even correct calculations dangerous. If Mariner's Book dealt with this subject only by defining “large and small scale”, the user might try to manage a port approach with a coastal chart, or assume that a danger not shown on a small-scale chart does not exist. Scale should therefore be presented not as a definition but as a reflex that teaches which chart to make decisions with at which stage. Once this reflex is in place, the chart becomes an active navigation tool rather than a passive drawing.

Harita ölçeğinin en kritik etkisi, genel.en: The most critical effect of chart scale is on generalisation. Small-scale charts deliberately simplify detail so that they can show a large area. Small rocks, extensions of shoals, the limits of narrow channels or secondary aids to navigation may not be shown at all on these charts, or may be shown reduced to a symbol. This is not a deficiency of the chart but a direct result of its scale. On large-scale charts the same area is shown in a much smaller frame, so the depth contours are closer together, there are more soundings, and lines of buoys and the limits of prohibited areas become clear.

Haritada kullanılacak kerteriz True (T).en: The bearing used on the chart must be True (T)

Hat aşılmaz, sadece taraf kontrolü yapıl.en: The line is not crossed; only the side of it the ship is on is checked

Her kerteriz bir LOP (Line of Position).en: Each bearing gives an LOP (Line of Position)

Her kerteriz için geri kerteriz hesaplan.en: The reciprocal bearing is worked out for each bearing

Hesaplama Adımları şu sırayla gerçekleşt.en: The calculation steps are carried out in the following order:

Ho ile Hc farkı doğrusal mesafeye dönüşt.en: The difference between Ho and Hc is converted into a linear distance. The difference found in minutes is read directly as nautical miles. At this stage there is no directional information; only “how much” the offset is has been determined.

Ho, Hc’den büyükse gözlemci varsayılan m.en: If Ho is greater than Hc, the observer is closer to the celestial body than the assumed position is, and the intercept is laid off towards the body. If Ho is less than Hc, the observer is farther from the body and the intercept is laid off away from it.

Horizontal Angle Fix, klasik seyrüseferd.en: The horizontal angle fix is a position-fixing method based on angle geometry that gives very precise results when applied correctly, and it plays an important role in terrestrial navigation where the sextant is in active use.

Inverse Problem of Mean Latitude Sailing.en: The inverse problem of mean latitude sailing gives the course and distance between two known positions and is one of the basic calculation methods of mean latitude sailing in the planning stage.

İki kerteriz arası Advance hesaplanır.en: The advance between the two bearings is calculated

İkinci kerteriz için BB₂ çizilir → LOP₂.en: BB₂ is drawn for the second bearing → LOP₂

İlk gök cismi gözleminden elde edilen LO.en: The LOP obtained from the first celestial observation is drawn as a straight line on the chart. This line means that at the time of the observation the ship was somewhere on it. A single LOP, however, does not give a position by itself.

İlk kerteriz için BB₁ çizilir → LOP₁.en: BB₁ is drawn for the first bearing → LOP₁

İlk LOP, geminin seyri ve mesafesi kadar.en: The first LOP is transferred by the ship's course and distance run

İstenen CMG ve gemi sürati bilinir.en: The required CMG and the ship's speed are known

Kaldırma kuvvetinin büyüklüğü, geminin ş.en: The magnitude of the buoyant force does not depend on the shape or material of the ship but only on the volume of water displaced and the density of the water. This relationship is expressed by Archimedes' principle and forms the mathematical basis of ship stability. The principle is defined as follows:

Kaldırma kuvvetinin etkidiği nokta, kald.en: The point at which the buoyant force acts is called the centre of buoyancy. It is the geometric centre of the underwater volume, and the buoyant force always acts vertically upwards through it. When the ship heels or trims, the shape of the underwater volume changes, so the position of the centre of buoyancy changes too. This movement is the basic mechanism of ship stability.

Kalıcı düzeltmeler, uzun süreli veya kal.en: Permanent corrections cover long-term or permanent changes. Adding a new buoy, changing the position or character of a light, or adding a new wreck to the chart belong to this group. These corrections are entered permanently on the chart and are not erased.

Kalite Kontrol Prosedürü olarak, hesapla.en: As a quality control procedure, the calculated results must be checked for logic. For example, if loading 500 tonnes gives a change in draft of only a few centimetres, is this consistent with the TPC? If GM is very different from what was expected, what is the reason? Simple logical checks like these are very effective in catching large errors.

Kargo Planlama fonksiyonu, konteyner gem.en: The cargo planning function covers bay plan optimisation on container ships, the hold loading plan on general cargo ships and weight distribution analysis on all ship types.

Kerteriz gemiden objeye alınır; haritada.en: The bearing is taken from the ship to the object; the reciprocal bearing is used to draw the LOP on the chart.

Kerteriz, gemiden objeye doğru ölçülür..en: The bearing is measured from the ship towards the object. To draw the LOP on the chart:

Kerterizler aynı anda alınmalıdır.en: The bearings must be taken at the same time

Kerterizler farklı zamanlarda ölçülür.en: The bearings are measured at different times

Kritik Olaylarda Acil Değerlendirme gere.en: Critical events call for an immediate assessment. Deteriorating weather (increasing wind force or wave height), a suspected cargo shift (a sudden change of heel, asymmetric rolling), tank leakage (an unexpected change of level, a trim anomaly) or any abnormal behaviour must trigger an immediate stability assessment.

Kuru Dökme Kargolar arasında tahıl (buğd.en: Dry bulk cargoes include grain (wheat, maize, barley, rice), ores (iron ore, copper concentrate, bauxite), coal, cement, sugar and salt. What these cargoes have in common is that they can shift as the ship rolls. The angle at which a bulk cargo shifts depends on its particle size, moisture content, density and stowage method.

Küçük bir üçgen oluşursa → ortalama merk.en: If a small triangle (cocked hat) is formed → its centre is taken as the fix

Küresel geometri yerine düzlem geometri.en: Plane geometry is used instead of spherical geometry

Küresel üçgen, kenarları büyük daire yay.en: A spherical triangle is a figure whose sides are arcs of great circles and whose corners lie on the surface of the sphere. The basic spherical triangle used in navigation is formed by the North Pole, the departure position and the arrival position. In this triangle the sides are expressed by the co-latitudes and the difference of longitude; the angles are quantities directly related to navigation, such as the initial and final great circle courses.

LCG LCB’nin gerisinde ise: Gemi kıça tri.en: If the LCG is abaft the LCB: the ship trims by the stern.

LCG LCB’nin önünde ise: Gemi başa trim y.en: If the LCG is forward of the LCB: the ship trims by the head.

Leeway ve akıntı ayrı ayrı değerlendiril.en: Leeway and current are assessed separately.

Leeway, klasik seyrüseferde küçük açı gi.en: Although leeway may look like a small angle, it can lead to large position errors on long passages and must always be allowed for in course and position work.

LOP, objeden gemiye doğru çizilir.en: The LOP is drawn from the object towards the ship

LOP’lar keskin açıyla kesişmelidir.en: The LOPs must cross at a well-defined angle, not a shallow one

LOP’lar mümkün olduğunca dik kesişmelidi.en: The LOPs should cross as nearly at right angles as possible

LOP₁, 090°T yönünde 6 NM taşınır.en: LOP₁ is transferred 6 NM in the direction 090°T

LOP₁, Course doğrultusunda A kadar taşın.en: LOP₁ is transferred by A along the course → Transferred LOP₁

Maden cevherleri taşımacılığında en cidd.en: The most serious risk in carrying ores is liquefaction. Granular cargoes whose moisture content is above a certain threshold can start to behave like a liquid under the ship's vibration and motion. This happens suddenly and turns the cargo into a flowing mass like a liquid cargo; a dramatic free surface effect appears and the ship can capsize within minutes. This is why the IMO introduced the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML): the moisture content of the cargo must not exceed the TML.

Mean Latitude Sailing, basitliği ve hızı.en: Mean latitude sailing is widely used in traditional navigation because it is simple and quick; but if it is used without knowing its latitude and distance limits, it can lead to serious position errors.

Thanks to its simplicity and speed, mean latitude sailing is one of the cornerstones of traditional navigation; but using it without knowing its limits of validity can lead to serious course errors, especially in high latitudes and over long distances.

Mean Latitude Sailing, kısa ve orta mesa.en: Mean latitude sailing is suitable for short and medium distances.

Mean Latitude Sailing’de boylam farkı, p.en: In mean latitude sailing the difference of longitude is converted into the actual distance along the parallel.

Mean Latitude Sailing’in doğrudan proble.en: The direct problem of mean latitude sailing, finding a new position from course and distance, is one of the basic calculations of traditional navigation and gives a practical and quick solution, especially on passages in middle latitudes.

Mercator projeksiyon, deniz haritalarınd.en: The Mercator projection is the mathematical projection used for nautical charts and forms the basis of navigational calculations. It is preferred at sea not for aesthetics or geographical accuracy but for navigational accuracy. The Mercator projection preserves direction and bearing relationships, so the course, bearing, distance and position work done at sea can be carried out directly and consistently on the chart.

Mercator projeksiyonda mesafe ölçümü, ya.en: On the Mercator projection distance is measured only on the latitude scale. The mathematical reason is that the projection deliberately stretches the scale in the direction of latitude. This stretching makes the latitude scale a reliable reference for distance.

Mercator projeksiyonda sabit bir hakiki.en: On the Mercator projection the track of a ship steering a constant true course is shown as a straight line on the chart. This line is called a loxodrome. This is why courses can be drawn, measured and followed directly on Mercator charts.

Mercator projeksiyonun en ayırt edici öz.en: The most distinctive feature of the Mercator projection is that the meridians are drawn parallel and equally spaced, while the parallels of latitude are drawn further apart as latitude increases. Near the equator the parallels are close together; towards the poles the distance between them increases. This is a deliberate distortion and the mathematical result of the projection.

Mercator projeksiyonunda enlemler arası.en: On the Mercator projection the spreading of the parallels of latitude is expressed by the isometric latitude. This conversion is the basic quantity of rhumb line calculations:

Mercator projeksiyonunun bu avantajı, al.en: This advantage of the Mercator projection is gained at the cost of distortions of area and distance that grow rapidly with latitude. Distances measured on a Mercator chart therefore do not give the true distance directly; they must be read only from the latitude scale.

Merkez açı d derece cinsinden bulunduğun.en: Once the central angle d has been found in degrees, its value in nautical miles can be calculated directly:

Mesafe, D.Lat ve Departure bileşenlerine.en: The distance is resolved into D.Lat and Departure components

Nötr denge ise geminin küçük bir yatma s.en: Neutral equilibrium is the special case in which the ship, after a small inclination, tends to stay in her new position. In this state there is neither a righting nor a capsizing moment. The ship stays at whatever angle she is left. It is possible in theory, but in practical ship operation it is undesirable and rarely met.

Obje merkezli yarıçap = D daire yayı.en: Arc of a circle centred on the object with radius = D

Obje’den 225°T doğrultusunda LOP₁ çizili.en: LOP₁ is drawn from the object in the direction 225°T

Obje’den 270°T doğrultusunda LOP₂ çizili.en: LOP₂ is drawn from the object in the direction 270°T

Objeler arası yatay açı ölçülür.en: The horizontal angle between the objects is measured

Objeler arasındaki yatay açı (Horizontal.en: The horizontal angle between the objects is measured

Objeler aynı doğrultuda hizalandığında t.en: A transit is formed when the objects are in line

Objelere olan mesafe, üçgen geometrisi i.en: The distances to the objects are calculated by triangle geometry

Objelerin eş zamanlı kerterizleri alınır.en: Simultaneous bearings of the objects are taken

Onay ve Belgeleme aşamasında, kaptan sta.en: In the Approval and Documentation stage, the master reviews and approves the stability calculations. The stability calculation sheet is signed and filed. The loading plan is recorded. These documents are legally valid for PSC inspections and any casualty investigation.

Operasyonel Değerlendirme aşamasında, be.en: In the Operational Assessment stage, the expected weather, the length of the voyage and particular conditions on the route (narrow waters, shallow water) are taken into account. If heavy weather is expected, increasing the GM margin and minimising the free surface effect are considered.

Orta enlem seyri, düzlem seyirin geometr.en: Mean latitude sailing does not abandon the geometry of plane sailing completely; it only corrects the longitude component using the mean latitude. This gives a more accurate result over short and medium distances without the need for complex projections.

Orta enlem seyrinde, seyir boyunca değiş.en: In mean latitude sailing the latitude, which changes during the passage, is represented by a single value. This value is the arithmetic mean of the departure and arrival latitudes. When the change of longitude is calculated, the length of a minute of longitude is taken for this mean latitude.

Ortalama enlem, başlangıç ve varış enlem.en: The mean latitude is defined as the arithmetic mean of the departure and arrival latitudes. It represents the latitude of the ship over the passage with a single value. In the mean latitude sailing approach, east–west distances are assessed according to the length of a minute of longitude in this latitude.

Ölçülen açı, gemi mevkiinden görülür.en: The measured angle is seen from the ship's position

Önce merkez açı d hesaplanır:.en: First the central angle d is calculated:

Paraleller arası mesafe sabit varsayılır.en: The distance between the parallels is assumed to be constant

Periyodik Gereksinimler kapsamında, yükl.en: As periodic requirements, the loading computer is verified annually, re-approved at 5-year intervals, and after any modification of the ship (change to a hold, added superstructure, tank modification etc.) a software update and re-approval are mandatory.

Raporlama kapsamında, şirket DPA (Design.en: For reporting, the company DPA (Designated Person Ashore) is informed, the classification society and the flag State are notified and, if necessary, SAR (Search and Rescue) coordination is started. All actions are recorded with their times and results.

Rhumb line (loxodrom), küre üzerindeki t.en: A rhumb line (loxodrome) is a curve that cuts all meridians on the sphere at a constant angle and gives a constant course throughout the passage. Its appearance as a straight line on the Mercator projection makes practical navigation much easier.

Rhumb line, küre üzerinde meridyenleri s.en: A rhumb line is a curve that cuts the meridians on the sphere at a constant angle. Because the Mercator projection preserves angles, this curve appears on the chart exactly as a straight line. This lets the navigator draw the track of a ship steering a constant course on the chart with a ruler in one stroke.

Rota ve mesafe, bir dik seyir üçgeni olu.en: The course and distance form a right-angled sailing triangle

Running fix, açık denizde pratik ve işle.en: A running fix is practical and useful in the open sea; but if there is a change of course or speed, or if DR discipline is weak, the result is not considered reliable. The method should therefore be used, where possible, to supplement fixes from simultaneous LOPs, not to replace them.

Running fix, göksel seyirde aynı anda el.en: In celestial navigation a running fix is based on bringing position lines (LOPs) that cannot be obtained at the same time to a common time, allowing for the ship's movement. Observations made at different times are combined at a single time to obtain a fix. It is a practical solution when few celestial bodies are available or when the weather does not allow simultaneous observations.

Running Fix, klasik seyrüseferde tek obj.en: The running fix is one of the basic terrestrial fixing methods in traditional navigation; it allows a position to be found from a single object and gives high accuracy when time and the ship's movement are applied correctly.

Running Fix, klasik seyrüseferde zaman v.en: The running fix is one of the basic position-fixing methods in traditional navigation; it brings time and movement into the solution and is highly reliable when applied correctly.

Rüzgâr iskele tarafından geldiği için ge.en: Because the wind is coming from the port side, the ship drifts to starboard.

Rüzgâr iskele tarafından geliyorsa → gem.en: If the wind comes from the port side → the ship drifts to starboard

Rüzgâr sancak tarafından geliyorsa → gem.en: If the wind comes from the starboard side → the ship drifts to port

Rüzgâr, gemiyi yanal olarak sürükler.en: The wind pushes the ship sideways

Saat 08:20’de elde edilen LOP, geminin s.en: The LOP obtained at 08:20 is transferred parallel to itself 6 nautical miles in the direction of the ship's track. Its intersection with the second LOP, obtained at 08:50, is the ship's running fix at 08:50.

Serbest yüzey etkisinin en kritik sonucu.en: The most critical result of the free surface effect is that it reduces the ship's effective GM. This reduction makes the ship behave as though her centre of gravity had risen.

Set yönünde D₍c₎ kadar gidilir.en: D₍c₎ is laid off in the direction of the set

Sextant ile ölçülen en büyük yükseklik,.en: The greatest altitude measured with the sextant is converted to Ho (observed altitude) by applying all the corrections (IE, dip, refraction, SD, parallax). In the noon position Ho represents the true altitude of the Sun on the meridian.

Sextanttan okunan alet yüksekliği Hs = 2.en: Let the sextant altitude read from the sextant be Hs = 27° 18.4′, with an index error of −1.6′, a height of eye of 16 m and a lower-limb observation of the Sun.

Seyir orta enlemlerde yapılır.en: The passage is made in middle latitudes

Seyir üçgeni hâlâ dik üçgen kabul edilir.en: The sailing triangle is still taken to be a right-angled triangle

Sonuç Kontrolü aşamasında, hesaplanan de.en: In the Results Check stage, the calculated values are compared with the IMO criteria and the ship's approved limiting curves. The parameters to be checked are:

Stabilite Kaybı Belirtileri ve bunlara k.en: The signs of loss of stability and the immediate actions against them can be summarised as follows:

Şamandıra düzeltmeleri, seyir güvenliğin.en: Buoy corrections are the chart corrections that affect navigational safety most directly. If a buoy is moved, removed or re-established, the symbol on the chart is cancelled completely and the new position is entered with the correct symbol. If the light character, colour or type of the buoy has changed, all the related descriptive information is updated together with the symbol.

t₁ anına ait LOP, geminin seyir doğrultu.en: The LOP for time t₁ is transferred parallel to itself along the ship's track by the distance run. This does not change the direction of the LOP; it only moves its position to time t₂.

Tank Yönetimi fonksiyonu, tüm tankların.en: The tank management function contains the capacity tables of all tanks, the sounding/ullage conversions and the free surface moments. As the contents of the tanks are entered, the software automatically calculates the weight, VCG, LCG and FSM values.

Taşınan LOP ile ikinci LOP’un kesişimi F.en: The intersection of the transferred LOP and the second LOP gives the fix

Taşınan LOP, orijinal LOP’a paralel kalı.en: The transferred LOP stays parallel to the original LOP.

Tehlike ile gemi arasında minimum mesafe.en: A minimum distance is kept between the danger and the ship

Tehlikeye teğet geçer.en: It passes tangentially to the danger

Tehlikeyi emniyetle teğet geçen bir doğr.en: A line that passes the danger safely at a tangent is chosen

Transfer Operasyonları seyir sırasında s.en: Transfer operations affect stability directly during the passage. When transferring fuel, port–starboard symmetry must be kept, the change in GM monitored and the number of slack tanks kept to a minimum. In ballast operations, trim optimisation, GM correction and the IMO Ballast Water Management (BWM) requirements must be assessed together. Especially during ballast exchange at sea, because the sequential method empties and refills the tanks one by one, the stability must be checked for every intermediate condition.

Transit (Leading Line), klasik seyirde e.en: A transit (leading line) is one of the most reliable and simplest position-fixing methods in traditional navigation and is indispensable especially in areas where navigational safety is critical.

Uyarı İşaretleri aşamasında stabilite ka.en: In the Warning Signs stage, the signs that a loss of stability has started must be recognised. A marked lengthening of the rolling period indicates that GM has decreased. A tendency of the ship to lean to one side from upright (a loll) shows that GM is approaching zero or has become negative. A steadily increasing angle of heel, with the ship unable to return upright by herself, indicates that a critical loss of stability has begun.

Üç LOP idealde tek noktada kesişir.en: Ideally three LOPs cross at a single point

Üçgen hem grafik, hem sayısal çözülebili.en: The triangle can be solved both graphically and numerically

Vardiya Bazında İzleme kapsamında, her v.en: In watch-by-watch monitoring, the fuel consumption is followed every watch, changes in tank levels are checked, the ship's draft and trim are observed and her rolling characteristics are assessed. A lengthening of the rolling period is an important sign that GM is decreasing and must be investigated at once.

Varsayılan mevki (AP), DR mevkiine yakın.en: The assumed position (AP) is a point close to the DR position and is the reference point for which Hc and Zn are calculated. The weighed or calculated gross mass of every container must be documented before loading. Containers without VGM information must not be loaded on board. The requirement was introduced to prevent stability casualties like those caused in the past by misdeclared weights.

If a least depth is given for a wreck, this value is shown clearly on the chart and used directly in draft calculations.

When tank data are entered, the density and temperature values are checked. The weights and positions of the cargo are specified. Separate calculations are made for both the departure and the arrival conditions, because fuel consumption during the passage can change stability considerably.

Yükleme bilgisayarının temel fonksiyonla.en: The basic functions of the loading computer fall under four main headings. Under stability calculation, the software calculates the draft, trim and heel, determines KG and GM, produces the GZ curve and checks all the IMO stability criteria automatically. If any criterion is not met, it gives an alarm or warning.

Yüzerlik şartını sağlayan bir gemi, kuvv.en: A ship that satisfies the condition of flotation is in equilibrium as far as forces are concerned; but this equilibrium alone does not explain how the ship behaves under a small external disturbance. The essence of ship stability is how the ship responds when she is displaced from her position of equilibrium. This response is described by the states of equilibrium and is studied in three basic classes: stable, unstable and neutral equilibrium.

Cb veya squall hattı yaklaşırken tedbirl.en: When a Cb or squall line approaches, the precautions are driven by the wind, not the rain, because the first blow arrives with the gust front. Radar is used actively to detect the precipitation cells and to work out their movement vector (the cells give bright, high-intensity echoes). Personnel on deck are brought inside, derricks/cranes are secured and open hatch covers are closed. Assuming the wind will suddenly shift and strengthen, the ship's position relative to the wind is assessed; at anchor, the engine is kept ready because of the risk of dragging the anchor. Because of the lightning risk, work on antennas and other high points on the open deck is stopped. Small cells can be avoided with visual and radar tracking without departing from the route; an organised squall line is crossed at its weakest point, at right angles if possible.

Demirde köprüüstü nöbeti sürdürülür; mev.en: A bridge watch is maintained at anchor; the position, the swinging circle, the weather and other ships are monitored. If there is a risk of dragging, the engine is kept on stand-by. Adequate scope, a suitable bottom (sand/mud holds well; rock holds poorly) and a sound watch are the basis of safe anchoring.

Demirin tutması büyük ölçüde zincirin de.en: The holding of the anchor depends largely on the chain applying a HORIZONTAL pull along the seabed. The length of chain paid out (scope) must therefore be several times the depth of water. In good weather the usual rule is chain of about 5–6 times the depth; more (7+ times) is paid out in bad weather. The weight of the chain (catenary) keeps the pull horizontal and increases the holding power.

Demirin tutmayıp sürüklenmesi (dragging).en: Dragging of the anchor is monitored by: taking a bearing of a fixed object/landmark and watching for change (transit/clearing bearing), the GPS anchor watch alarm, depth changes on the echo sounder, and sudden tension and vibration in the chain. If dragging is detected, more scope is paid out or action is taken with the engine or by re-anchoring.

Demirleme (anchoring), gemiyi belirli bi.en: Anchoring transfers the load of the ship to the seabed through the anchor and chain to hold her safely in a given position. The right choice of position, adequate scope (chain paid out) and good holding ground keep the ship from dragging. Maintenance of the anchoring equipment and manoeuvring discipline are critical for both safety and operational reliability.

Demirleme yerinde su derinliği 40 m ise.en: If the depth of water at the anchorage is 40 m, approximately how much scope should be paid out in good weather?

Demirli gemi sürekli izlenir; tarama tes.en: The anchored ship is monitored continuously; if dragging is detected the engine is made ready and the scope is increased.

Demirli gemi sürekli izlenir: GPS demirl.en: The anchored ship is monitored continuously: her position is checked with the GPS anchor alarm, bearings/ranges (transits, radar ranges) and visual references. Signs of dragging: the chain constantly taut or vibrating, the ship moving relative to her references, the anchor alarm sounding. If dragging is detected the engine is made ready and, if necessary, the scope is increased, the second anchor is let go, or the ship re-anchors or gets under way. When heavy weather is expected, the scope is increased in advance and the engine is kept on stand-by.

İstenen kalomaya ulaşınca band freni sık.en: When the required scope is reached, the band brake is applied and the stopper is put on

The second anchor is let go under control; letting it go at high speed overloads the chain and the windlass.

Tarama belirtisinde önce makine hazır ed.en: At the first sign of dragging the engine is made ready and the Master is called; the ship must be ready to manoeuvre at any moment. Waiting increases the risk of grounding or collision, and heaving up unprepared is risky in darkness and in traffic.

Zincirde ritmik sarsıntı, kerteriz değiş.en: Rhythmic jerking of the chain, a change of bearing and a shift in position are signs of dragging; the engine is made ready and the scope is increased or the ship shifts berth.

Üçüncü Zabitin ana emniyet sorumluluğu,.en: The Third Officer's main safety responsibility is to keep the ship's LSA and FFE systems continuously ready in terms of operation, documentation and crew preparedness.

Lifeboat falls dıştan iyi görünür ama te.en: Lifeboat falls may look good from the outside while broken wires are starting — a visual check is not enough; regular wire inspection is required.

Hook/release mekanizması sertleşmiş olab.en: The hook/release mechanism may have stiffened — the release gear test must be carried out realistically.

Liferaft cradle pas nedeniyle release'i.en: A rusted liferaft cradle may hinder release; if the liferaft lashings have been painted, the HRU system may not work.

EEBD yangın söndürmek için değil, kaçış.en: The EEBD is for escape, not for firefighting — if the crew do not know this, the equipment will be misused.

Fixed CO2 sisteminde eksik bilgi, yanlış.en: Incomplete knowledge of the fixed CO2 system is as dangerous as an incorrect release — the remote shutdown and ventilation stop procedures must be known.

Fire door wedge ile açık tutulması 'ufak.en: Holding a fire door open with a wedge looks like a 'minor defect', but it disables the system that stops smoke spreading in a fire.

Hydrant dolabı pasla kilitlenmiş olabili.en: A hydrant cabinet may be seized with rust — this is very common on older ships and costs minutes in an emergency.

Halat kopması gemi kazalarının en ölümcü.en: Parting lines are among the deadliest types of shipboard accident; the bosun's firmness on snap-back zone discipline saves lives.

Pilot ladder kazaları hâlâ yaşanmaktadır.en: Pilot ladder accidents still happen — the securing arrangement and the steps must be checked meticulously.

Bosun's store dağınıklığı, ihtiyaç anınd.en: A disorganised bosun's store means the right material cannot be found when needed — regular inventory control is essential.

Lookout görevinde dikkat dağınıklığı vey.en: Distraction or failure to report while on lookout directly increases the risk of collision — this duty is one of the most basic requirements of COLREG.

Halat/tel operasyonlarında snap-back zon.en: Standing in a snap-back zone during rope/wire operations can be fatal.

PPE kullanmadan çalışmak, en basit işte.en: Working without PPE carries a serious risk of injury even in the simplest job.

Stajyer bağımsız karar alamaz ve imza ye.en: A cadet cannot make independent decisions and has no authority to sign — the supervising officer's approval is required in every case.

Ana makine arızası açık denizde geminin.en: A main engine failure at sea means the ship loses manoeuvrability — a shortage of critical spare parts directly increases this risk.

OWS bypass veya 15 ppm alarm manipülasyo.en: If an OWS bypass or manipulation of the 15 ppm alarm is detected, the ship is detained and criminal proceedings follow — zero tolerance.

Emergency generator ve emergency fire pu.en: If the emergency generator and emergency fire pump are not tested or do not work, in an emergency the ship is left in darkness and without fire water.

Ana makine scavenge fire riski, scavenge.en: The risk of a main engine scavenge fire depends directly on the cleanliness of the scavenge space — a dirty scavenge space means fire.

Bunker operasyonlarında taşma, deniz kir.en: An overflow during bunkering means pollution of the sea and heavy fines — the overflow tank and alarm system must always be in working order.

ORB kayıtlarında tutarsızlık veya eksikl.en: Inconsistencies or gaps in the ORB entries are a direct cause of detention by PSC.

Vardiya teslim-devir sırasında eksik bil.en: Incomplete handover of information at the change of watch directly increases the risk of accidents in the engine room.

Vardiya sırasında oil mist detector alar.en: An oil mist detector alarm during the watch must be taken seriously — the risk of a crankcase explosion is deadly.

Boiler safety valve sıkışması veya devre.en: A seized or disabled boiler safety valve directly creates the risk of a boiler explosion.

LOTO uygulanmadan bakım çalışması başlat.en: Starting maintenance work without applying LOTO can lead to loss of limbs or death.

Bilge seviye izleme ihmal edilirse makin.en: If bilge level monitoring is neglected, the risk of flooding in the engine room increases and the ship's stability is endangered.

Makine saha raporlarını ECR'a iletir..en: Passes engine room scene reports to the ECR.

Serbest bırakılınca doğrudan craft istas.en: When released, goes directly to the craft station and reports for muster.

İndirme donanımını yalnızca doğrudan göz.en: Operates the launching gear only under direct supervision.

Manevra sırasında ekipman, kayıt veya ha.en: Gives equipment, record or messenger support during manoeuvring.

Recovery station'a malzeme gönderimini k.en: Coordinates sending equipment to the recovery station.

Hortum, portable pump ve ışık taşır..en: Carries hoses, the portable pump and lights.

Sounding değerini mühendis gözetiminde a.en: Takes soundings under an engineer's supervision and reports them exactly.

Su basmış veya elektrik riski olan mahal.en: Does not enter a flooded space or one with an electrical hazard independently.

Kapalı mahale girmez; yedek tüp, sedye v.en: Does not enter the enclosed space; handles the logistics for spare cylinders, the stretcher and lights.

Gaz ölçüm ve giriş kayıtlarını ilgili gö.en: Carries gas test and entry records to the persons concerned.

Temiz/kirli ve güvenli/tehlikeli bölge s.en: Maintains the clean/dirty and safe/dangerous zone boundaries.

Emici, atık kabı ve temiz PPE malzemesin.en: Brings absorbents, waste containers and clean PPE.

Kontamine malzemeyi etiketli geçici alan.en: Moves contaminated material to the labelled temporary area.

Kullanılan stok miktarını kayıt görevlis.en: Reports the quantity of stock used to the person keeping the records.

Ocak, elektrikli pişirme ve gaz/yakıt ka.en: Secures the stove, electric cooking equipment and gas/fuel supply.

Yoklamasını verir ve ilk yardım/erzak de.en: Reports for muster and moves to the first aid/provisions support duty.

Galley ve store durumunu doğrulanmış şek.en: Reports the condition of the galley and stores in verified form.

Galley izolasyonu, ardından ilk yardım i.en: Galley isolation, then the first aid station

Emniyetliyse galley ısı/güç kaynağını ve.en: If safe, shuts off the galley heat/power supply and ventilation in accordance with procedure.

Galley yangın söndürme sistemine izinsiz.en: Does not operate the galley fire-extinguishing system without authority; reports the situation.

Atanmışsa ilk yardım ve sedye ekibine ka.en: If assigned, joins the first aid and stretcher team.

Atanmış ilave su, acil erzak ve battaniy.en: Brings the assigned extra water, emergency provisions and blankets to the station.

Özel sağlık/diyet ihtiyacı olan kişileri.en: Informs the craft commander of persons with special medical/dietary needs.

Kişi akışına engel olmadan malzemeyi cra.en: Hands the items over to the craft without obstructing the flow of people.

Battaniye, kuru giysi ve sıcak ortamı ha.en: Prepares blankets, dry clothing and a warm area.

Kazazedeyi medical officer'a teslimde ya.en: Helps hand the casualty over to the medical officer; gives no fluids by mouth to an unconscious person.

İlk yardım alanını temiz ve erişilebilir.en: Keeps the first aid area clean and accessible.

Galley/store kapı ve açıklıklarını emniy.en: Secures the galley/store doors and openings.

Yaşam mahallindeki su, elektrik veya kay.en: Reports water, electrical or slip hazards in the accommodation.

İlk yardım ve personel ihtiyaçları için.en: Prepares the support area for first aid and personnel needs.

Oksijen/ilk yardım donanımını eğitimli m.en: Prepares the oxygen/first aid equipment for trained medical personnel.

Kazazedenin ısı kaybını önleyecek kuru v.en: Prepares a dry, controlled area to prevent heat loss from the casualty.

Kurtarma alanına izinsiz girmez ve tıbbi.en: Does not enter the rescue area without permission and follows medical instructions.

Temiz su, temiz PPE ve hijyen malzemesin.en: Prepares clean water, clean PPE and hygiene material outside the dirty zone.

Kontamine giysi ile galley/yaşam alanı a.en: Prevents cross-contamination between contaminated clothing and the galley/accommodation.

Müdahale ekibinin içme suyu ve dinlenme.en: Meets the response team's drinking water and rest needs safely.

Yalnızca emniyetliyse atanmış kamara/ort.en: Checks the assigned cabin/common area sweep route only if it is safe.

Bulunan, eksik veya yardıma ihtiyaç duya.en: Reports persons found, missing or needing assistance to the muster officer.

Yangın kapıları ve kaçış yollarını açık/.en: Secures fire doors and escape routes open or closed as required.

Emniyetliyse atanmış fire door, porthole.en: If safe, closes the assigned fire doors, portholes and ventilation openings.

Dumanlı koridora bağımsız girmez; tamaml.en: Does not enter a smoke-filled corridor independently; reports the sweep areas completed.

Atanmışsa sedye ve ilk yardım ekibine ka.en: If assigned, joins the stretcher and first aid team.

Atanmış kamara/ortak alanın boşaltıldığı.en: Reports that the assigned cabins/common areas have been evacuated.

İlave can yeleği, battaniye ve ilk yardı.en: Brings extra lifejackets, blankets and the first aid kit to the station.

Kişi hesabı ve doğru craft'a yönlendirme.en: Helps with the headcount and directing people to the right craft.

Sedye, battaniye, kuru giysi ve ilk yard.en: Prepares the stretcher, blankets, dry clothing and first aid area.

Kazazedenin mahremiyetini ve sıcak tutul.en: Ensures the casualty's privacy and keeps them warm.

Tıbbi ekip talimatıyla kayıt veya ekipma.en: Gives record or equipment support on the medical team's instructions.

Alt seviye kamara/ortak alanları yalnızc.en: Checks the lower-level cabins/common areas only by a safe route.

Watertight/fire door ve açıklıkların dur.en: Reports the condition of watertight/fire doors and openings.

Personeli su alan veya elektrik riski bu.en: Moves personnel away from flooded areas or areas with an electrical hazard.

Sedye, ilk yardım ve oksijen donanımını.en: Prepares the stretcher, first aid and oxygen equipment for trained personnel.

Kazazedenin kabul alanını açık ve emniye.en: Keeps the casualty reception area clear and safe.

Kapalı mahale veya giriş kontrol sınırın.en: Does not pass into the enclosed space or the entry control boundary without permission.

Kirli PPE için ayrı toplama ve etiketli.en: Sets up separate collection for dirty PPE and a labelled temporary storage area.

Kontamine ayakkabı/giysiyle yaşam mahall.en: Prevents entry into the accommodation with contaminated shoes/clothing.

Temiz PPE ve hijyen malzemesi stokunu ka.en: Reports the stock of clean PPE and hygiene material to the person keeping the records.

Genel acil durum alarmı, PA sistemi, per.en: The general emergency alarm, the PA system, the crew's first actions and how the Master will give the order to abandon ship must be stated clearly.

Gerçek cetvel rütbe grubu değil, her per.en: The real muster list must show each crew member by name/rank with the assigned initial station, not by rank group; persons of the same rank must have separate duties.

Watertight/fire door, valf, scupper, sid.en: Watertight/fire doors, valves, scuppers, side openings, fans, dampers, fuel and electrical isolations must be assigned to named persons.

Her survival craft için amir, ikinci sor.en: For each survival craft, the commander, second-in-command, engine operator, launching crew, painter and carriers of portable communications/LSA must be designated.

Saldırı, yedek, BA control, boundary coo.en: Attack, back-up, BA control, boundary cooling, pump/isolation and first aid duties must be written with the team leader and the withdrawal chain.

Köprüüstü–saha–ECR haberleşmesi, kullanı.en: Bridge–scene–ECR communications, the equipment/channel used, the person responsible for distress communications and the incident recorder must be stated.

LSA ve FFA'nın iyi durumda ve hemen kull.en: The officer or officers responsible for keeping the LSA and FFA in good condition and ready for immediate use must be clearly assigned.

Kaptan, saha komutanı, Baş Mühendis, GMD.en: Named substitutes must be designated for the Master, on-scene commander, Chief Engineer, GMDSS operator, craft commanders and other critical duties in case personnel are unavailable or injured.

Cetvel gemi denize çıkmadan hazırlanmalı.en: The muster list must be prepared before the ship proceeds to sea and revised when the crew changes; it must be posted in conspicuous places on the bridge, in the engine room and in the accommodation.

Operasyonu yöneten güverte zabiti; başüs.en: The deck officer in charge of the operation; forward/aft team leader and authorised operator

Gemiye özgü kullanım kitabını, risk değe.en: Verify the ship-specific operating manual, the risk assessment, the allocation of duties and the means of uninterrupted communication.

Enerji kaynağı, lokal/acil durdurma, fre.en: Carry out no-load checks of the power source, local/emergency stops, brake, guards, limits and leaks; clear the fall, crushing and rope/chain recoil areas.

Uygunsa kaldırma donanımı sicili, SWL ve.en: Where applicable, the register of lifting appliances, SWL and certificates

1 Ocak 2026'dan itibaren kaldırma donanı.en: Safety of lifting appliances and anchor handling winches from 1 January 2026; applicability depends on the equipment

Gemi kaldırma donanımları için işletme,.en: Guidelines for the operation, inspection, testing and maintenance of shipboard lifting appliances

Gemiye özel limit, komuta zinciri ve emn.en: Ship-specific limits, chain of command and safe stopping method

Köprüüstü vardiya zabiti; kritik ayar ve.en: The officer of the watch on the bridge; bridge team management with the Master for critical settings and deviations

Cihazın güç, self-test/BITE, sensör kayn.en: At the watch handover, verify the equipment's power, self-test/BITE, sensor source, date/time, dimmer and alarm status.

Ayarları seyir safhası, draft/UKC politi.en: Make the settings according to the phase of the voyage, the draft/UKC policy, visibility, traffic, chart coverage and the Master's night orders; do not take over the previous watch's settings blindly.

Arıza/servis kaydı; olaya ilişkin veriys.en: Defect/service record; VDR save if the data relate to an incident

Seyir cihazlarının gemi tipi/tonaj/yapım.en: Carriage of navigational equipment according to ship type/tonnage/date of build, and up-to-date official charts/publications

Emniyetli seyir vardiyası, gözcülük ve m.en: Safe navigational watch, lookout and the proper use of all available means

Cihaz tipine özgü fonksiyon, alarm, test.en: Equipment-specific functions, alarms, tests and back-up arrangements

Başmühendis gözetimindeki vardiya mühend.en: The engineer of the watch under the Chief Engineer's supervision; engine control confirmed with the bridge

Yağlama, soğutma, yakıt/hava, elektrik v.en: Before starting, verify the lubrication, cooling, fuel/air, electrical and control air auxiliaries, and the interlock, alarm and trip conditions.

Turning gear, çalışma izni/LOTO, persone.en: Check the turning gear, permit to work/LOTO, personnel and tools, and bridge–engine room communications; allow remote control only when local preparation is complete.

Makine jurnali ve performans trendleri.en: Engine room log and performance trends

Yakıt-yağ analizi ve klas/servis raporla.en: Fuel/lube oil analyses and class/service reports

Makine, elektrik, dümen ve acil durum dü.en: Machinery, electrical, steering and emergency arrangements

Emniyetli işletme, kritik ekipman, bakım.en: Safe operation, critical equipment, maintenance and management of non-conformities

Gemi ve makine tipine özgü limit, tolera.en: Limits, tolerances and tests specific to the ship and machinery type

Vardiya mühendisi veya atanmış makine za.en: The engineer of the watch or an assigned engineer officer; the ETO/authorised personnel for electrical work

Hat dizilimini P&ID üzerinden doğrula; t.en: Verify the line arrangement from the P&ID; check the tank level, suction/discharge valves, vents, drains, lubrication, cooling and electrical supply.

Stand-by ünitenin gerçekten hazır olduğu.en: Confirm that the standby unit is really ready, that alarms/trips are normal and that maintenance isolations have been removed.

Kimyasal/atık/servis kaydı (sisteme uygu.en: Chemical/waste/service record (if applicable to the system)

Temel makine, elektrik, kazan, basınçlı.en: Basic provisions on machinery, electrical installations, boilers, pressure systems and fire safety

Atık veya deşarj üreten yardımcı sisteml.en: For auxiliary systems that produce waste or discharges, the relevant Annex and approved arrangement

Hat dizilimi, interlock, normal değer ve.en: Line arrangement, interlocks, normal values and safe maintenance

Kaptan komutasındaki acil durum organiza.en: The emergency organisation under the Master's command; depending on the system, the Chief Engineer, officers and the trained fire team

Fire Control Plan, muster list, sabit si.en: Verify the Fire Control Plan, muster list, fixed-system release procedure, evacuation of the space and communications for the specific ship.

Valf/izolasyon konumu, güç kaynağı, alar.en: Visually check the valve/isolation positions, power supply, alarms, cylinder/tank pressure or pump readiness and the access seals, without changing anything.

Yetkili servis, dolum, hidrostatik test.en: Authorised service, refilling, hydrostatic test or inspection report

Yangının önlenmesi, algılanması, sınırla.en: Prevention, detection, containment and extinction of fire

Sabit ve seyyar yangın sistemlerinin tek.en: Technical arrangement of fixed and portable fire-fighting systems

Gemiye özgü mahal, vana, uzaktan kapatma.en: Ship-specific spaces, valves, remote shut-offs and release sequence

Kaptan gözetiminde birinci zabit/cargo o.en: The Chief Officer/cargo officer under the Master's supervision; coordination with the terminal and the engine control room

Onaylı cargo/operations manual, loading.en: Verify the approved cargo/operations manual, loading plan, ship/shore checklist, communications and emergency stop method together.

Hat, tank/ambar, valf, vent, seviye-bası.en: Before the operation, confirm the lines, tanks/holds, valves, vents, level/pressure alarms, closing arrangements and appropriate gas measurements.

CSM, test sertifikası, PMS ve defect rep.en: CSM, test certificates, PMS and defect report

Yük bilgisi, istifleme, sabitleme ve teh.en: Provisions on cargo information, stowage, securing and dangerous goods

Gemi ve yük tipine uygulanabilen çevre v.en: Environmental and cargo codes applicable to the ship and cargo type

Gemiye özgü hat, limit, ESD ve operasyon.en: Ship-specific lines, limits, ESD and operating sequence

Başmühendis/atanmış mühendis; kayıt ve d.en: The Chief Engineer/assigned engineer; MARPOL/BWM responsibility together with the Master for records and discharge decisions

Onaylı plan/operating manual, sertifika,.en: Verify the approved plan/operating manual, certificate, calibration, sampling point and line arrangement on the actual pipework.

Bypass veya mühürlü vana durumunu, sensö.en: Check the status of any bypass or sealed valves, the sensor/alarm self-test and the tank capacity; do not start the operation simply because a type approval exists.

İlgili resmî record book ve elektronik k.en: The relevant official record book and electronic record

PMS, tank sounding ve reception facility.en: PMS, tank soundings and reception facility documents

Sistemin ürettiği deşarj, atık veya emis.en: Provisions applicable to the discharges, waste or emissions produced by the system

Type-approved sistemin gemiye özgü çalış.en: The ship-specific operating envelope and limitations of the type-approved system

Kaptan gözetimindeki GOC/ROC yetkili tel.en: The GOC/ROC-qualified radio officer or assigned LSA officer under the Master's supervision; muster list duties for life-saving

Gemi sertifikası, sea area, ekipman kiml.en: Check the ship's certificate, sea area, equipment identity/MMSI, reserve power, self-test and date/time/position input.

LSA için erişim, securing, release/HRU,.en: For LSA, verify access, securing, release/HRU, weekly/monthly checks and authorised service dates against the maker's instructions; do not improvise a dangerous release test.

Radio log veya GMDSS test kaydı.en: Radio log or GMDSS test record

LSA haftalık/aylık kontrol ve drill kayd.en: LSA weekly/monthly check and drill record

Can kurtarma araçları, hazır bulundurma,.en: Life-saving appliances, readiness, maintenance and drills

Modernize GMDSS fonksiyonları, deniz ala.en: Modernised GMDSS functions, sea areas and radio equipment

Filika/rescue boat, launching appliance.en: Authority for the maintenance/testing of lifeboats/rescue boats, launching appliances and release gear

Windlass statik demirleme yükünü tek baş.en: The windlass is not left to carry the static anchoring load alone; the functions of the brake, clutch and chain stopper do not replace one another.

Zincirin yönü, şakül/marka, hız, yük ve.en: Monitor the lead of the chain, the vertical/marks, speed, load and the angle at which it leaves the seabed together.

Fren sıcaklığı, hidrolik basınç/kaçak, m.en: Assess the brake temperature, hydraulic pressure/leaks, motor current and abnormal noise/vibration as trends.

Köprü ile her komutta kapalı çevrim repe.en: Use closed-loop repeat-back with the bridge for every order; compare the observed chain movement with the control indicator.

Demir yerine oturduğunda yükün stopper'a.en: When the anchor is housed, verify physically that the load has been transferred to the stopper; do not rely on the brake lever position alone.

Kontrolsüz zincir kaçırma, fren tutmamas.en: Do not continue the operation if the chain runs out uncontrolled, the brake does not hold or personnel enter the line of the chain.

Basınç/akım ani yükselmesi, zincirin haw.en: Stop and call the Master in the event of a sudden rise in pressure/current, the chain seating wrongly in the hawse pipe, or loss of communication.

Gerçek bir demir ırgadı örneği. Wildcat,.en: An example of a real anchor windlass. The wildcat, clutch, band brake and chain stopper arrangement varies from ship to ship; a photograph on its own is not an operating diagram.

SWL tek bir evrensel kapasite değildir;.en: SWL is not a single universal capacity; the outreach, jib angle, grab/spreader weight, dynamic load, trim/list and wind change the load chart.

Load chart, outreach, kanca yüksekliği,.en: Monitor the load chart, outreach, hook height, rope spooling, brake and limit indicators together with the movement of the load.

Rüzgâr, gemi hareketi, side-pull, yük sa.en: Continuously reassess the wind, ship movement, side pull, swing of the load and quality of communication.

Yük ağırlığı ve loose gear toplamını bel.en: Verify the total of the load weight and loose gear from documents/labels; do not lift an unknown load by guesswork.

Yüksüz fonksiyon-fren-limit testi ile fi.en: Check with a no-load function, brake and limit test that the physical movement matches the direction of the control.

Overload/limit alarmı, fren kaydırması,.en: Make the load safe in case of an overload/limit alarm, brake slip, wire damage, personnel under the load or loss of communication.

Beklenmeyen list/trim, çatlak/deformasyo.en: If there is an unexpected list/trim, cracking/deformation, a hydraulic leak or abnormal noise, do not continue without an authorised inspection.

Gemi güverte vinci örneği. Doğru kapasit.en: An example of a ship's deck crane. The correct capacity is determined not from a photograph but from that crane's load chart, SWL marking and certified loose gear records.

Auto-tension her rıhtım operasyonunda gü.en: Auto-tension is not a safe default in every berth operation; if the ship/terminal procedure and line arrangement are not suitable, it can cause lines to slacken and tighten in turn.

Halat lead'i, katmanlanma, aşınma, eşit.en: Physically monitor the line lead, layering, wear, equal load sharing and the snap-back direction.

Fren tutma, render/tension göstergesi, g.en: Assess the brake holding, render/tension indicator, tide/draft changes and the effect of wind/current together.

Mooring planındaki hat fonksiyonunu ve d.en: Verify on deck the function of the line in the mooring plan and the correct use of fairleads/bollards.

Fren test sonucu ile üretici/design MBL.en: Compare the brake test result with the setting based on the manufacturer's/design MBL; do not tighten by feel alone.

Personel bight/snap-back alanındaysa, ha.en: Stop the winch if personnel are in the bight/snap-back area, the line is jumping or communication is lost.

Fren kayması, pedestal/fairlead deformas.en: In the event of brake slip, pedestal/fairlead deformation or serious damage to the line, transfer the load to another line under control and report it.

Bir mooring winch kurulum örneği. Tambur.en: An example of a mooring winch installation. The drum, split drum, warping head and brake arrangement vary from ship to ship; the safe area is not just a painted stripe.

Cleat'leri aşırı sıkmak hasarlı conta, c.en: Over-tightening the cleats does not make up for a damaged gasket, compression bar or drain; a hose/ultrasonic test result is meaningful only with the correct procedure.

Panel hizası, teker/ray, hidrolik kaçak,.en: Monitor panel alignment, wheels/rails, hydraulic leaks, cross joints, gasket compression and the drain channel.

Kapatmada cleat yükünü dengeli uygula; c.en: When closing, apply the cleat load evenly; check the integrity of the coaming, drain non-return valves and access hatches together.

Kapanma sonrası fiziksel kilit/cleat poz.en: After closing, verify the physical lock/cleat positions and that the drains are clear by walking round with two people.

Yük/hava riskine göre yetkin kişiyle ult.en: Depending on the cargo/weather risk, carry out an ultrasonic or approved hose test with a competent person; do not mistake a chalk test for a watertightness test.

Panel hareket alanında kişi/engel, hizas.en: Stop the movement if there are people/obstructions in the path of the panels, panels out of alignment or a safety interlock fault.

Çatlak, kalıcı deformasyon, conta hattın.en: In the event of cracking, permanent deformation, a serious leak along the gasket line or a locking failure, escalate the decision to sail to the Master/class process.

Gerçek bir ambar kapağı örneği. Fotoğraf.en: An example of a real hatch cover. The photograph gives the general appearance of the type; weathertightness depends on the gasket, compression bar, cross joints and drains working together.

Capstan halatı kilitleyen bir depolama t.en: A capstan is not a storage drum that locks the rope; as the number of turns increases, the holding force and the risk of jamming/override increase together.

Halatın düzgün turunu, kuyruk tarafındak.en: Monitor the even turns of the rope, the stance of the person on the tail and the start of any override.

Motor yükü, warping head yüzeyi, ayak ku.en: Continuously check the motor load, the warping head surface, the return of the foot control and communications.

Halat lead'inin capstan eksenine uygun v.en: Before the operation, verify that the rope lead suits the capstan axis and that the fairlead is clear.

Kumandayı bıraktığında hareketin kesildi.en: Test at no load that the movement stops when the control is released; do not count switching the main switch as a test.

Halat üst üste binmeye, kişinin eli/giys.en: Stop immediately if the rope starts to override, a person's hand/clothing comes close or control of the tail is lost.

Kumanda takılması, frenlememe, anormal s.en: If the control sticks, it does not brake, it overheats or the pedestal is cracked, apply LOTO and report it.

Dikey capstan/warping head örneği. Halat.en: An example of a vertical capstan/warping head. The direction of the turns and the safe position of the operator are set by the ship's actual fairlead arrangement.

Radar her hedefi garanti ederek gösterme.en: Radar does not guarantee to show every target; clutter settings can remove a target, and the ARPA CPA/TCPA is an estimate that depends on the sensors, tracking time and target manoeuvres.

Brilliance, range, orientation/motion, g.en: Set the brilliance, range, orientation/motion, gain, tuning, sea/rain clutter and pulse to suit the conditions; check on different ranges that the automatic settings are not suppressing small targets.

Relative/true vector, vector time, targe.en: Do not treat CPA/TCPA as a decision value without reading the relative/true vector, vector time, target history, acquisition status and the heading/speed sensor.

Hedefi görsel kerteriz, ikinci radar, AI.en: Cross-check the target with a visual bearing, a second radar, the AIS identity and, if possible, the chart/PI; do not mistake an AIS symbol for a radar echo.

EBL/VRM ve paralel index'i sabit harita.en: Check the EBL/VRM and parallel index against a fixed charted object; if the heading marker/antenna alignment or range/bearing accuracy is in doubt, carry out a performance test.

Heading veya speed input kaybı, yanlış m.en: If the heading or speed input is lost, the motion/vector mode is wrong, there is a radar/antenna fault or obvious misalignment, do not trust the ARPA result and call the Master.

Kötü görüşte hedef algısı yetersizse saf.en: If target detection is inadequate in poor visibility, reassess the safe speed, reinforce the lookout and organise the team for early and substantial action in accordance with COLREG.

Radar performance/PM ve compass bearing.en: Radar performance/PM and compass bearing check record

Passage plan üzerindeki PI/clearing rang.en: PI/clearing range information on the passage plan

Gemi radarlarının revize performans stan.en: Revised performance standards for shipborne radar

Gözcülük, emniyetli hız, çatışma riski,.en: Look-out, safe speed, risk of collision, action to avoid collision and restricted visibility

Radar/ARPA kullanımı ve emniyetli köprüü.en: Use of radar/ARPA and a safe bridge watch

X-band bir radar PPI/ARPA konsolu örneği.en: An example of an X-band radar PPI/ARPA console. The green echoes on the screen show the real surroundings; the manufacturer's interface may be old, but the logic of range, gain, clutter, EBL/VRM, vectors and trails is the same on current radars.

ECDIS kendi başına emniyetli rota üretme.en: ECDIS does not produce a safe route on its own; legal equivalence depends on type approval, official and up-to-date data, correct use and an adequate independent back-up arrangement together.

Appraisal'da tüm rota için resmî ENC kap.en: In the appraisal, check official ENC coverage, usage band/scale, permits and update status for the whole route; in planning, check the safety depth/contour, XTD, look-ahead, no-go areas, wheel-over and abort points.

Monitoring sırasında seçili position/hea.en: During monitoring, watch the selected position/heading/speed source, chart scale/overscale, off-track, safety contour and special-condition alerts; do not acknowledge an alarm without understanding its cause.

Primary GNSS mevkiini radar/visual fix,.en: Cross-check the primary GNSS position with a radar/visual fix, a second independent PNT source or another suitable method; do not treat the radar overlay alignment as independent evidence of position.

Automatic route check sonrasında rotayı.en: After the automatic route check, inspect the route leg by leg visually at the largest suitable ENC scale; take mariner action for isolated dangers, CATZOC/quality, SCAMIN and temporary/preliminary information.

Resmî kapsam/permit/update yokluğu, upda.en: Do not approve the plan if official coverage/permits/updates are missing, an update is rejected, the datum/PNT is in doubt or the back-up arrangement cannot be used; escalate to the Master and the company procedure.

Position jump/freeze, heading uyuşmazlığ.en: In the event of a position jump/freeze, heading mismatch, safety alarm or unplanned deviation, first bring the ship into a safe navigational condition; do not let following the route line on the screen become an automatic reflex.

ENC update report, permit ve update reje.en: ENC update report, permit and update rejection record

Master-approved passage plan/revision ve.en: Master-approved passage plan/revision and alarm/position cross-check records

1 Ocak 2009-31 Aralık 2025 arasında kuru.en: Revised performance standards for ECDIS installed between 1 January 2009 and 31 December 2025

1 Ocak 2026-2028 kurulumlarında alternat.en: Alternative for installations from 1 January 2026 to 2028; the new/S-100 ECDIS standard from 1 January 2029

ECDIS için iyi uygulama, data/maintenanc.en: Good practice for ECDIS; data/maintenance/training roles

Gösterim, ENC veri/koruma ve denizci kul.en: Presentation, ENC data/protection and mariner's guidance for use

Ortadaki ekran ECDIS, yanlardaki ekranla.en: The display in the middle is the ECDIS; the displays on either side are radar consoles. The photograph shows the ECDIS in the context of an integrated bridge; although chart colours and menus vary with the manufacturer/standard, official data, safety settings and independent position checks do not change.

AIS hedef tespit sensörü değildir; yanlı.en: AIS is not a target detection sensor; data may be wrong, delayed, entered incorrectly by hand or not transmitted at all, and AIS alone does not carry a COLREG decision.

MMSI/call sign/IMO, draft, destination,.en: Keep the MMSI/call sign/IMO number, draft, destination, ETA and navigational status fields correct for the voyage; monitor the sensor status and position age.

CPA/TCPA ve association durumunu radar e.en: Compare the CPA/TCPA and association status with the radar echo; check whether the same target is producing two symbols or a wrong merge.

AIS kimliğini radar echo/bearing-range v.en: Match the AIS identity with the radar echo/bearing–range and visual observation; prove that the ship whose name appears on the screen is the same as the physical target.

Own-ship yayınını uygun test/shore repor.en: Verify the own-ship transmission with a suitable test/shore report or a second receiver according to the procedure; the decision to switch off for security reasons is made and recorded by the Master.

Yanlış own-ship identity/position, sürek.en: If the own-ship identity/position is wrong, there is a continuous TX alarm or spoofing is suspected, stop using the data as a basis for decisions and inform the Master.

Hedef manevrası AIS ile radar arasında u.en: If the target's manoeuvre does not agree between AIS and radar, go back to radar plotting and visual information; do not let a VHF agreement replace COLREG responsibility.

Bir Class A AIS MKD örneği. Bu fiziksel.en: An example of a Class A AIS MKD. This physical display is only the minimum display; on a modern ship AIS data are usually presented on the ECDIS/radar, and they are still not a radar echo.

GNSS ekrandaki hassasiyet kadar doğru ka.en: GNSS cannot be assumed to be as accurate as the precision shown on the display; the antenna/multipath, geometry, augmentation, jamming/spoofing and datum integrity affect the result.

Kullanılan constellation, datum, positio.en: Monitor the constellation used, datum, position age, HDOP/quality/RAIM and alarm indicators according to the phase of the voyage.

COG/SOG'nin düşük hızdaki oynaklığını he.en: Distinguish the fluctuation of COG/SOG at low speed from the heading/log data; remember that the same GNSS source can create a common error in all systems.

Mevkiyi radar/visual/terrestrial fix ve.en: Cross-check the position with a radar/visual/terrestrial fix and, if possible, an independent antenna/receiver; seeing the same coordinates on two displays is not independent verification.

Jamming/spoofing şüphesinde zaman, COG/S.en: If jamming/spoofing is suspected, check the time, COG/SOG, AIS targets, radar overlay and alignment with charted objects together.

Ani position jump, imkânsız hız/rota, in.en: In the event of a sudden position jump, impossible speed/course, an integrity alarm or the same deviation on several GNSS receivers, remove the dependence on the autopilot/track control and call the Master.

Kıyı yaklaşmasında doğrulanamayan mevkiy.en: When approaching the coast, do not rely on appearing within the planned XTD with a position that cannot be verified; go back to a safe speed/area and manual fixing.

Köprüüstü GNSS alıcısı örneği. Ekrandaki.en: An example of a bridge GNSS receiver. The coordinates on the screen are not proof of accuracy; the quality/integrity indicators and independent position checks must be read together.

Gyro ve manyetik pusula farklı kuzey ref.en: The gyro and magnetic compass have different north references and error models; repeaters showing the same value does not prove that the master compass is accurate.

Master-repeater farkı, gyro alarmı, lati.en: Monitor the master–repeater difference, gyro alarms, latitude/speed inputs and, on the magnetic compass, bubbles/freedom of the card/the effect of deviation.

Her vardiya ve belirgin rota/enlem/hız d.en: Check the compass error trend with a suitable method every watch and after significant changes of course/latitude/speed; do not accept a single measurement as absolute.

Gyro error'ı celestial azimuth/amplitude.en: Calculate the gyro error by celestial azimuth/amplitude or a reliable transit, and the magnetic error by separating variation and deviation.

Steering, radar ve ECDIS heading değerle.en: Compare the steering, radar and ECDIS heading values with the master/repeater; distinguish a distribution fault from a compass fault.

Heading jump, repeater uyumsuzluğu veya.en: In the event of a heading jump, repeater mismatch or a gyro error that cannot be checked, leave automatic/track steering appropriately and set up back-up navigation with the magnetic compass.

Manyetik pusula yakınına yeni ferromanye.en: If new ferromagnetic/electrical equipment has been placed near the magnetic compass, do not take the old card as definitive until the deviation has been checked.

Fotoğraf bir gyro repeater/azimuth circl.en: The photograph shows a gyro repeater/azimuth circle arrangement; it must not be confused with a magnetic compass binnacle. The master gyro, repeaters and magnetic compass have separate error checks.

Echo sounder charted depth veya tam UKC.en: The echo sounder reading is not the charted depth or the full UKC; draft, transducer offset, tide, squat/heel and sound velocity effects are dealt with separately.

Range, gain, frequency, keel/transducer.en: Monitor the range, gain, frequency, keel/transducer offset, shallow alarm and bottom lock against the actual depth of water.

Aeration, heavy weather, soft mud, steep.en: Recognise false traces such as aeration, heavy weather, soft mud, a steep bottom and second echoes; notice when automatic range loses the bottom.

Gösterim referansını gemi draftı/offset.en: Verify the display reference against the ship's draft/offset document; do not confuse 'below keel', 'below transducer' and 'below surface' values.

Charted depth+tide ile ölçümü trend olar.en: Compare the measurement with charted depth + tide as a trend; if they differ, consider survey quality, squat, heel and sound velocity.

Sığ su alarmı, bottom loss veya beklenme.en: On a shallow water alarm, bottom loss or an unexpectedly rapid decrease in depth, call the Master and reassess the speed/course and UKC plan.

Offset bilinmiyorsa ekrandaki sayıyı UKC.en: If the offset is not known, do not report the displayed figure as UKC; do not continue the approach without a reliable back-up measurement/area.

Tarihî kâğıt kayıtlı bir echo sounder ör.en: This is an example of a historical echo sounder with a paper recorder; modern bridges use colour digital displays. What matters in training is the transducer reference, gain/range, the bottom echo and the UKC distinction.

Tek bir exhaust temperature veya scaveng.en: There is no universal normal value for a single exhaust temperature or scavenge pressure; the trend between cylinders is read against the maker's limits.

Silindir egzoz sıcaklığı farkı, scavenge.en: Trend the exhaust temperature difference between cylinders, scavenge pressure/temperature, Pmax/IMEP, bearing/LO values and turbocharger behaviour together.

Slow steaming, manevra ve yük artışında.en: Apply the limits on thermal load, excess air, liner lubrication and the torsional barred range during slow steaming, manoeuvring and load increases.

Otomasyon değerini lokal gösterge/indepe.en: Verify the automation value with a local gauge/independent thermometer-pressure gauge and by comparison between cylinders.

Köprü telegraph komutu, governor/fuel in.en: Confirm in a closed loop the bridge telegraph order, the governor/fuel index and the actual rpm/pitch response.
