Crankcase oil mist, scavenge fire işaret.en: In the event of crankcase oil mist, signs of a scavenge fire, severe bearing temperature/LO loss or overspeed, apply the maker's emergency response.

Anormal vuruntu, hızlı egzoz sapması vey.en: In the event of abnormal knocking, a rapid exhaust deviation or metal particles, reduce the load safely; the Chief Engineer decides on restart/inspection.

Düşük devirli iki zamanlı ana makinenin.en: An example of the top platform/cylinder covers of a slow-speed two-stroke main engine. The internal cycle and the oil–air–fuel flow must be read from the system diagram.

Ana tahrik ve genset uygulamasında gover.en: The governor/load sharing/gear limits differ between main propulsion and generator applications; automatic load acceptance does not replace mechanical preparation.

Egzoz sıcaklık balansı, charge air, LO/C.en: Monitor the exhaust temperature balance, charge air, LO/CW, crankcase, turbocharger speed and generator/gear load together.

Start-stop sayısı, düşük yükte kurum/wet.en: Manage the number of starts and stops, fouling/wet stacking at low load and the effect of sudden load steps according to the maker's limits.

Lokal basınç/sıcaklığı otomasyonla karşı.en: Compare local pressures/temperatures with the automation; prove a cylinder cut-out or load balance result with the exhaust trend.

Clutch/gear veya breaker bağlantısından.en: Before engaging the clutch/gear or closing the breaker, verify the rpm, phase/load sharing and permissive status.

LO loss, overspeed, crankcase mist, cool.en: In the event of LO loss, overspeed, crankcase mist, cooling failure or serious knocking, carry out a safe shutdown without bypassing the protection.

Start air/fuel leak, misfire veya yük pa.en: In the event of a starting air/fuel leak, misfiring or unstable load sharing, plan the changeover to the standby engine and inform the Chief Engineer.

Orta devirli dört zamanlı motor örneği..en: An example of a medium-speed four-stroke engine. The generator or propulsion connection and the valve/turbocharger arrangement vary with the model.

Bearing sıcaklığının normal olması align.en: A normal bearing temperature does not on its own prove the alignment, wear-down and integrity of the stern tube seals.

Bearing temperature, vibration, stern tu.en: Trend the bearing temperature, vibration, stern tube oil level/pressure, seal leakage and coupling/shaft behaviour against rpm and load.

Hull deflection, draft/trim ve sıcaklık.en: Assess the effect of hull deflection, draft/trim and temperature changes on the alignment measurements in the context of maintenance.

Sensör trendini lokal inspection, oil sa.en: Cross-check the sensor trend with local inspection, oil samples, wear-down/poker gauge readings and class/maker tolerances.

Vibration artışını motor combustion, pro.en: Do not replace parts before separating an increase in vibration into combustion, propeller fouling/damage and shaft alignment sources.

Hızlı bearing temp artışı, metalik ses,.en: In the event of a rapid rise in bearing temperature, a metallic noise, a large oil loss/seal leak or severe vibration, reduce the rpm safely and inform the Chief Engineer.

Shaft earth/grounding veya turning gear.en: In the event of a shaft earthing/grounding or turning gear interlock fault, do not return to normal operation without a maker/class assessment.

Makine dairesindeki şaft hattı ve yatak.en: An example of the shaft line and a bearing in the engine room. The photograph gives the external appearance; thrust transmission, the stern tube and alignment measurements are understood from the diagram.

Pitch, rpm ve güç tek başına itme/verim.en: Pitch, rpm and power alone are not thrust or efficiency; wake, slip, cavitation, fouling, draft and sea state change the result.

Shaft rpm/power, CPP pitch feedback, vib.en: Monitor the shaft rpm/power, CPP pitch feedback, vibration, speed/slip and stern tube/gear load together.

Cavitation/ventilation işaretleri, ağır.en: Assess signs of cavitation/ventilation, racing in heavy weather and the barred range according to the operating conditions.

Pitch command-feedback'i ve shaft power'.en: Compare the pitch command–feedback and shaft power with the sea trial/baseline trend; do not diagnose a propeller fault from loss of speed alone.

Underwater damage/fouling şüphesini vibr.en: Verify a suspicion of underwater damage/fouling with the vibration spectrum, the fuel–power–speed trend and a suitable inspection.

Pitch runaway/feedback mismatch, severe.en: In the event of pitch runaway/feedback mismatch, severe vibration or reaching the shaft torque limit, reduce the load with bridge–engine room coordination.

Blade/hub oil leak ya da grounding sonra.en: Do not use high power after a blade/hub oil leak or a grounding without a class/maker inspection.

Pervane ve dümen kurulum örneği. Blade g.en: An example of a propeller and rudder installation. Blade geometry, pitch and tip clearance are not measured from a photograph; approved drawings and survey data are used.

Rudder angle indicator komutu değil gerç.en: The rudder angle indicator must show the actual feedback, not the command; autopilot performance does not replace the steering gear safety test.

Command-actual rudder farkı, pump pressu.en: Monitor the difference between commanded and actual rudder, pump pressure/temperature, oil level/leaks, hunting and response time.

Heavy weather veya düşük hızda dümen etk.en: In heavy weather or at low speed, assess the rudder effect together with propulsion/wake; do not keep loading the limit stop continuously.

Pre-departure steering testinde full mov.en: In the pre-departure steering test, physically verify full movement, timing, pumps, remote/local/emergency control, indicators, alarms and bridge–steering gear room communications.

Gyro/autopilot hatasını lokal follow-up/.en: Separate a gyro/autopilot fault from the steering gear using local follow-up/non-follow-up control and the actual rudder feedback.

Rudder response kaybı, hydraulic burst/l.en: In the event of loss of rudder response, a hydraulic burst/leak, conflicting indicators or uncontrollable hunting, apply the emergency steering procedure and call the Master.

Bir güç ünitesi arızasında kalan kapasit.en: After a power unit failure, do not continue normal manoeuvring without verifying the remaining capacity and the SOLAS/maker limits.

Pervane arkasındaki dümen dış görünümü..en: External view of the rudder behind the propeller. The steering gear, ram/rotary vane and back-up control arrangement are inside the ship and are examined with a separate diagram.

Breaker'ın kapanması güvenli paraleli te.en: Closing the breaker does not on its own prove safe paralleling; phase sequence, voltage, frequency, synchronism, reverse power and load sharing work together.

kW/kVAr, current balance, voltage/freque.en: Monitor kW/kVAr, current balance, voltage/frequency, PF, winding/bearing temperatures and engine exhaust/LO/CW values together.

Load step, spinning reserve, preferentia.en: Manage load steps, spinning reserve, preferential trips and standby auto-start readiness according to the ship's operation.

Senkron koşullarını synchroscope/lamp ve.en: Verify the synchronising conditions with the synchroscope/lamps and the protection permissive; do not try paralleling with the wrong phase sequence.

Load sharing'i her jeneratörün kW/kVAr t.en: Cross-check load sharing with each generator's kW/kVAr response and the governor/AVR mode.

Reverse power, differential/earth fault,.en: Do not bypass the protection in the event of reverse power, a differential/earth fault, unstable frequency/voltage or a serious engine alarm.

Blackout riskinde kritik yükleri koru, s.en: If there is a risk of blackout, protect the critical loads, apply the standby/emergency source procedure and call the Chief Engineer.

Gemi dizel jeneratör seti örneği. Prime.en: An example of a ship's diesel generator set. The prime mover, the alternator and the MSB protection chain are separate components.

Su seviye göstergesi tek noktadan doğrul.en: A water level indication is not accepted as reliable without verification from more than one point; the low-low water and flame failure interlocks are not bypassed for operational convenience.

İki bağımsız level göstergesi, steam pre.en: Trend the two independent level indicators, steam pressure, flame, FD fan/draft, feed flow and water chemistry.

Light-up/purge, burner sequence ve sudde.en: During light-up/purge, the burner sequence and sudden load changes, distinguish the swell/shrink effect from the actual water level.

Gauge glass blow-through ve independent.en: Carry out the gauge glass blow-through and independent level alarm test in the maker/SMS sequence; do not accept the transmitter value on its own.

Safety valve, flame scanner ve low-water.en: Verify the safety valve, flame scanner and low-water trip tests with an authorised procedure and records.

Low-low water, flame failure sonrası yak.en: In the event of low-low water, fuel accumulation after a flame failure, a furnace blowback or a suspected tube leak, carry out a safe shutdown/purge immediately.

Susuz kazana doğrudan feed verme; soğutm.en: Do not feed water directly into a boiler that has run dry; the decision on cooling and inspection is set by the Chief Engineer/maker's procedure.

Gemi yardımcı kazanı örneği. Burner, fur.en: An example of a ship's auxiliary boiler. The burner, furnace, drum and safety devices are not fully visible in an external photograph.

Purifier kapasitesi nominal debi değildi.en: Purifier capacity is not the nominal flow rate; viscosity/temperature, density, interface setting and the actual contamination change the separation result.

Feed temperature/viscosity, pressure, bo.en: Monitor the feed temperature/viscosity, pressure, bowl speed, vibration, back pressure and discharge cycle.

Water seal/interface veya ALCAP water se.en: Manage the water seal/interface or ALCAP water sensor behaviour according to the oil type with the maker's settings.

Clean oil sample ve drain/sludge gözlemi.en: Compare the clean oil sample and drain/sludge observations with the inlet condition; do not take the absence of alarms as proof of separation.

Bowl assembly, gravity disc/parring disc.en: Verify the correct type/fitting of the bowl assembly, gravity disc/paring disc and sealing rings against the overhaul drawing.

High vibration, abnormal bowl noise, oil.en: In the event of high vibration, abnormal bowl noise, oil overflow or loss of speed, stop the feed and apply the maker's shutdown sequence.

Sıcak yağ kaçağında ignition kaynakların.en: In the event of a hot oil leak, isolate the sources of ignition; do not open the bowl until it has stopped completely.

Fuel-oil separator/purifier örneği. Bowl.en: An example of a fuel oil separator/purifier. The internal structure of the bowl and disc stack is not visible in the photograph; the correct flow diagram is what matters.

Receiver basıncı tek başına hava kalites.en: Receiver pressure alone does not prove air quality or compressor safety; the discharge temperature, drains, relief valves and oil carry-over are monitored.

Stage pressure/temperature, cooling wate.en: Monitor the stage pressures/temperatures, cooling water, LO, unloader and automatic drain behaviour.

Start frequency ve receiver pressure dec.en: Trend the start frequency and receiver pressure decay against leakage/air demand.

Interstage gauge ve relief/non-return du.en: Compare the interstage gauge and relief/non-return valve status by local checks with the automation.

Receiver drain condensate/oil miktarı il.en: Cross-check the amount of condensate/oil drained from the receiver with the discharge air quality and the compressor condition.

High discharge temp, relief lifting, kno.en: Stop the compressor in the event of a high discharge temperature, a relief valve lifting, knocking, loss of cooling or oil carry-over.

Receiver/line üzerinde çalışmadan pressu.en: Before working on the receiver/lines, isolate the pressure, drain and apply LOTO; do not rely on the stop button alone.

Pistonlu starting-air compressor örneği..en: An example of a reciprocating starting air compressor. The intercooler, separator, non-return valve and receiver chain are an integral part of the system.

Pompa tipi ve duty point eşleşmeden 'val.en: An 'open the valve and run it' approach is not safe unless the pump type and duty point match; centrifugal and positive displacement pumps behave differently at shut-off.

Suction/discharge pressure, flow, motor.en: Monitor the suction/discharge pressure, flow, motor current, vibration, seal leakage and bearing temperature together with the duty point.

Cavitation, loss of prime, dead-heading.en: Distinguish cavitation, loss of prime, dead-heading and the minimum-flow requirement according to the pump type.

Valve lineup ve tank level'i P&ID/fiziks.en: Verify the valve line-up and tank level from the P&ID and a physical round; do not rely on the mimic display alone.

Basınç farkını gerçek akış/level change.en: Cross-check the pressure difference with the actual flow/level change; after maintenance, verify the direction of rotation at no load.

Dry running, cavitation, seal failure, r.en: Stop the pump in the event of dry running, cavitation, seal failure, a rapid rise in pressure/current or a PD relief valve failure.

Kimyasal/sıcak/yanıcı akışkan kaçağında.en: In the event of a leak of a chemical/hot/flammable fluid, isolate the area and move to the appropriate PPE/permit procedure.

Makine dairesindeki santrifüj pompa örne.en: An example of a centrifugal pump in the engine room. Not every pump application is the same; the P&ID, pump curve and minimum-flow arrangement must be read.

Üretilen düşük-salinity distillate otoma.en: The low-salinity distillate produced is not automatically drinkable; mineralisation/disinfection and the potable water standard are a separate chain.

Vacuum, temperatures, ejector/seawater f.en: Trend the vacuum, temperatures, ejector/seawater flow, production rate and salinity against the feed condition.

RO'da differential pressure/conductivity.en: Monitor the differential pressure/conductivity on an RO unit, and signs of scale/foaming and demister carry-over on an evaporator.

Salinometer'ı doğrulanmış sample/conduct.en: Cross-check the salinometer with a verified sample/conductivity; carry out the high-salinity automatic dump test according to the maker's procedure.

Potable transfer öncesi dezenfeksiyon ve.en: Before transfer to potable water tanks, verify the disinfection and laboratory/shipboard test requirements according to the ship's plan.

High salinity, vacuum loss, membrane pre.en: In the event of high salinity, loss of vacuum, membrane pressure limit or chemical dosing failure, do not deliver the product to the potable tank.

Contamination şüphesinde tankı izole et,.en: If contamination is suspected, isolate the tank, take a sample and await the decision of the Chief Engineer/Master.

Evaporator tip fresh-water generator örn.en: An example of an evaporator-type fresh water generator. An RO unit looks different; product quality control is mandatory for both systems.

Her gemi atığı yakılamaz; MARPOL, yerel/.en: Not all ship's waste can be incinerated; MARPOL, local/port prohibitions, the type approval and the maker's feed limits apply together.

Chamber temperatures, draft/O2, burner f.en: Monitor the chamber temperatures, draft/O₂, burner flame, feed rate and flue condition against the type-approved cycle.

PVC/halogenated material, pressurized co.en: Separate out PVC/halogenated material, pressurised containers, unknown chemicals and prohibited waste before feeding.

Atık kaynağı/miktarı ile incinerator/slu.en: Cross-check the source/quantity of waste with the incinerator/sludge tank mass balance and the quantity of ash.

Temperature sensor/interlock ve door sea.en: Verify the temperature sensors/interlocks and door seal with the PMS test; do not rely on the displayed value alone.

Flame failure, low temperature, positive.en: In the event of flame failure, low temperature, positive pressure/smoke leakage or refractory damage, stop the feed and carry out the purge/cool-down.

Yasak atık veya emisyon şüphesinde yakma.en: If prohibited waste or emissions are suspected, stop incinerating and follow the MARPOL/port procedure.

15 ppm göstergesi deşarj izni değildir;.en: A 15 ppm reading is not a permission to discharge; the Annex I conditions, special area/local restrictions, being en route, approved equipment and correct records must all be met together.

Feed condition, pressure drop, temperatu.en: Monitor the feed condition, pressure drop, temperature/emulsion, ppm trend, sample flow and the automatic stopping response.

Detergent/chemical emulsion ve clean-wat.en: Ensure that detergent/chemical emulsions and clean-water flushing do not falsify the real sample; do not create a bypass.

Gerçek valve lineup ve overboard/recircu.en: Compare the actual valve line-up and the overboard/recirculation return on a physical round with the mimic display.

15 ppm alarm/automatic stop testini onay.en: Verify the 15 ppm alarm/automatic stop test with the approved method and a valid calibration; the test result must agree with the ORB entry.

ppm yükselişi, sample loss, alarm/auto-s.en: Close the overboard discharge if the ppm rises, the sample is lost, the alarm/auto-stop fails, a seal/bypass is suspected or the legal position condition is not met.

Arızayı seyreltme veya manuel valfle aşm.en: Do not overcome a fault by dilution or with a manual valve; set up the holding capacity/reception facility plan with the Master and Chief Engineer.

Plant running göstergesi effluent standa.en: A 'plant running' indication does not prove the effluent standard; the hydraulic/organic load, disinfectant, sludge and Annex IV/local discharge conditions are monitored.

Blower/aeration, level, return sludge, d.en: Trend the blower/aeration, level, return sludge, disinfectant, odour/foam and effluent clarity daily.

Toxic cleaner/chemical shock, overload v.en: Manage the effect on the biomass of toxic cleaners/chemical shocks, overloading and long idle periods.

Effluent sample/test ve disinfectant res.en: Cross-check the effluent sample/test and disinfectant residual against the equipment limits.

Discharge/holding valve lineup'ını konum.en: Verify the discharge/holding valve line-up physically before reaching the position and checking the local rules.

Blower loss, overflow, failed disinfecti.en: In the event of blower loss, overflow, failed disinfection or non-compliant effluent, close the overboard discharge and move to the holding/reception plan.

Kapalı tank/plant müdahalesinde enclosed.en: Do not enter a closed tank/plant for work without an enclosed-space and biological hazard permit.

Outlet sıcaklığını tutturmak exchanger'ı.en: Holding the outlet temperature does not on its own show that the exchanger is clean or sound; bypass, flow and cross-contamination are monitored.

Her iki taraf inlet/outlet temperature,.en: Trend the inlet/outlet temperatures, pressure drop, flow and control valve position on both sides together.

Fouling, air lock, gasket/tube leak ve t.en: Assess signs of fouling, air locks, gasket/tube leaks and thermal expansion against changes in load.

Heat balance ve sample/level değişimiyle.en: Check for cross-leakage by heat balance and sample/level changes; do not look only at the pressure on one side.

Temizlik sonrası pressure test/plate tig.en: After cleaning, verify the pressure test/plate tightening or tube plugging record against the maker's tolerance.

Rapid cross-contamination, major leak, h.en: In the event of rapid cross-contamination, a major leak, high pressure drop or loss of cooling, reduce the load and isolate the exchanger.

Sıcak/basınçlı ekipmanı drain-vent-cool.en: Do not open hot/pressurised equipment without draining, venting, cooling and LOTO.

Suction/discharge pressure tek başına ch.en: Suction/discharge pressure alone does not diagnose the charge; superheat, subcooling, room/product temperature, airflow and defrost are assessed together.

Room/product temperature, suction/discha.en: Trend the room/product temperature, suction/discharge, superheat, condenser cooling, oil level and defrost cycle.

Ice pattern, fan/door seal, drain ve ref.en: Monitor the ice pattern, fan/door seals, drains and refrigerant leak detector status on a physical round.

Gauge readings'i calibrated thermometer.en: Cross-check gauge readings with a calibrated thermometer and the compressor current; rule out leak/airflow/defrost causes before adding refrigerant.

Stand-by compressor/room alarmı ve emerg.en: Test the standby compressor/room alarm and the emergency response before any risk to the cargo arises.

High discharge pressure/temp, low oil, s.en: Do not bypass the unit's protection in the event of high discharge pressure/temperature, low oil, a severe leak or signs of liquid slugging in the compressor.

Refrigerant kaçağında havalandır, alanı.en: In the event of a refrigerant leak, ventilate, isolate the area and apply the gas safety data/permit procedure.

Acil jeneratörün çalışması acil güç düze.en: The emergency generator running does not prove that the emergency power arrangement is sound; the automatic start time, the correct consumer list, separation of the interconnector and the supply duration are verified together.

Yakıt seviyesi, akü gerilimi/şarj, blok.en: Monitor the fuel level, battery voltage/charge, block heater, room ventilation and the mode (auto/manual) position.

Test sırasında gerilim/frekans oturma sü.en: During the test, assess the time taken for voltage/frequency to settle, the behaviour under load and signs of wet stacking.

Otomatik start dizisini ve interconnecto.en: Verify the automatic start sequence and the separation of the interconnector with a real loss-of-supply scenario, as far as the SMS allows; do not consider a manual start test sufficient.

Beslenen tüketicilerin onaylı elektrik ş.en: Check that the consumers supplied match the emergency consumer list on the approved electrical diagram.

Otomatik start, yük alma veya transfer a.en: In the event of a failure of automatic start, load acceptance or transfer, do not consider the arrangement serviceable; escalate it to the Chief Engineer/Master as a critical defect.

Testten sonra set otomatik modda değilse.en: If the set is not in automatic mode after the test, the ship is considered to be without emergency power; correct it immediately and record it.

Acil jeneratör mahalli örneği. Bağımsız.en: An example of an emergency generator room. The independent fuel, starting and emergency switchboard arrangements are not fully visible in the photograph.

Şaft jeneratörü ana makineye bağımlıdır;.en: The shaft generator depends on the main engine; since a main engine trip can mean a direct loss of electrical power, it is not managed as a sole source.

kW/kVAr, frekans/gerilim kararlılığı, ko.en: Monitor kW/kVAr, frequency/voltage stability, converter temperature, harmonics and the shaft speed/pitch feedback together.

Seyir safhasına göre stand-by dizel jene.en: Manage the readiness of the standby diesel generator and the PMS changeover logic according to the phase of the voyage.

Senkron koşullarını ve yük transferini g.en: Cross-check the synchronising conditions and load transfer with the actual kW response; actually try the changeover to the auxiliary generator before manoeuvring.

Konvertörlü düzende sabit frekansın gerç.en: In a converter arrangement, verify with an independent measurement that a constant frequency is really maintained.

Frekans/gerilim kararsızlığı, konvertör.en: In the event of frequency/voltage instability, converter overtemperature or operation of the protection, take the shaft generator off the busbar and change over to the auxiliary generator.

Manevra ve dar su geçişlerinde tek kayna.en: Do not rely on the shaft generator as the sole source during manoeuvres and narrow-water passages; bring standby capacity on line in advance.

İtici kuvveti gemi hızı arttıkça hızla d.en: Thruster force falls rapidly as the ship's speed increases, and the electrical load can create a blackout risk; the position of the control lever does not prove the actual thrust produced.

Motor akımı/sargı sıcaklığı, hatve geri.en: Monitor the motor current/winding temperature, pitch feedback, vibration, gearbox oil level and busbar frequency together.

Sürekli tam güç kullanım süresini ve tek.en: Manage the duration of continuous full-power use and the restart interval according to the manufacturer's limits.

Kumanda talebi, hatve göstergesi ve gemi.en: Compare the control demand, the pitch indicator and the ship's actual response during manoeuvres; do not rely on the indicator value alone.

Kullanım öncesi devrede yeterli jeneratö.en: Before use, verify from the PMS and busbar load that sufficient generator capacity is on line.

Aşırı titreşim, hatve geri besleme kaybı.en: Stop using it and inform the bridge in the event of excessive vibration, loss of pitch feedback, a motor temperature alarm or a fall in the oil level.

Tünel bölgesinde dalgıç/temizlik çalışma.en: If divers/cleaners are working in the tunnel area, do not give any command until the thruster has been electrically isolated and locked.

Tünel tipi baş itici örneği. Izgara, per.en: An example of a tunnel-type bow thruster. The grating, propeller and gearbox arrangement are not fully visible in the photograph.

Hedef sıcaklığın tutması eşanjörün temiz.en: Holding the target temperature does not show that the exchanger is clean or the circuit sound; flow, differential pressure, valve position and water chemistry are assessed together.

Deniz suyu süzgeç fark basıncı, pompa ba.en: Trend the seawater strainer differential pressure, pump pressures, HT/LT inlet and outlet temperatures and expansion tank level together with the load.

Sığ/çamurlu/buzlu sularda sandık seçimin.en: Manage the choice of sea chest and the MGPS status according to the operating conditions in shallow/muddy/icy waters.

Aynı yükte artan sıcaklık farkını temizl.en: Before interpreting a rising temperature difference at the same load as a need for cleaning, verify the flow and valve positions physically.

Genleşme tankındaki seviye değişimini ka.en: Cross-check level changes in the expansion tank with a pressure test, traces of oil/gas and chloride measurement to distinguish a leak from internal leakage.

Soğutma kaybı, deniz suyu emiş kaybı vey.en: In the event of loss of cooling, loss of seawater suction or suspected internal leakage, reduce the load, change over to the standby pump and inform the Chief Engineer.

Sıcak HT devresinde basınç düşürülüp sıc.en: Do not open a cover/valve on the hot HT circuit until the pressure has been released and the temperature has fallen to a safe level.

Sıcaklık değeri tek başına doğru enjeksi.en: The temperature value alone does not prove correct injection; the decisive quantity is viscosity, and the supply/booster pressure stages are needed to prevent gas locking.

Besleme/booster basıncı, ısıtıcı çıkış s.en: Monitor the supply/booster pressure, heater outlet temperature, viscosity value, filter differential pressure and automatic backflush frequency together.

Yakıt değişiminde sıcaklık değişim hızın.en: During fuel changeover, manage the rate of temperature change and the transition time in the mixing tank according to the manufacturer's limits.

Viskozimetre değerini numune/laboratuvar.en: Cross-check the viscometer value with sample/laboratory data and the heater outlet temperature.

Servis tankı drenajı ve filtre bulguları.en: Assess the service tank drain and filter findings together with separator performance; do not blame the filter alone.

Yakıt pompalarında sıkışma, ani basınç k.en: In the event of fuel pump seizure, sudden loss of pressure, a serious leak or loss of viscosity control, reduce the load and make a planned changeover to a safe fuel.

Sıcak yakıt kaçağında tutuşma kaynakları.en: In the event of a hot fuel leak, isolate the ignition sources; do not open the line while it is under pressure.

Yağ basıncının normal görünmesi film kal.en: A normal-looking oil pressure does not prove the film thickness or oil quality; water content, viscosity and wear metals are a separate chain.

Yağ basıncı/sıcaklığı, filtre fark basın.en: Record the oil pressure/temperature, filter differential pressure and the tank and stern tube header tank levels on rounds.

Silindir yağı besleme oranını yük ve yak.en: Manage the cylinder oil feed rate together with the load and fuel sulphur, and with the iron/alkalinity results of the scrape-down analysis.

Yağ numunesi sonuçlarını (su, viskozite,.en: Compare the oil sample results (water, viscosity, wear metals) with the trend; do not decide on an oil change from a single measurement.

Separatörün gerçekten yağ çektiğini ve b.en: Verify by local observation that the separator is really taking oil and that the discharge cycle is working.

Düşük yağ basıncı, yağda ciddi su veya k.en: In the event of low oil pressure, serious water in the oil or a crankcase temperature/mist alarm, do not bypass the protection; stop the engine safely.

Karter kapağını soğuma süresi beklemeden.en: Do not open the crankcase door without waiting for the cooling time; hot oil vapour carries a risk of explosion.

Mimik panodaki valf göstergesi gerçek ha.en: A valve indication on the mimic panel does not prove the actual line arrangement; separating the ballast and bilge lines is essential both for flooding safety and for pollution.

Pompa emiş/basma basıncı, tank seviye de.en: Monitor the pump suction/discharge pressure, the change in tank level, the effect on draft/trim and the eductor driving pressure together.

Sintine kuyusu seviyelerini ve yüksek se.en: Verify on rounds the bilge well levels and that the high-level alarms are in working order.

Kritik valfleri yerel olarak fiziksel do.en: Verify the critical valves physically on site; compare the change in level with the expected flow rate.

Kayıt defteri girişlerini gerçek soundin.en: Cross-check the record book entries with the actual soundings and operation times.

Beklenmeyen tank seviye değişimi, sintin.en: In the event of an unexpected change in tank level, a bilge level that does not fall or a suspicion of flooding, stop the operation and escalate to the Chief Engineer/Master.

Onaylı ayırıcı devre dışı veya koşullar.en: Do not discharge bilge water overboard while the approved separator is out of service or the conditions are not met; move to the holding and shore facility plan.

Sistem basıncının normal görünmesi yağ t.en: A normal-looking system pressure does not prove oil cleanliness, accumulator pre-charge or tightness; most failures are caused by contamination and moisture.

Sistem basıncı, motor akımı, yağ sıcaklı.en: Monitor the system pressure, motor current, oil temperature, filter differential pressure, tank level and signs of leakage.

Pompanın devreye girme sıklığını ve tüke.en: Trend the pump cut-in frequency and the speed of movement of consumers for internal leakage/loss of pre-charge.

Akümülatör ön şarjını yalnız sistem tara.en: Measure the accumulator pre-charge only after the system side has been drained; do not interpret frequent cutting-in without measuring.

Yağ numunesi partikül ve su sonuçlarını.en: Compare the particle and water results of the oil sample with the manufacturer's target cleanliness class.

Sürekli açan emniyet valfi, hızlı ısınma.en: In the event of a relief valve lifting continuously, rapid heating, a serious leak or loss of control, stop the unit and bring the consumer to a safe position.

Basınçlı hatta çalışmaya başlamadan bası.en: Before starting work on a pressurised line, release the pressure and drain the accumulator side; apply lock-out/tag-out.

Sludge tankının dolu olmaması uyumun kan.en: A sludge tank that is not full is not evidence of compliance; the consistency between production, disposal and tank level is assessed together with the records.

Transfer sırasında tank seviyeleri, pomp.en: During transfer, monitor the tank levels, pump pressure, heating temperature and overflow tank under continuous supervision.

Sludge üretim hızını yakıt kalitesi ve s.en: Trend the sludge production rate weekly together with the fuel quality and separator performance.

Seviye değişimini beklenen debiyle ve so.en: Cross-check the change in level with the expected flow rate and the soundings; check the condensate observation tank for a coil leak.

Kayıt defteri girişlerinin gerçek işlem,.en: Verify that the record book entries are consistent with the actual operations, quantities and receipts.

Basınç yükselip debi oluşmadığında pompa.en: If the pressure rises and there is no flow, stop the pump; do not keep pumping against a closed valve.

Taşma, kaçak veya kirlilik şüphesinde op.en: If an overflow, leak or pollution is suspected, stop the operation, implement the SOPEP and assess the reporting obligation with the Master.

Hidrantta basınç görülmesi tüm ring/main.en: Pressure at one hydrant does not prove the integrity of the whole ring main or the flow at the most distant nozzle; isolation and the independence of the emergency fire pump are tested.

Suction, discharge pressure, priming, le.en: Monitor suction, discharge pressure, priming, leakage and the performance at distant hydrants.

Isolating valves, international shore co.en: Keep the isolating valves, the international shore connection and the emergency pump access/power source ready.

En olumsuz hidrant düzeninde maker/SOLAS.en: Carry out the maker/SOLAS/SMS test with the most unfavourable hydrant arrangement; do not look only at the pump discharge gauge.

Emergency fire pump'ın ana makine daires.en: Physically verify that the emergency fire pump has a suction/power/start arrangement independent of a fire in the main engine room.

Dry running, suction loss, burst main ve.en: In the event of dry running, loss of suction, a burst main or an electrical hazard, use suitable isolation and an alternative pump/section.

Testte yetersiz pressure/flow veya froze.en: If insufficient pressure/flow or a frozen/seized valve is found in the test, report it immediately as a critical defect.

CO₂ release bir ilk müdahale düğmesi değ.en: Releasing CO₂ is not a first-response button; it creates an atmosphere that is lethal to people and is not used without evacuation, a headcount, ventilation/fuel shutdown and the Master's authority.

Release cabinet, pilot cylinder, selecto.en: Periodically check the release cabinet, pilot cylinder, selectors, alarm/time delay, bottle weight/level and the condition of the piping/nozzles.

Gerçek olayda mahal tahliyesi, personel.en: In a real incident, monitor the evacuation of the space, the headcount, boundary cooling and the re-entry atmosphere through the chain of command.

Protected space selector ve shutdown int.en: Verify the protected space selectors and shutdown interlocks against the Fire Control Plan/maker's diagram; do not rely on memory for valve positions.

Servis/quantity kontrolünü yetkili yönte.en: Carry out service/quantity checks by an authorised method; do not test the release line by discharging CO₂.

Personel sayımı tamam değilse veya yanlı.en: Do not release if the headcount is not complete or the wrong space may have been selected.

Release sonrası kontrolsüz yeniden giriş.en: After release, do not start uncontrolled re-entry/ventilation; the Master and the trained team decide on the basis of gas measurements.

Foam tipleri/yüzdeleri ve application ra.en: Foam types/percentages and application rates are not interchangeable; the wrong concentrate, incompatibility with seawater or forceful application can break the blanket.

Concentrate level/type, proportioning pr.en: Monitor the concentrate level/type, proportioning pressure, solution flow and access to the monitors/branch pipes.

Blanket bütünlüğü, wind, hot surface ve.en: Reassess the integrity of the blanket, the wind, hot surfaces and drainage/containment throughout the fire.

Foam concentrate certificate/compatibili.en: Compare the foam concentrate certificate/compatibility and the proportioning test result with the system design.

Yalnız köpük görünümüne bakma; applicati.en: Do not look only at the appearance of the foam; verify the application rate and coverage of the correct space/area against the plan.

Yanlış concentrate, düşük proportioning,.en: In the event of the wrong concentrate, low proportioning, electrical/chemical incompatibility or a risk of personnel exposure, rearrange the application.

PFOS veya yasaklı/uygunsuz concentrate ş.en: If PFOS or a prohibited/unsuitable concentrate is suspected, stop using the stock and escalate to the company/flag procedure.

Sprinkler ve high/low-pressure water mis.en: Sprinklers and high/low-pressure water mist are not the same system; nozzles, section valves, the pump/gas unit and the release logic vary with the maker's design.

Tank/pressure source, pump auto-start, s.en: Monitor the tank/pressure source, pump auto-start, section valves, detector/release panel and any nozzle obstruction.

Activation sonrası affected section, wat.en: After activation, manage the affected section, water demand, drainage/free surface and the risk of re-ignition through the chain of command.

Remote indication ve local valve positio.en: Compare the remote indication with the local valve position; verify the alarm/pump response through the test valve with the maker's procedure.

Nozzle cap/obstruction ve approved spaci.en: Check nozzle caps/obstructions and the approved spacing with the survey/PMS; do not discharge water at random.

Yanlış section release, piping rupture v.en: In the event of the wrong section being released, a piping rupture or an electrical hazard, set up isolation/alternative extinguishing according to the Fire Control Plan.

System impaired ise compensating measure.en: If the system is impaired, do not operate as if normal protection were in place until compensating measures and flag/class/company notification have been completed.

IGS patlamayı imkânsız kılmaz; O₂, basın.en: The IGS does not make an explosion impossible; O₂, pressure, the integrity of the deck seal/non-return devices, venting and cargo operation limits are maintained together.

O₂, deck main pressure/temp, scrubber le.en: Monitor the O₂, deck main pressure/temperature, scrubber level/flow, blower and seal water together with the cargo rate.

Tank pressure/vacuum, P/V breaker ve bra.en: Manage the tank pressure/vacuum, P/V breaker and branch isolations according to the loading/discharge/tank cleaning phase.

Fixed O₂ analyzer'ı portable calibrated.en: Cross-check the fixed O₂ analyser with a calibrated portable meter and the sampling point.

Deck seal/non-return ve alarm trips'i ma.en: Verify the deck seal/non-return devices and alarm trips with the maker/approved manual tests; do not rely only on the panel lamp.

O₂ veya pressure approved limit dışına ç.en: If the O₂ or pressure goes outside the approved limits, stop/reduce the cargo operation concerned according to the manual and call the Master/Cargo Officer.

Deck seal failure, gas backflow veya scr.en: In the event of a deck seal failure, gas backflow or a serious scrubber/blower failure, make the cargo line-up safe.

Normal panel tek tek detector temizliği/.en: A normal panel does not prove the cleanliness/accessibility of each detector or that no zone has been disabled; isolations and faults are managed as an active fire risk.

Panel power, loop/zone fault, disable/is.en: Monitor the panel power, loop/zone faults, the disable/isolate list and the alarm history throughout the watch.

Hot work, steam/dust ve ventilation deği.en: Manage the risk of false alarms/temporary isolation from hot work, steam/dust and ventilation changes through the permit system.

Seçilmiş detector/call point testini app.en: Test the selected detector/call point with the approved test medium and verify the correct address/zone on the panel.

Fire patrol ve mahal turunu disabled det.en: Record fire patrols and rounds of the spaces as compensating measures for disabled detectors; do not act as if automatic detection were in place.

Unknown isolation, repeated fault veya a.en: In the event of an unknown isolation, repeated faults or an alarm that does not match the space, do not just reset the panel and move on; carry out a physical investigation.

Gerçek alarm şüphesinde ventilation/fire.en: If a real alarm is suspected, start the ventilation/fire door and muster response according to the SMS.

Renk/etiket ve basınç göstergesi tek baş.en: The colour/label and the pressure gauge alone are not evidence of suitability; the agent, fire class, capacity, access, servicing and escape route are assessed together.

Doğru konum, erişim, pin/seal, corrosion.en: Check the correct location, access, pin/seal, corrosion/damage, pressure or weight and the service date.

Müdahalede ajan uyumu, wind, electrical.en: During the response, continuously assess the suitability of the agent, the wind, electrical isolation, re-ignition and the escape route.

Fire Control Plan inventory ile gerçek a.en: Compare the actual number/type/location with the Fire Control Plan inventory.

CO₂ ve cartridge/pressure tiplerinde mak.en: For CO₂ and cartridge/stored-pressure types, apply the maker's/service measurement method; do not assume it is fully charged because the gauge is green.

Yangın büyümüş, duman kaçışı kesmiş veya.en: If the fire has grown, smoke has cut off the escape or the agent is unsuitable, abandon personal action and move to the alarm/muster and fixed system.

Kullanılmış/kısmen boşalmış söndürücüyü.en: Do not put a used/partly discharged extinguisher back in place; mark it, replace it and open a record.

EEBD yangınla mücadele veya kapalı mahal.en: An EEBD is not a device for fire-fighting or enclosed-space entry; the SCBA duration is limited not by the nominal cylinder duration but by the user's effort and reserve/discipline.

Cylinder pressure/weight, mask/hood, str.en: Check the cylinder pressure/weight, mask/hood, straps, seal, whistle/low-air alarm and expiry/service status.

SCBA kullanımında entry control, tally,.en: When SCBA is used, monitor entry control, tallies, communications, team back-up and the turn-around pressure.

Donning, face-seal ve low-pressure alarm.en: Verify donning, the face seal and the low-pressure alarm with a training set/procedure; do not discharge the emergency set unnecessarily.

Fire Control Plan/muster inventory ile l.en: Compare the location/number and the spare cylinder/compressor status with the Fire Control Plan/muster inventory.

Mask seal yok, pressure yetersiz, alarm/.en: Do not enter if there is no mask seal, the pressure is insufficient, the alarm/communications are faulty or there is no back-up team.

EEBD ile yangına yaklaşma veya yeniden g.en: Do not approach a fire or re-enter with an EEBD; the device is only for reaching a clear escape route.

Tüm remote shutdown'ları aynı anda rastg.en: Pulling all the remote shutdowns at random at the same time is not safe; selecting the wrong system can affect propulsion, steering, emergency power or personnel safety.

Mühür, erişim, label, actuator energy ve.en: Check the seals, access, labels, actuator energy and remote/local position indication.

Gerçek olayda kapanmanın yangın sınırı,.en: In a real incident, manage the fire boundary, the propulsion/electrical consequences and the restart risk of a shut-off through the chain of command.

Testte komutun doğru valve/fan/pump üzer.en: In a test, verify by local observation that the command produces real movement of the correct valve/fan/pump; do not accept the panel light alone.

Fire Control Plan ve P&ID üzerindeki rem.en: Compare the remote stop/quick-closing mapping on the Fire Control Plan and P&ID with the physical labels.

Yanlış/kimliği belirsiz release veya stu.en: If there is a wrong/unidentified release or a stuck actuator, mark the system as a critical defect and put compensating measures in place.

Yangın mahali emniyetli ilan edilmeden r.en: Do not reset/reopen until the fire space has been declared safe; the Master/Chief Engineer brings it back into service under control.

Pompa discharge pressure tek başına güve.en: Pump discharge pressure alone does not mean a safe flow; tank venting, valve line-up, shore back pressure, NPSH, cargo properties and ESD are monitored together.

Tank level/rate, suction-discharge, pump.en: Monitor the tank level/rate, suction–discharge, pump current/speed, bearings/seals, manifold pressure and venting together.

Stripping aşamasında vapour/gas entrainm.en: In the stripping stage, manage vapour/gas entrainment, cavitation and the tank bottom condition according to the pump limits.

İki kişiyle valve line-up/tank identity.en: Verify the valve line-up/tank identity and manifold connection physically with two people according to the ship–shore checklist.

Transfer rate'i tank level/ullage change.en: Cross-check the transfer rate with the tank level/ullage change and the shore figure; do not rely on a single flowmeter.

Unexpected level/pressure, ESD/communica.en: In the event of an unexpected level/pressure, ESD/communication loss, a seal leak or a venting failure, stop the transfer using the agreed emergency sequence.

Yanlış tank/line contamination şüphesind.en: If contamination from the wrong tank/line is suspected, stop the flow without moving valves and go back to the sample/plan and the Cargo Officer's decision.

COW rutin suyla yıkama değildir; approve.en: COW is not routine washing with water; it is not carried out without the approved COW manual, inert condition, washing programme, oxygen/pressure control and stripping performance.

IG deck pressure/O₂, COW line pressure/t.en: Monitor the IG deck pressure/O₂, COW line pressure/temperature, machine cycle, tank atmosphere and stripping suction throughout the programme.

Static electricity, leakage, wash sequen.en: Manage static electricity, leakage, the washing sequence and the slop/tank level within the limits of the approved manual.

Machine movement/pressure ve stripping p.en: Verify the machine movement/pressure and stripping performance with the designated indicators/soundings.

COW planı ile gerçek tank/machine/line-u.en: Cross-check the COW plan with the actual tank/machine/line-up and the ORB entry.

IG pressure/O₂ limiti ihlali, COW line l.en: In the event of a breach of the IG pressure/O₂ limit, a COW line leak, a machine failure or loss of stripping, stop washing according to the manual.

Manual dışı tank/program veya uygun olma.en: Do not carry out COW on a tank/programme outside the manual or with an unsuitable crude; escalate to the Master/Cargo Officer.

Continuous radar gauge ile independent h.en: A continuous radar gauge and an independent high-level/overfill alarm are not the same function; common power/sensor failures and the effect of cargo foam/vapour are kept separate.

Level trend, rate, alarm health, vapour/.en: Monitor the level trend, rate, alarm health, effect of vapour/foam, sensor discrepancies and tank pressure.

Loading limit ve alarm setpoint'lerini t.en: Assess the loading limits and alarm set points together with the tank table, trim/list and thermal expansion.

Uygun kapalı manual gauging veya bağımsı.en: Cross-check the selected tank reading with suitable closed manual gauging or an independent sensor.

High/high-high alarm functional testini.en: Carry out the high/high-high alarm functional test with the approved procedure; do not mistake a process gauge simulation for a real test of the independent alarm.

Unknown/frozen level, alarm fault veya r.en: If the level is unknown/frozen, there is an alarm fault or the rate and level do not match, reduce/stop the loading rate and measure the tank independently.

Overfill alarmını susturup operasyona de.en: Do not silence the overfill alarm and carry on; apply the ship–shore ESD plan.

Görsel kapalı görünüm veya tebeşir izi t.en: Looking closed or a chalk test alone is not weathertight performance; structural condition, drainage, compression and testing are needed together.

Panel/track alignment, seal compression,.en: Monitor the panel/track alignment, seal compression, cross joints, cleats and the condition of the drain non-return valves.

Heavy weather ve cargo operation sonrası.en: After heavy weather and cargo operations, check for coaming/panel deformation and evidence of leakage.

Pre-loading/closing walkdown ve suitable.en: Verify the whole cover perimeter with a pre-loading/closing walkdown and a suitable leak test.

Repair sonrası local patch'i değil globa.en: After a repair, test the overall compression/drainage continuity, not just the local patch.

Panel hareket alanı açık değilse veya lo.en: Do not move the panels if their path is not clear or the locks/interlocks are not working.

Known leakage/deformation ile sea passag.en: With known leakage/deformation, escalate the decision on the sea passage to the Cargo Officer/Master/class assessment.

Lashing sayısı tek başına yeterlilik değ.en: The number of lashings alone does not determine adequacy; the calculation of cargo weight/CG, stowage position, accelerations, angles, MSL/CS and equipment condition does.

Correct gear/type, thread engagement, te.en: Monitor the correct gear/type, thread engagement, tension, lashing angle, stack geometry and any loose/damaged units.

Heavy weather, ice, vibration ve cargo s.en: Recheck the condition of the lashings after heavy weather, icing, vibration and settling of the cargo.

Actual stow/weight ile approved CSM/comp.en: Compare the actual stowage/weights with the approved CSM/computer input at bay–row–tier level.

Gear marking/certificate ve visual condi.en: Verify the gear markings/certificates and visual condition; do not use equipment that is illegible or deformed.

CSM dışı stow, unknown weight/CG, missin.en: Do not approve departure/the operation without correction if there is stowage outside the CSM, unknown weight/CG, missing/broken fittings or unsafe access.

Denizde lashing müdahalesi için risk ass.en: Do not send the team to work on lashings at sea without a risk assessment, weather/deck access assessment and fall protection.

Socket enerjili ve display normal olması.en: An energised socket and a normal display do not prove the pulp temperature of the cargo; the container unit, airflow, set point and cargo instructions are assessed together.

Set/supply/return temp, current, phase/a.en: Monitor the set/supply/return temperatures, current, phase/alarms, defrost and ventilation setting against the cargo instructions.

Plug/lead condition, water ingress, secu.en: Check the plug/lead condition, water ingress, securing and safe access on every round.

Container ID ve setpoint'i manifest/reef.en: Cross-check the container ID and set point with the manifest/reefer list, and remote monitoring with the local display.

Electrical isolation/dead test'i bağlant.en: Before disconnecting, verify electrical isolation/dead test with a suitable tester and permit.

Damaged/wet plug, earth fault, overheati.en: In the event of a damaged/wet plug, an earth fault, overheating or unsafe access, isolate the power and inform the ETO/Cargo Officer.

Temperature excursion'da setpoint'i izin.en: In a temperature excursion, do not change the set point without authorisation; record the time of the alarm, the local condition and the cargo instructions.

Closed lamp tek başına emniyet değildir;.en: A 'closed' lamp alone is not safety; physical locking, cleats, isolation of hydraulic pressure and the bridge indication are verified separately.

Movement zone, hinge/wire/cylinder load,.en: Monitor the movement zone, hinge/wire/cylinder loads, hydraulic leaks, the vehicle interface and wind/ship motion.

Closing'de seal/compression, lock sequen.en: When closing, check the seal/compression, lock sequence and local/bridge indication step by step.

Sorumlu kişi tüm locks/cleats'i fiziksel.en: The person in charge physically checks all locks/cleats and compares them with the bridge indicator.

Departure checklist ve shell-door alarm.en: Carry out the departure checklist and the shell door alarm test according to the SMS; do not treat CCTV as the only evidence.

Person/vehicle movement zone'da, interlo.en: Stop the movement if there are persons/vehicles in the movement zone, an interlock is bypassed, the movement is asymmetrical or there is a wire/hydraulic abnormality.

Lock/seal/indicator uyuşmazlığında deniz.en: If the locks/seals/indicators do not agree, escalate the decision to proceed to sea to the Master/class procedure.

Crane SWL, derrick union purchase SWL ve.en: Crane SWL, derrick union purchase SWL or loose gear MSL values are not directly convertible into one another; the rig configuration and resultant loads are calculated.

Rig geometry, preventer/guy tension, wir.en: Monitor the rig geometry, preventer/guy tension, wire leads, brakes/limits, load swing and weather.

Single agreed signaller, radio fallback.en: Keep a single agreed signaller, a radio fallback and the exclusion zone throughout the operation.

Cargo weight/CG, lift points ve tüm gear.en: Compare the cargo weight/CG, lift points and all gear certificates/SWL with the lift plan.

Yüksüz ve uygun test yükü altında brake/.en: Verify the brake/limit/function check at no load and under a suitable test load with the approved procedure.

Unknown weight, side pull, gear damage,.en: Stop lifting if the weight is unknown, there is a side pull, gear damage, loss of communication or a person under the load.

Any overload/structural contact sonrası.en: After any overload/structural contact, do not use it again without an examination by a competent person.

Tank cleaning kimyasal püskürtme değildi.en: Tank cleaning is not spraying chemicals; the atmosphere, static electricity, toxicity, tank coating, heating, slop capacity and discharge law are managed together.

Tank atmosphere, wash pressure/temp, mac.en: Monitor the tank atmosphere, wash pressure/temperature, machine cycle, slop level, stripping suction and deck leaks.

Simultaneous operations, venting/IG, che.en: Manage simultaneous operations, venting/IG, chemical exposure and enclosed-space boundaries with the permit/SMS.

Cleaning plan ile actual tank/line/machi.en: Cross-check the cleaning plan with the actual tank/line/machine programme and the slop capacity.

Eductor motive pressure-vacuum ve stripp.en: Verify the eductor motive pressure/vacuum and the stripping result with soundings/ullages.

Atmosphere limit dışı, IG/vent failure,.en: Stop cleaning if the atmosphere is outside the limits, or in the event of IG/vent failure, a leak, a jammed machine or a risk to slop capacity.

Tank entry için ayrı enclosed-space entr.en: Do not enter the tank until a separate enclosed-space entry permit, gas-freeing and LOTO have been completed.

Type approval her su kalitesi/flow koşul.en: Type approval does not guarantee compliance in every water quality/flow condition; the system design limitations, TRO/UV dose, holding time and contingency measures are applied.

Flow, filter differential pressure/backw.en: Compare the flow, filter differential pressure/backwash, UV intensity/UVT or TRO, temperature/salinity and treatment alarms with the SDL.

Bypass, sensor invalid, hold time ve neu.en: Manage bypass, invalid sensors, holding time and the neutralisation/discharge limits with the voyage plan.

Valve line-up ve treatment status'u actu.en: Cross-check the valve line-up and treatment status with the actual ballast tank/flow, and sensor readings with calibration/samples.

BWRB entry, BWMP contingency action ve a.en: Verify that the BWRB entry, the BWMP contingency action and the alarm export describe the same operation.

Treatment critical alarm, unapproved byp.en: Do not discharge as if compliant in the event of a critical treatment alarm, an unapproved bypass, an invalid sensor or conditions outside the SDL.

Contingency measure'i Kaptan/şirket/port.en: Determine and record the contingency measures through the Master/company/port authority process.

ppm ekranı veya clean-water test sonucu.en: A ppm display or a clean-water test result does not prove that the actual bilge flow is compliant; approved piping, alarm/stop, the position requirement and the ORB mass balance are required.

Feed homogenization, pressure drop, emul.en: Monitor feed homogenisation, pressure drop, emulsion, sample flow, the ppm trend and the automatic stop.

Tank sounding, processed quantity ve dis.en: Check that the tank sounding, processed quantity and discharge duration/rate are mathematically consistent.

Actual pipe/valve route'u approved drawi.en: Physically compare the actual pipe/valve route with the approved drawing.

Alarm/automatic stop testini approved pr.en: Verify the alarm/automatic stop test with the approved procedure and a valid calibration.

Sample/alarm/stop arızası, ppm limit aşı.en: If there is a sample/alarm/stop failure, the ppm limit is exceeded or the legal discharge conditions are not met, keep the overboard valve firmly closed.

Bypass/seyreltme yapma; reception facili.en: Do not bypass or dilute; set up a reception facility/holding plan and report the defect.

Genel '3/12 mil' ezberi tek başına karar.en: The general '3/12 miles' rule of thumb is not a decision tree on its own; the approved plant, comminution/disinfection, en route, rate, special area and coastal rules are read together.

Plant/blower/level/disinfection, effluen.en: Monitor the plant/blower/level/disinfection, effluent quality and holding capacity throughout the voyage.

Discharge position/speed/rate ve local/s.en: Verify the discharge position/speed/rate and local/special-area restrictions against the plan.

Valve line-up ve actual tank/effluent co.en: Compare the valve line-up and the actual tank/effluent condition with the panel.

Sample/test ve certificate/approved manu.en: Cross-check sample/test results against the certificate/approved manual limits.

Plant failure, poor effluent, overflow r.en: If there is a plant failure, poor effluent, a risk of overflow or the legal conditions are not met, close the overboard valve.

Tank/plant girişini enclosed-space/biolo.en: Do not enter the tank/plant without enclosed-space/biological hazard checks.

Sludge/garbage availability yakma izni d.en: The availability of sludge/garbage is not permission to incinerate; prohibited materials, port/local restrictions, the chamber condition and the operating manual are decisive.

Chamber temp/draft, flame, feed, flue ve.en: Monitor the chamber temperature/draught, flame, feed, flue and refractory condition.

Waste category/mass balance ve ash dispo.en: Manage the waste category/mass balance and the ash disposal route with the records.

Feed category'yi Garbage/Sludge record v.en: Verify the feed category against the Garbage/Sludge record and the MSDS.

Interlock/sensor testini PMS ve service.en: Cross-check the interlock/sensor test with the PMS and the service report.

Low temp/flame failure/smoke leak/refrac.en: Stop the feed on low temperature, flame failure, smoke leak or refractory damage.

Unknown/prohibited waste veya port ban v.en: Do not incinerate unknown/prohibited waste or where a port ban applies.

Set temperature indoor air quality değil.en: The set temperature is not indoor air quality; outside air, filters, damper/fire closure, humidity, condensate and space pressure are assessed together.

Supply/return temp, humidity, filter ΔP,.en: Monitor the supply/return temperature, humidity, filter ΔP, fan current, condensate and damper position.

Galley/hospital/battery/paint store gibi.en: Maintain the pressure and exhaust separation of special spaces such as the galley, hospital, battery room and paint store.

BMS value'yu calibrated room/duct measur.en: Cross-check the BMS value with a calibrated room/duct measurement and the airflow.

Fire damper/remote stop ve smoke-control.en: Verify the fire damper/remote stop and smoke-control functions with the Fire Control Plan/PMS.

Smoke/fire spread, refrigerant leak veya.en: On smoke/fire spread, refrigerant leak or contamination, isolate the affected zone in a planned way.

Confined duct/fan bakımına LOTO ve hygie.en: Do not enter a confined duct or carry out fan maintenance without LOTO and a hygiene check/permit.

Basınç normal olsa da potable water kali.en: Even if the pressure is normal, potable water quality, air charge, pump cycling, backflow and tank hygiene are checked separately.

Cut-in/out pressure, pump starts, tank l.en: Monitor the cut-in/cut-out pressure, pump starts, tank level/air cushion, leaks and the relief valve.

Chlorine/residual veya ship water plan p.en: Manage chlorine/residual or ship water plan parameters, tank cleanliness and the shore bunkering risk.

Pressure gauge/switch'i calibrated gauge.en: Cross-check the pressure gauge/switch with a calibrated gauge, and pump cycling with the actual demand/a leak test.

Potable quality'yi uygun sample/test ile.en: Verify potable quality with a suitable sample/test; appearance/taste is not the only evidence.

Contamination/backflow, tank bladder/air.en: On contamination/backflow, tank bladder/air loss or rapid cycling, isolate the affected supply and rectify.

Basınçlı tankı depressurize/LOTO olmadan.en: Do not open a pressurised tank without depressurising it and LOTO.

Room air temperature ürün çekirdek sıcak.en: Room air temperature alone does not show the product core temperature and quality; airflow, door openings, defrost and alarm duration are monitored.

Room/product temp, pressure, superheat,.en: Monitor the room/product temperature, pressure, superheat, defrost, fans and the door seal.

Alarm duration ve food segregation/conti.en: Manage the alarm duration and food segregation/contingency with the catering officer.

Remote sensor'u calibrated independent t.en: Compare the remote sensor with a calibrated independent thermometer.

Stand-by unit/alarm ve refrigerant leak.en: Test the stand-by unit/alarm and refrigerant leak detection.

Severe refrigerant leak/high pressure/lo.en: Do not bypass the unit's protection on a severe refrigerant leak, high pressure or low oil.

Temperature excursion'da ürünü otomatik.en: After a temperature excursion, do not automatically treat the product as acceptable; carry out a food-safety assessment and record it.

Devreler arası cross-connection yanlış b.en: A cross-connection between circuits can spread incorrect pressure or contamination; the requirements for starting air, control air and working air are not the same.

Receiver pressures, dew point/oil-water.en: Monitor the receiver pressures, dew point/oil-water drains, compressor cycling and the non-return/relief valve condition.

Control-air quality ve starting-air rese.en: Assess the control-air quality and the starting-air reserve together with the manoeuvring demand.

Local gauges/receiver drains ve automati.en: Cross-check the local gauges/receiver drains and the automatic start-stop with the control system.

Isolation/cross-connection lineup'ını P&.en: Physically verify the isolation/cross-connection line-up with the P&ID and tags.

Oil carry-over/high temp/relief lift vey.en: On oil carry-over, high temperature, relief valve lifting or control-air contamination, isolate the affected source.

Starting-air manifold üzerinde turning g.en: Do not work on the starting-air manifold without the turning gear engaged/engine isolated and the system depressurised.

Steam valve open/pressure varlığı doğru.en: An open steam valve or the presence of pressure does not prove correct condensate drainage or trap operation; the water hammer and hot-surface risks are monitored.

Header/branch pressure, drain/trap, retu.en: Monitor the header/branch pressure, drains/traps, return temperature, hotwell level and the make-up trend.

Warm-through sırasında expansion, water.en: During warming through, manage the expansion, water hammer and condensate pocket risks by operating the valves slowly.

Trap function'ı temperature/ultrasonic m.en: Cross-check trap function with a temperature/ultrasonic method and the condensate return.

Valve lineup ve pressure-reducing/safety.en: Verify the valve line-up and the pressure-reducing/safety devices according to the P&ID/maker's test.

Water hammer, major leak, failed trap ca.en: On water hammer, a major leak, a failed trap causing flooding or overpressure, safely isolate the branch.

Hot/pressurized line'ı cool-drain-vent-L.en: Do not open a hot/pressurised line until cool-down, draining, venting and LOTO are complete.

GMDSS tek bir cihaz veya yalnız Inmarsat.en: GMDSS is not a single device or Inmarsat alone; how the functions are provided depends on the ship's sea area, the approved services/equipment and the duplication/shore-based maintenance arrangement.

Sea area, watch receivers, position/time.en: Monitor the sea area, watch receivers, position/time feed, printer/storage, antenna, reserve source of energy and the charger alarm.

NAVTEX/SafetyNET MSI coverage ve message.en: Match the NAVTEX/SafetyNET MSI coverage and message filtering to the voyage route.

Approved self-test/test call'ları radyo.en: Carry out approved self-tests/test calls according to the radio log procedure; do not accidentally send a distress alert to the live network.

Battery autonomy/capacity ve duplicated.en: Verify the battery autonomy/capacity and the duplicated equipment arrangement with the certificate/diagram.

Distress false alert'te approved cancell.en: On a false distress alert, immediately apply the approved cancellation procedure and establish the record trail with the RCC/coast station.

Watch/alerting fonksiyonu kaybında Maste.en: On loss of the watch/alerting function, inform the Master and set up the defect report/shore assistance and a compensating watch plan.

DSC distress alert ayrıntılı voice distr.en: A DSC distress alert does not replace detailed voice distress traffic; a wrong MMSI/position/time or an antenna fault corrupts the SAR data.

Ch 70 watch, GNSS age, MMSI, power sourc.en: Monitor the Ch 70 watch, GNSS position age, MMSI, power source, squelch/volume and antenna/VSWR faults.

Distress category/nature ve follow-up wo.en: Manage the distress category/nature of distress and the follow-up working channel with the incident procedure.

Internal/self-test ve izinli test call'ı.en: Verify the DSC path with the internal self-test and a permitted test call, and the audio path separately with a routine voice radio check.

Handset/channel/power selection'ı actual.en: Check the handset/channel/power selection against the actual display; do not mistake dual watch for the Ch 70 DSC watch.

False alert'te cihazı kapatıp susma; DSC.en: On a false alert, do not switch the set off and stay silent; apply the DSC cancellation and Ch 16 voice cancellation procedure.

Position/MMSI yanlışsa distress tuşunu k.en: If the position/MMSI is wrong, plan a manual correction/voice supplement rather than pressing the distress button unconditionally.

MF/HF menzili sabit değildir; frequency,.en: MF/HF range is not fixed; frequency, time, the ionosphere, the antenna/tuning and propagation determine it; it is not operated as a simple alternative to satellite.

Sea area/frequency watch, tuning result,.en: Monitor the sea area/frequency watch, tuning result, power, antenna earth, propagation and the selected mode.

Distress acknowledgement/relay ve workin.en: Manage distress acknowledgement/relay and working frequency changes with the GOC procedure.

Approved coast-station test call veya se.en: Verify the DSC path with an approved coast-station test call or self-test, and separately verify voice and the other installed functions listed in the Radio Record.

Position/time ve MMSI'yi alert ekranında.en: Compare the position/time and MMSI on the alert screen with the actual source.

Tuning/antenna fault veya repeated faile.en: On a tuning/antenna fault or repeated failed calls, do not blindly repeat the same action; change to a suitable band/service and the Master's plan.

False distress'te band/mode'a uygun canc.en: On a false distress alert, carry out the cancellation appropriate to the band/mode and the log entry/authority notification.

Terminal login/registered görünümü mesaj.en: A terminal showing logged-in/registered does not by itself prove that a message was delivered or that the correct ocean region/service is selected; delivery status and the EGC configuration are monitored.

Logged-in status, position/time, EGC are.en: Monitor the logged-in status, position/time, EGC areas, printer/storage, antenna and distress button protection.

Message priority, address ve delivery co.en: Check the message priority, address and delivery confirmation according to the operation.

Approved link/performance test ile termi.en: Verify the terminal path with an approved link/performance test, and the filtering by the route relevance of received EGC messages.

Distress position/identity display'ini G.en: Compare the distress position/identity display with the GNSS and the ship's certificate.

Failed delivery/login veya wrong identit.en: On failed delivery/login or a wrong identity/position, do not rely on a single channel; use alternative GMDSS means and notify the Master.

False distress'te recognized service can.en: On a false distress alert, apply the recognised service's cancellation procedure and notify the RCC.

EPIRB test mode dışında aktive edilmez;.en: An EPIRB is not activated except in test mode; the hydrostatic release frees it automatically, but incorrect mounting, lanyard arrangement or an obstruction prevents float-free operation.

Bracket erişimi, housing, lanyard'ın doğ.en: Check bracket access, the housing, correct stowage of the lanyard, HRU and battery expiry, the registration label and the GNSS self-test result.

Gerçek aktivasyonda beacon'ı açık gökyüz.en: On real activation, keep the beacon upright with a clear view of the sky and, if possible, tethered to the survival craft.

Maker self-test/GNSS testini izinli aral.en: Carry out the maker's self-test/GNSS test within the permitted interval; do not make an RF transmission test that looks like a real distress.

HEX ID/MMSI registration'ı certificate/d.en: Compare the HEX ID/MMSI registration with the certificate/database record; update it on a change of ship/flag.

Accidental activation'da beacon'ı kapatm.en: On accidental activation, do not just switch the beacon off; send a false alert cancellation to the RCC/coast station and log it.

Expired/damaged/failed self-test EPIRB'i.en: Do not treat an expired/damaged EPIRB or one that failed its self-test as serviceable; arrange an approved replacement/shore service.

Radar SART S-band radarda görünmez; ekra.en: A radar SART is not seen on S-band radar; the 12 response dots on the display can turn into arcs/rings with range/receiver saturation, and the antenna height determines the range.

Activation indication, mounting height/o.en: Monitor the activation indication, mounting height/orientation and accessibility in the survival craft.

Radar SART aramada X-band radar range/ga.en: During a radar SART search, manage the X-band radar range/gain/sea clutter settings so that they do not suppress the target response.

Maker self-test'i vessel radarına yanlış.en: Carry out the maker's self-test in the approved mode without creating a false target on the ship's radar.

Inventory, battery expiry ve correct typ.en: Compare the inventory, battery expiry and correct type with the muster/LSA plan.

Distress dışında operational mode'a alma.en: Do not switch to operational mode except in distress; if a false response occurs, inform the bridge team.

Failed self-test/expired battery cihazı.en: Do not treat a device with a failed self-test/expired battery as serviceable or put it back in the craft.

BNWAS gözcü veya vardiya zabiti yerine g.en: BNWAS does not replace the lookout or the officer of the watch; continuous/automatic pressing of the reset defeats the purpose of the system, and the authority to select the mode rests with the Master.

Operating mode, timer, reset locations,.en: At the start of the watch, check the operating mode, timer, reset locations, stage alarms and the back-up officer routing.

Reset'in gerçek bridge activity'yi temsi.en: Verify that the reset reflects real bridge activity and that the alarm can be heard above the ambient noise.

Stage sequence ve cabin routing testini.en: Verify the stage sequence and the cabin routing test through to the actual recipients with the SMS/maker procedure.

Mode access/keys ve power-failure alarmı.en: Compare mode access/keys and the power-failure alarm with the bridge equipment checklist.

Stage alarm/routing arızası veya unautho.en: On a stage alarm/routing failure or an unauthorised bypass, inform the Master and set up a compensating watch arrangement.

Alarmı susturmak için sürekli reset/weig.en: Do not use continuous resets, weights or tape to silence the alarm; this disables a critical safety system.

Normal status lamp tüm data channel'ları.en: A normal status lamp does not prove that all data channels are being meaningfully recorded; the annual performance test and source-specific monitoring are required.

Power/UPS, capsule/beacon, microphones,.en: Monitor the power/UPS, capsule/beacon, microphones, input-channel faults and the recording status.

Incident/near miss sonrası overwrite sür.en: After an incident/near miss, apply the maker/SMS save/preserve action without waiting for the overwrite period.

Annual performance test report ve channe.en: Compare the annual performance test report and the channel list with the sensors/displays actually installed.

Approved playback/check ile time sync, a.en: Verify with an approved playback/check that the time sync, audio and selected channels are usable; do not alter the data.

Recording/input fault'ta Master ve compa.en: On a recording/input fault, inform the Master and the company and set up a defect/repair plan; do not report as if normal navigation data were available.

Kaza sonrası capsule/data'ya yetkisiz er.en: After an accident, do not access, delete or export the capsule/data without authorisation; preserve the chain of evidence.

VDR carriage ve revised performance stan.en: VDR carriage and revised performance standards; VDR/S-VDR applies according to the ship and its date of construction

Filika/davit testleri yüksek risklidir;.en: Lifeboat/davit tests are high-risk; release gear and overload/dynamic tests are carried out only within the limits of SOLAS III/20, MSC.402(96), the maker and an authorised service provider.

Hull/door, drain plug, equipment, engine.en: Carry out planned checks of the hull/doors, drain plug, equipment, engine/fuel, battery, steering, falls, brake, limit switches and release indicators.

Launch/recovery'de ship motion, water ar.en: During launching/recovery, monitor the ship's motion, the water area, communications, hooks and the winch/fall load under a dedicated person in charge.

Checklist/LSA plan ile inventory ve secu.en: Physically compare the inventory and securing with the checklist/LSA plan; carry out the engine test within the cooling/maker restrictions.

Annual/5-year service ve release gear re.en: Verify the annual/5-year service and release gear records with the authorised provider/Administration acceptance.

Unclear hook status, damaged fall/brake,.en: Stop launching/recovery on an unclear hook status, a damaged fall/brake, a person in the danger zone or loss of communication.

Safety pin/interlock bypass veya yetkisi.en: Do not allow a safety pin/interlock bypass or an unauthorised on-load release test.

HRU raft'ı şişirmez; container'ı gemiden.en: The HRU does not inflate the raft; it releases the container from the ship. Without the painter's weak link/ship connection and correct lashing, the float-free sequence does not work.

Container/cradle, lashing, HRU orientati.en: Check the container/cradle, lashing, HRU orientation/expiry, weak link, painter connection and the launching path.

Embarkation ladder/MES/lighting ve assig.en: Keep the embarkation ladder/MES/lighting and the assigned capacity/location consistent with the muster plan.

Label serial/capacity/service date ve ce.en: Compare the label serial number/capacity/service date and the certificate with the physical raft.

Securing arrangement'ı maker installatio.en: Verify the securing arrangement with the maker's installation drawing; do not open the raft for testing.

Yanlış painter/weak-link bağlantısı, exp.en: Do not treat the raft as serviceable with an incorrect painter/weak-link connection, expired service/HRU or an obstructed float-free path.

Container'ı gemiye doğrudan zincir/halat.en: Do not tie the container directly to the ship with an extra chain/rope and defeat the HRU function.

Rescue boat, lifeboat ve FRB şartları ay.en: Rescue boat, lifeboat and FRB requirements are not the same; crew competence, PPE, the painter, release and davit working load/motion limits are ship-specific.

Engine/fuel/battery, steering, communica.en: Check the engine/fuel/battery, steering, communications, recovery strop, hooks, davit/brake and boat equipment.

Launch/recovery'de ship speed/lee, sea s.en: During launching/recovery, a dedicated boat commander monitors the ship's speed/lee, sea state, propeller hazard, hook load and crew condition.

Pre-use function ve equipment inventory'.en: Physically verify the pre-use function and equipment inventory with the checklist/LSA plan.

Davit/release annual ve 5-year service r.en: Compare the davit/release annual and 5-year service records with the authorised provider's requirements.

Hook/fall/brake uncertainty, engine/stee.en: Stop the operation on hook/fall/brake uncertainty, engine/steering failure, a person in the fall zone or lost communication.

FRB'yi training/launch limitleri dışında.en: Do not put the FRB at risk outside the training/launch limits solely to achieve speed; the Master decides the SAR plan.

H: Baş yüksekliği, su hattından güvertey.en: H: Effective height from the summer load waterline to the top of the uppermost house (m)

A: Rüzgâra maruz yanal alan (m²).en: A: Lateral area exposed to the wind (m²)

18 000 ton deplasmanı, 28 m genişliği, 1.en: Calculate the Equipment Number of a ship with a displacement of 18,000 tonnes, a breadth of 28 m, an effective height (h) of 14 m and a lateral area of 3,200 m².

Elektrik veya hidrolik motor, redüktör ü.en: An electric or hydraulic motor turns the cable lifter (wildcat) through a reduction gear.

Wildcat dişleri zincir baklalarına geçer.en: The wildcat teeth engage the chain links to let go/heave up the anchor.

Bant freni (band brake) ve disk fren, mo.en: The band brake and disc brake hold the load when the motor stops.

Kavrama (clutch) wildcat'i şafttan ayıra.en: The clutch disengages the wildcat from the shaft so that the anchor can be let go by gravity.

Hidrolik tipte yön valfi yağ akışını yön.en: On hydraulic types, a directional valve directs the oil flow to set the direction and speed of rotation.

Çalıştırmadan önce lokal kumandayı, yağ.en: Before starting, check the local control, oil levels and brake condition.

Hidrolik sistemi devreye al, basınç yüks.en: Start the hydraulic system and wait until the pressure builds up.

Frenleri aç, kavramayı bağla; köprüden v.en: Release the brakes, engage the clutch; give the command from the bridge or the local panel.
