Funda sırasında her şak (shackle) geçişi.en: When letting go, slow down as each shackle passes; when heaving up, watch the ammeter.

İşlem bitince kavramayı boşa al, bant fr.en: When finished, disengage the clutch, apply the band brake, switch off and fit the safety lock.

Elektrik beslemesi yok / hidrolik basınç.en: No electrical supply / low hydraulic pressure / brake seized

Şalter ve sigortayı kontrol et, pompa ba.en: Check the switch and fuses, measure the pump pressure, release the brake.

İşlemi durdur, soğut, yağ seviyesini ve.en: Stop the operation, let it cool, check the oil level and bearings.

Zincir kaymalı funda yapıyor.en: Chain slips and runs out through the brake

Bant fren balatası aşınmış veya yağlı.en: Band brake lining worn or oily

Funda durdur, freni temizle/balata değiş.en: Stop the chain running out, clean the brake/replace the lining, test in dry weather.

Sistem basıncını boşalt, hortum/keçe değ.en: Release the system pressure, replace the hose/seal, top up the oil.

Diş aşıntısı veya yanlış zincir kalibres.en: Worn teeth or wrong chain size

İşlemi durdur, wildcat ve zincir kalibre.en: Stop the operation, check the wildcat and the chain size, replace if necessary.

Çalışma alanında baret, eldiven, çelik b.en: Wear a hard hat, gloves, safety boots and goggles in the working area.

Funda sırasında zincir uçuşma alanına ki.en: No one may enter the area where the chain can whip while letting go; the bow stopper must be ready and applied once the anchor has brought up.

Bakım öncesi enerji izolasyonu (LOTO) ya.en: Before maintenance, isolate the energy (LOTO) and release the hydraulic pressure.

Baca gazı sıcaklık sensörüyle izlenir; d.en: The flue gas is monitored by a temperature sensor; if it falls, the unit shuts down automatically.

Sludge tankı seviyesini, yakıt tankını v.en: Check the sludge tank level, the fuel tank and the air fan.

Burner ile maker start sequence'ini tama.en: Complete the maker's start sequence with the burner; start the sludge/solid feed only at the chamber temperature permitted by the type approval and the interlock.

Chamber/combustion-gas sıcaklığını type-.en: Keep the chamber/combustion gas temperature within the type-approved operating band; do not accept over-dosing or visible smoke as normal.

Çalışma sonunda dosingi kes, brulor ile.en: At the end of operation, stop the dosing and cool/purge the chamber with the burner on clean fuel.

Garbage Record Book'a tür, hacim, başlan.en: Enter the type, volume and start/finish times in the Garbage Record Book.

Yakıt yok, ignition elektrot kirli, foto.en: No fuel, ignition electrode dirty, photocell faulty

Yakıt valfini aç, elektrotları temizle,.en: Open the fuel valve, clean the electrodes, check the photocell.

Hava yetersiz, atomizer tıkalı, sludge ç.en: Insufficient air, atomiser blocked, sludge too viscous

Hava fanı debisi artır, atomizer söküm t.en: Increase the air fan flow, dismantle and clean the atomiser, check the sludge preheating.

Refrakter hasarı, fazla sludge dosingi,.en: Refractory damage, too much sludge dosing, low-calorie fuel

Refrakter inspeksiyon, dosing kıs, yakıt.en: Inspect the refractory, reduce the dosing, do not mix the fuel with dirty sludge.

Switch ve conta değişimi, kilit test..en: Replace the switch and seal; test the lock.

Çalışırken charge door kesinlikle açılma.en: The charging door must never be opened during operation; risk of flashback.

Plastik veya PVC içeren atık dioxin/fura.en: Waste containing plastic or PVC produces dioxins/furans, which are harmful to health and the environment.

Refrakteri termal şoktan korumak için ma.en: Complete the maker's controlled cool-down/purge time to protect the refractory from thermal shock; a fixed 4 hours is not valid for all models.

Stack çıkışı çevresinde personel olmamal.en: No personnel may be near the stack outlet; in cold weather invisible hot gas is a danger.

Sintine pompası yağlı suyu separatöre be.en: The bilge pump feeds oily water to the separator; in the first chamber free oil rises to the top and is collected in the oil tank.

Su, koalesan filtre elemanından geçer; m.en: The water passes through the coalescing filter element; micron droplets combine and rise to the surface.

Çıkış suyu OCM'den geçer; numune sürekli.en: The outlet water passes through the OCM; the sample is measured continuously and the data are logged.

≥15 ppm okumada 3-yollu solenoid valf ot.en: At a reading of ≥15 ppm, the 3-way solenoid valve automatically diverts the outlet back to the bilge tank and gives an alarm.

Çalıştırmadan önce sealing water hattını.en: Before starting, open the sealing water line (required on some models).

Pompa başlat, ilk birkaç dakika resirkül.en: Start the pump; prime the OCM in recirculation mode for the first few minutes.

Deşarj koşulları checklist ile doğruland.en: After the discharge conditions have been verified with the checklist and the responsible officer has given permission, select overboard in the maker's sequence; monitor the OCM value, sample flow and the function of the automatic stopping device.

ORB Code'a uygun operasyon kodu, start/s.en: Have the responsible officer record without delay the operation code under the ORB Code, start/stop times, position, quantity and method; apply the Master's check/signature arrangement.

Bitirince hatları temiz su ile flush et,.en: When finished, flush the lines with clean water and keep the OCM sensor clean.

OCM sensörü kirli, koalesan element doym.en: OCM sensor dirty, coalescing element saturated

OCM cell temizliği, koalesan element değ.en: Clean the OCM cell; replace the coalescing element.

Sintine kuyusu boş, hava emiyor.en: Bilge well empty, pump drawing air

Suction kontrol, hava al, valfleri kontr.en: Check the suction, vent, check the valves.

Sludge tankına transfer et, ORB'a yaz..en: Transfer to the sludge tank and record in the ORB.

Üretici prosedürüne göre temiz su ile ze.en: Carry out zero and span calibration with clean water according to the manufacturer's procedure.

OCM mührü (seal) PSC inspeksiyonunda kon.en: The OCM seal is checked in PSC inspections; the seal must not be broken.

Bypass hattı veya sahte OCM bağlantısı k.en: A bypass line or false OCM connection must never be made; it carries heavy fines and prison sentences.

Numune hattı sürekli akışlı olmalı; tıka.en: The sample line must have a continuous flow; a blockage does not raise an alarm but gives a false low reading.

Slop tankı transferi shore reception fac.en: When the slop tank contents are delivered to a shore reception facility, the receipt is attached to the ORB.

Aerobik tankta blower hava verir; aktif.en: In the aerobic tank, a blower supplies air; bacteria in the activated sludge convert organic matter into CO₂ and H₂O.

Settling tankında çamur çöker; dipte bir.en: Sludge settles in the settling tank; the sludge collected at the bottom is recirculated to the aerobic tank.

Üst sıvı kontak tankında klor (kalsiyum.en: The clear liquid is disinfected with chlorine (calcium hypochlorite tablets or electrolytic) in the contact tank.

Discharge pompası işlenmiş su tankından.en: The discharge pump pumps from the treated water tank overboard; a level switch provides automatic control.

Biyolojik proseste blower duty/standby v.en: In the biological process, maintain the blower duty/standby and operating cycle according to the maker's manual; after a long loss of air, analyse the health of the biomass and carry out a controlled recovery.

Dezenfeksiyon tipine göre dozaj/elektrol.en: According to the type of disinfection, check the dosing/electrolysis, residual and consumables against the maker's manual and the discharge standard.

Discharge pompasını ancak Annex IV, spec.en: Start the discharge pump only after the conditions of Annex IV, any special-area/port rules and the ship's Sewage Management Plan have been verified.

Haftalık olarak çamur seviyesini ölç; ge.en: Measure the sludge level weekly; if necessary, transfer the excess sludge to the sludge tank.

Blower yetersiz, aşırı yükleme, deterjan.en: Insufficient blower air, overloading, too much detergent

Hava debisini artır, mutfak greywater'ı.en: Increase the air flow, bypass the galley grey water, add a micro-organism culture.

Klor tabletini doldur, settling'i temizl.en: Refill the chlorine tablets, clean the settling tank, re-seed the system.

Level switch arızalı, impeller tıkalı (p.en: Level switch faulty, impeller blocked (napkins, etc.)

Switch test, pompa söküm temizlik..en: Test the switch; dismantle and clean the pump.

Filtre değiştir, kayış gerginlik kontrol.en: Replace the filter; check the belt tension.

STP girişine wet wipe, peçete, bez atılm.en: Wet wipes, napkins or rags must not be put into the STP inlet; they block the pumps and nozzles.

Klor/dezenfektan ile çalışırken SDS'de b.en: When working with chlorine/disinfectant, use the chemical PPE, ventilation and emergency response arrangements specified in the SDS; an unsuitable mixture with acid can release toxic gas.

Sistem 24+ saat durduğunda bakteri kültü.en: When the system is stopped for 24+ hours, the bacterial culture may die; re-seeding may be needed when restarting.

Holding tank kapasitesi POB, üretim debi.en: The holding tank capacity is calculated from the POB, the production rate, route/port restrictions and the reception plan; the remaining holding time is monitored at the watch handover with the high-level alarm.

Sıcak akışkan (yağ, ceket suyu, hava) bi.en: The hot fluid (oil, jacket water, air) flows on one side and the cooling fluid (seawater or LT fresh water) on the other side in the opposite direction (counter-flow).

İnce ayırıcı yüzey (plaka/boru) üzerinde.en: Heat passes from hot to cold by conduction through the thin separating surface (plate/tube).

Termostatik/üç-yollu valf çıkış sıcaklığ.en: The thermostatic/three-way valve adjusts the coolant flow by monitoring the outlet temperature.

Central sistemde SW yalnızca central coo.en: In a central system, SW cools only the central cooler; the internal circuit runs on clean FW.

Devreye almadan önce hava kilidini gider.en: Before putting it into service, remove air locks (vent); start the SW and FW pumps.

Giriş/çıkış sıcaklık ve basınç farkını (.en: Note the inlet/outlet temperatures and the pressure difference (ΔP); an increase in ΔP is a sign of fouling.

Termostatik valfin set sıcaklığını (ör..en: Check the set temperature of the thermostatic valve (e.g. jacket water ~80–85 °C).

Deniz suyu strainer'ını düzenli temizle;.en: Clean the seawater strainer regularly; if the SW flow falls, the outlet temperature rises.

Plakalı cooler'ı periyodik aç, plakaları.en: Open the plate cooler periodically, clean the plates with chemicals (acid) and check the gaskets.

Plaka/boru kirli (fouling), SW debisi dü.en: Plates/tubes fouled, low SW flow, air lock

Cooler temizliği, SW strainer temizliği,.en: Clean the cooler, clean the SW strainer, vent.

Plaka çatlağı, gasket bozuk, boru delinm.en: Cracked plate, defective gasket, perforated tube

Basınç testi, hasarlı plaka/boru değişim.en: Pressure test, replace damaged plates/tubes, renew gaskets.

Nitrit seviyesini test et ve dozla, hava.en: Test the nitrite level and dose; eliminate the air ingress.

Kimyasal temizlikte (asit) uygun PPE kul.en: Use suitable PPE for chemical (acid) cleaning and rinse thoroughly after neutralisation.

Plakalı cooler'ı sökerken plaka sırasını.en: When dismantling a plate cooler, mark the order and direction of the plates; a wrong arrangement causes leaks.

Basınçlıyken flanş/cıvata gevşetilmez; ö.en: Flanges/bolts must not be loosened while under pressure; first isolate and release the pressure.

Deniz suyu tarafı galvanik korozyon için.en: On the seawater side, the condition of anodes/coatings must be checked against galvanic corrosion.

Kompresör soğutucu gazı sıkıştırır → kon.en: The compressor compresses the refrigerant gas → the condenser liquefies it with seawater (liquid) → liquid receiver → expansion valve (pressure drops) → evaporator (cools the room air, becomes gas) → compressor.

Termostat oda sıcaklığını okur; set nokt.en: The thermostat reads the room temperature; when the set point is reached it closes the solenoid valve and the compressor pumps down.

Defrost timer/sensör tetiklendiğinde sıc.en: When the defrost timer/sensor triggers, hot gas or an electric heater is directed to the evaporator.

Sefere çıkmadan kumanya yüklendiğinde tü.en: When provisions are loaded before the voyage, all rooms are brought down to the set temperature.

Sıcaklık ve alarm kayıtlarını Food Safet.en: Keep temperature and alarm records as required by the Food Safety Management Plan/MLC, the company procedure and the cargo/provisions; do not generalise that 'HACCP is mandatory in the same form on every ship'.

Evaporator coil'inde aşırı buz birikimi.en: If there is excessive ice build-up on the evaporator coil, defrost is started manually.

Refrigerant level (sight glass) ve oil l.en: The refrigerant level (sight glass) and the oil level (compressor) are checked.

Condenser sea-water strainer'ını differe.en: Clean the condenser seawater strainer according to the differential pressure, the flow/temperature trend and the PMS; do not use a fixed weekly interval in place of evidence of fouling.

Gaz kaçağı, evaporator buzlu, solenoid v.en: Gas leak, evaporator iced up, solenoid valve closed

LP switch ayarsız, gaz az, sıvı geri dön.en: LP switch out of adjustment, low gas charge, liquid return

Switch ayar, gaz şarj, ekspansiyon valf.en: Adjust the switch, charge gas, service the expansion valve.

Conta değişim, defrost frekansı artır..en: Replace the seal; increase the defrost frequency.

SW pompa, strainer, kondenser temizlik..en: Check the SW pump, strainer; clean the condenser.

Soğuk depoya tek başına girilmez; içerid.en: Never enter a cold store alone; risk of being trapped inside (panic alarm + radio).

Defrost sırasında üretilen sıvı drain ha.en: The drain line for the liquid produced during defrost must not be blocked (freezing/leakage).

Refrigerant kaçağı boğulma, toksisite ve.en: A refrigerant leak can create a risk of asphyxiation, toxicity or flammability; the need for a fixed detector is verified from the refrigerant class/charge, the space and the class/flag risk assessment, and portable measurement and ventilation are kept ready.

Kompresör çalışırken suction valf kapatı.en: The suction valve must not be closed while the compressor is running (liquid compression = breakage).

Ana bara gerilimi kaybolur; düşük gerili.en: Voltage on the main busbar is lost; the undervoltage relay sends a start signal to the emergency generator.

Marş kaynağı (akü/hidrolik/hava) ana güç.en: The starting source (battery/hydraulic/air) starts the set independently of main power.

Set nominal gerilim ve frekansa ulaşınca.en: When the set reaches nominal voltage and frequency, the emergency busbar breaker closes and the interconnector remains open.

Geçici güç kaynağı, jeneratör yüke alına.en: The transitional source of power supplies the emergency lighting and communications until the generator takes the load.

Ana güç geri geldiğinde düzen prosedüre.en: When main power is restored, the arrangement returns to normal supply in accordance with the procedure and the set is put back into automatic mode.

Testten önce yakıt seviyesi, yağ, soğutm.en: Before the test, check the fuel level, oil, cooling water, battery voltage, block heater and ventilation of the space.

Seti SMS/PMS sıklığında çalıştır; mümkün.en: Run the set at the SMS/PMS frequency; where possible, verify both the automatic start sequence and supply under load.

Acil switchboard üzerindeki tüketici bre.en: Confirm that the consumer breakers on the emergency switchboard and the interconnector are in the positions stated in the procedure.

Test sonrası seti soğut, yakıtı tamamla.en: After the test, cool the set down, top up the fuel and put it in automatic mode; record the result.

Yıl içinde en az bir kez, planlı ve izin.en: At least once a year, practise a blackout scenario under planned and authorised conditions according to the company procedure.

Akü zayıf/şarj arızası, start rölesi vey.en: Weak battery/charger fault, start relay or undervoltage sensor fault, fuel valve closed

Akü gerilimini yük altında ölç, manuel s.en: Measure the battery voltage under load, distinguish the fault with a manual start, trace the fuel line and the sensor circuit.

AVR arızası, breaker kapanma mantığı vey.en: AVR fault, breaker closing logic or overload

Gerilim/frekansı ölç, breaker kapatma iz.en: Measure the voltage/frequency; check the breaker closing permissives and the consumer list.

Egzozdan yağlı duman, düşük yüklerde çal.en: Oily smoke from the exhaust, poor running at low load

Uzun süre yüksüz çalıştırma (wet stackin.en: Prolonged running at no load (wet stacking)

Gerçek yük veya yük bankasıyla periyodik.en: Apply periodic loading with real load or a load bank; check the injectors and the exhaust side.

Ana güç geldiğinde acil bara beslemesi g.en: Emergency busbar supply does not change back when main power returns

Interconnector arızası veya hatalı mod s.en: Interconnector fault or wrong mode selection

Transfer mantığını ve breaker konumların.en: Verify the transfer logic and breaker positions on the diagram.

Test sonrası set manuel modda kalmış.en: Set left in manual mode after the test

Prosedür sonrası mod konumunun kontrol e.en: Mode position not checked after the procedure

Mod konumunu tur kontrol listesine ekle.en: Add the mode position to the rounds checklist and confirm it at the handover.

Acil jeneratör mahalli depo olarak kulla.en: The emergency generator room must not be used as a store; access routes, doors and ventilation are kept clear.

Test sırasında ana bara ile paralelleme.en: During the test, paralleling with the main busbar is done only if the arrangement allows it and there is a written procedure.

Egzoz hattı, damper ve mahal havalandırm.en: The exhaust line, dampers and room ventilation are checked before the test; running with a closed damper creates a risk of CO and overheating.

Akü mahallinde hidrojen birikimine karşı.en: Ventilation is provided in the battery room against the build-up of hydrogen, and sources of sparks are kept away.

Devir %10 düşerse N = 810 dev/dak.en: If the speed falls by 10%, N = 810 rpm

Ana makine şaftı, dişli kutusu veya doğr.en: The main engine shaft drives the electrical machine through a gearbox or a direct coupling.

PTO modunda makine senkron jeneratör gib.en: In PTO mode the machine works as a synchronous generator; the voltage is maintained by the AVR and the frequency by constant speed or a converter.

PTI/PTH modunda aynı makine şebekeden be.en: In PTI/PTH mode the same machine is supplied from the network and works as a motor, delivering torque to the shaft.

PMS, yük durumuna göre şaft jeneratörü i.en: The PMS manages load sharing and changeover between the shaft generator and the auxiliary diesel generators according to the load.

Devreye almadan önce şaft devri, ana mak.en: Before putting it on line, verify that the shaft speed, main engine load and propeller mode (CPP pitch) are suitable.

Senkronizasyon koşullarını (gerilim, fre.en: Meet the synchronising conditions (voltage, frequency, phase sequence, phase angle) and connect to the busbar.

Yük transferini kademeli yap; yardımcı j.en: Transfer the load gradually; before taking the auxiliary generator off line, see that the shaft generator carries the load steadily.

Manevra öncesi yardımcı jeneratörü devre.en: Before manoeuvring, put the auxiliary generator on line and take the shaft generator off line in accordance with the procedure.

Konvertör soğutması, harmonik filtre ve.en: Check the converter cooling, harmonic filter and fan/filter condition periodically.

Şaft devri değişimi, CPP hatve kontrolü.en: Change in shaft speed, CPP pitch control or converter regulation fault

Devir ve hatve geri beslemesini kontrol.en: Check the speed and pitch feedback, review the converter alarm log, change over to the auxiliary generator if necessary.

Mod seçimlerini ve kW/kVAr tepkisini jen.en: Compare the mode selections and the kW/kVAr response generator by generator.

Ana makine yavaşladığında güç kaybı.en: Loss of power when the main engine slows down

Düşük devirde şaft jeneratörü kapasitesi.en: Reduced shaft generator capacity at low speed

Seyir safhasına göre stand-by jeneratörü.en: Put the standby generator on line in advance according to the phase of the voyage.

Fan/filtre tıkanıklığı, soğutma suyu sor.en: Fan/filter blockage, cooling water problem, overload

Yükü azalt, soğutma ve filtre durumunu k.en: Reduce the load, check the cooling and filter condition, observe the manufacturer's limits.

PTH modunda beklenen hız sağlanamıyor.en: Expected speed not reached in PTH mode

Sınırlı güç, hatve/ayar hatası veya bata.en: Limited power, pitch/setting error or battery capacity

Düzenin tasarım gücünü ve süresini doğru.en: Verify the design power and duration of the arrangement; revise the passage plan accordingly.

Şaft jeneratörü devredeyken ana makine y.en: If the main engine load and speed are to be changed while the shaft generator is on line, the electrical load is managed in advance.

Konvertör ve alternatör mahallinde yükse.en: High-voltage warnings and the lock-out (LOTO) procedure are applied in the converter and alternator spaces.

Harmonik bozulma hassas elektronik cihaz.en: Harmonic distortion can affect sensitive electronic equipment; measurements and filter maintenance are not neglected.

PTH düzeninin kapasitesi ve çalışma süre.en: The emergency plan is not based on the PTH arrangement without knowing its capacity and operating time.

Elektrik veya hidrolik motor, dişli kutu.en: An electric or hydraulic motor turns the propeller inside the tunnel through a gearbox.

Kuvvetin yönü ve şiddeti, CPP düzeninde.en: The direction and magnitude of the thrust are set by the pitch angle in a CPP arrangement, and by the direction and speed of rotation through a converter in an FPP arrangement.

Köprüüstü kumandası, hatve/devir talebin.en: The bridge control sends the pitch/speed demand to the local control unit; the feedback indicator shows the actual pitch.

Yağ sistemi dişli kutusunu ve sızdırmazl.en: The oil system supplies the gearbox and the seals; the pressure and level are monitored.

Manevradan önce ilave jeneratörü devreye.en: Before manoeuvring, put an additional generator on line, report the thruster ready to the bridge and verify the transfer of control.

İticiyi kademeli yükle; sürekli tam güçt.en: Load the thruster gradually; prolonged continuous use at full power pushes the motor and converter temperature limits.

Hatve göstergesi ile gerçek kuvvet tepki.en: Compare the pitch indicator with the actual thrust response; if load is drawn at zero pitch, the feedback or the mechanism is faulty.

Manevra bitiminde iticiyi durdur, hatvey.en: At the end of manoeuvring, stop the thruster, set the pitch to zero and cut off the electrical supply according to the procedure.

Yağ seviyesi, sıcaklık, titreşim ve moto.en: Record the oil level, temperature, vibration and motor winding temperature.

Tünel ızgarası kirli, hatve geri besleme.en: Tunnel grating fouled, wrong pitch feedback, damaged propeller

Izgara ve pervane durumunu dalgıç/havuzl.en: Check the grating and propeller by diver/dry-docking; verify the pitch calibration.

Yol verirken bara frekansı düşüyor / bla.en: Busbar frequency drops on starting / risk of blackout

Yetersiz jeneratör kapasitesi, ani yük a.en: Insufficient generator capacity, sudden load increase

İlave jeneratörü devreye al, yol verme r.en: Put an additional generator on line; review the start ramp and PMS settings.

Kavitasyon, yabancı cisim, kanat hasarı.en: Cavitation, a foreign object, blade damage or bearing wear

Yükü azalt, titreşim ölçümü al, ilk fırs.en: Reduce the load, take a vibration measurement and plan a diver inspection at the first opportunity.

Kullanımı sınırla, seviye trendini kayde.en: Limit its use, record the level trend, report the pollution risk and plan a repair.

Uzun süreli tam yük, soğutma veya filtre.en: Prolonged full load, cooling or filter problem

Yükü düşür, soğutma ve havalandırmayı ko.en: Reduce the load, check the cooling and ventilation, keep within the manufacturer's operating time limit.

Tünel bölgesinde dalgıç çalışması varsa.en: If divers are working in the tunnel area, the thruster is electrically isolated and locked out (LOTO).

İtici mahalline giriş öncesi mahal haval.en: Before entering the thruster room, the ventilation of the space and enclosed-space risks are assessed.

Aşırı ısınmayı önlemek için üreticinin s.en: To prevent overheating, the manufacturer's continuous operating time and restart limits are observed.

Yağ kaçağı şüphesinde kirlilik bildirim.en: If an oil leak is suspected, the obligation to report pollution is assessed together with the Master.

LT devresinde 200 m³/h debi dolaşıyor ve.en: A flow of 200 m³/h circulates in the LT circuit, and the difference between the inlet and outlet of the central cooler is measured as 5 K. Calculate the heat transferred.

Deniz suyu pompası, sandıktan aldığı suy.en: The seawater pump draws water from the sea chest and pumps it through the strainer to the central cooler.

LT devresi ekipman soğutucularından geçe.en: The LT circuit collects heat as it passes through the equipment coolers and transfers it to seawater in the central cooler.

HT devresi ana makine gömleklerini soğut.en: The HT circuit cools the main engine jackets; the temperature is kept constant with a three-way thermostatic valve, and excess heat is given to the LT circuit or the fresh water generator.

Genleşme tankı devrenin havasını atar, ı.en: The expansion tank vents the circuit, takes up thermal expansion and serves as the filling point.

Vardiyada deniz suyu süzgeç fark basıncı.en: On watch, check the seawater strainer differential pressure, the pump pressures and that the standby pump is in automatic.

HT/LT giriş-çıkış sıcaklıklarını yükle b.en: Trend the HT/LT inlet and outlet temperatures together with the load; a rising difference at the same load indicates fouling.

Genleşme tankı seviyesini her turda kayd.en: Record the expansion tank level on every round; if it changes suddenly, check for leaks and internal leakage.

Sığ ve çamurlu sularda uygun deniz sandı.en: In shallow and muddy waters, change over to the suitable sea chest; if necessary, use the blowing line according to the procedure.

Kimyasal ölçümleri planlı aralıkta yap,.en: Carry out chemical tests at the planned intervals; record the dosing and the results.

Süzgeç/soğutucu kirli, pompa performansı.en: Strainer/cooler fouled, low pump performance, air in the circuit

Fark basıncını ölç, stand-by pompaya geç.en: Measure the differential pressure, change over to the standby pump, vent, plan cleaning.

Sandık tıkanması, sığ suda hava emme.en: Sea chest blocked, drawing air in shallow water

Diğer sandığa geç, süzgeci temizle, gere.en: Change over to the other sea chest, clean the strainer, blow through if necessary.

Devreyi bölüm bölüm izle, basınç testi p.en: Trace the circuit section by section, plan a pressure test, record the quantity topped up.

Genleşme tankında yağ veya gaz izi.en: Traces of oil or gas in the expansion tank

Yağ soğutucusundan iç geçiş veya gömlek/.en: Internal leakage from the oil cooler or a liner/seal problem

İlgili eşanjörü izole ederek ayrım yap,.en: Identify the source by isolating the exchanger concerned, carry out a gas test and inform the Chief Engineer.

Termostatik valf açık kalmış veya sensör.en: Thermostatic valve stuck open or sensor fault

Valf hareketini yerel olarak dene, sensö.en: Test the valve movement locally, verify the sensor, report the risk of cold corrosion.

Deniz suyu hattında bakım öncesi sandık.en: Before maintenance on a seawater line, the sea chest valve is closed, the line drained and tagging/lock-out applied.

Tank valfi sızdırıyor, P/V valve açık ka.en: Tank valve leaking, P/V valve stuck open

Valfleri kontrol, P/V'yi test et..en: Check the valves; test the P/V valve.

Tank atmosferine giriş öncesi mutlaka ga.en: Before entering a tank atmosphere, gas-freeing and an O₂ measurement are always required.

IGS kapalıyken kargo discharge yasaktır..en: Discharging cargo while the IGS is off is prohibited.

Scrubber'da yıkama suyu sürekli akmalı,.en: Wash water must flow continuously in the scrubber; otherwise overheating and corrosion occur.

Sistem üzerinde her zaman iki bağımsız n.en: There must always be two independent non-return barriers in the system.

Duman dedektöründe optik oda; partikül g.en: In a smoke detector's optical chamber, light is scattered when particles enter and the photocell signal increases.

Sabit sıcaklık dedektöründe bimetal/eute.en: In a fixed-temperature detector, a bimetal/eutectic element closes the circuit at the threshold temperature.

Sinyal merkezi panel tarafından bölgeye.en: The signal is matched to its zone by the central panel, and a visual + audible alarm is given.

Panel lamp, fault, isolator ve zone/loop.en: Carry out panel lamp, fault, isolator and zone/loop tests with the Fire Safety Operational Booklet at the PMS frequency.

Dedektörleri onaylı test gazı/ısı/alev s.en: Function-test the detectors with an approved test gas/heat/flame simulator according to the maker's and the MSC.1/Circ.1432 maintenance plan.

Dedektör temizleme/değişim aralığını çev.en: Plan the detector cleaning/replacement interval according to environmental contamination, self-monitoring, the maker's limit and the test trend.

Yanlış alarm sonrası bölge önce silinir,.en: After a false alarm, the zone is first silenced, then reset.

Dedektörü temizle, gerekirse değiştir..en: Clean the detector; replace it if necessary.

Hattı ölç, terminasyonu kontrol et..en: Measure the line; check the terminations.

Aküyü değiştir, şarj devresini test et..en: Replace the battery; test the charging circuit.

Dedektör altında 50 cm açık koni olmalı,.en: There must be a clear cone of 50 cm under the detector; no objects may be placed there.

Boya/dekorasyon sırasında dedektörler sö.en: During painting/decoration, detectors must not be removed or covered.

Test sırasında köprüüstüne ve makine kon.en: The bridge and the engine control room must be informed before a test.

Yıllık sertifika ve test raporları gemi.en: Annual certificates and test reports must be kept in the ship's records.

Su: soğutma ile söndürür (yangın üçgenin.en: Water: extinguishes by cooling (removes the heat from the fire triangle).

Köpük: yakıt yüzeyini örter, oksijeni ke.en: Foam: blankets the fuel surface and cuts off the oxygen.

CO₂: oksijeni seyreltir, soğutur (-78 °C.en: CO₂: dilutes the oxygen and cools (−78 °C).

Kuru kimyasal: yanma reaksiyonunu kimyas.en: Dry chemical: interrupts the combustion reaction chemically (chain breaking).

P-A-S-S: Pin çek, Aim (alevin tabanına n.en: P-A-S-S: Pull the pin, Aim at the base of the flame, Squeeze the handle, Sweep from side to side.

Rüzgârı arkana al, alevin tabanına yönle.en: Keep the wind behind you; aim at the base of the flame.

Söndürdükten sonra geri çekil, yeniden a.en: After extinguishing, step back and watch for re-ignition.

Kullanılan veya boşalmış söndürücü hemen.en: A used or discharged extinguisher is replaced at once and its use is recorded.

Manometre kırmızı bölgede (basınç düşük).en: Pressure gauge in the red zone (low pressure)

Servise gönder, yeniden doldurt..en: Send it for servicing and have it refilled.

Hortumu değiştir, yıllık servis kontrolü.en: Replace the hose; mark it at the annual service check.

Söndürücüye yakın elektrik tablosu varsa.en: If there is an electrical panel near the extinguisher, CO₂/dry chemical must be chosen; water is prohibited.

CO₂ kapalı küçük hacimde kullanırsa boğu.en: Using CO₂ in a small enclosed space carries a risk of asphyxiation.

Kuru kimyasal sonrası elektronik ekipman.en: After dry chemical has been used, electronic equipment needs drying and cleaning.

Söndürücü kullanımı eğitimi SOLAS III/19.en: Training in the use of extinguishers is given under SOLAS III/19.4: to personnel joining the ship within two weeks at the latest, and covering all equipment within two-month periods.

Yüksek basınçlı tüp (200–300 bar) hava r.en: The high-pressure cylinder (200–300 bar) air is reduced to medium pressure by the regulator.

Demand valf, kullanıcı nefes aldıkça mas.en: The demand valve supplies air to the mask as the user breathes in.

Low-pressure warning maker set değerinde.en: The low-pressure warning operates at the maker's set value; at entry control the team works out the pressure–time calculation and turn-around pressure and starts the return without waiting for the whistle.

Kullanım öncesi tüp basıncını sıcaklık d.en: Before use, check the cylinder pressure with a temperature correction against the maker's full-charge value; record that it is sufficient for the team's entry time/return reserve.

Maske sızdırmazlık testi: tüm girişi kap.en: Mask seal test: block the inlet completely and breathe in deeply — it must hold the vacuum.

Cihazı tak, ana valfi tam aç, demand val.en: Put on the set, open the main valve fully, connect the demand valve.

Görev sırasında basıncı izle; düdük çald.en: Monitor the pressure during the task; turn back when the whistle sounds.

Conta kontrol et, kompresörden yeniden d.en: Check the seal; refill from the compressor.

Servise gönder; yedek setle değiştir..en: Send it for servicing; replace with a spare set.

Doğru boy seç, contayı değiştir, sakal t.en: Choose the correct size, replace the seal, shave off the beard.

SCBA tüpünün hydrostatic test ve ömür li.en: Verify the hydrostatic test and service life limits of the SCBA cylinder from the cylinder standard, the manufacturer and the flag requirements; do not judge the certificate/marking by a fixed 5-year rule alone.

Hava kompresöründe CO/CO₂/yağ buharı fil.en: The CO/CO₂/oil vapour filters of the air compressor must be replaced periodically.

EEBD eğitimi yapılmadan kullanılmamalı;.en: An EEBD must not be used without training; the hood must provide eye protection.

Yangın takımı yerinde, mühürlü ve eksiks.en: The fireman's outfit must be kept in place, sealed and complete; the monthly check must be recorded.

QCV sapanı çekildiğinde önceden kurulmuş.en: When the QCV pull wire is pulled, the pre-set spring force closes the valve disc.

Pnömatik tipte ise kontrol valfi açılınc.en: On pneumatic types, the cylinder closes the QCV when the control valve is opened.

Fan stop kontağı motor kontaktörünü açar.en: The fan stop contact opens the motor contactor and the fan stops.

Yakıt servis pompası emergency stop kont.en: The emergency stop contact of the fuel service pump cuts the circuit through the protection relay.

Yangın doğrulanıp tahliye sağlandıktan s.en: After the fire has been confirmed and evacuation ensured: shut off the fuel (QCV) → stop the fans → stop the fuel pumps → release the CO₂.

Aylık testlerde her QCV ayrı ayrı kapatı.en: In the monthly tests, each QCV is closed, opened and greased individually.

Emergency stop butonları PSC denetiminde.en: The emergency stop buttons are function-tested in PSC inspections.

Test sonrası ilgili sistemlerin yeniden.en: After the test, it is entered in the log book that the systems concerned have been put back into service.

Yay korozyonu, kablo gevşek, hava basınc.en: Spring corroded, wire slack, no air pressure

Mekanik kontrol, yağla, hava şişesi bası.en: Check mechanically, lubricate, recharge the air bottle.

Kontaktörü test et, bobini değiştir..en: Test the contactor; replace the coil.

Valf revize edilmeli, gerekirse değiştir.en: The valve must be overhauled and replaced if necessary.

Tatbikat dışında QCV asla kapatılmamalı.en: A QCV must not be closed except in an emergency or during a planned test/drill (the main engine may stop).

Test öncesi köprüüstü ve makine kontrol.en: The bridge and engine control room must be informed before a test.

Re-set sonrası yakıt hattında havayı al,.en: After resetting, vent the fuel line and check for leaks.

Etiketleme net olmalı: hangi tank/pompa.en: Labelling must be clear: it must show which tank/pump is connected to which pull wire.

Santrifüj pompada impeller döner; merkez.en: In a centrifugal pump the impeller rotates; centrifugal force throws the liquid outwards into the volute and the discharge pressure is created.

Submerged pompada tank içi pompa motoru.en: In a submerged pump, the in-tank pump motor is driven by hydraulic oil; the liquid rises directly through the pump to the riser pipe.

Pozitif deplasmanlı stripping pompası he.en: A positive displacement stripping pump moves a fixed volume every revolution; it gives a low flow but a high vacuum.

Booster pompa ana pompanın discharge'ını.en: The booster pump takes the discharge of the main pump and pressurises it again.

Tank discharge planına göre suction valf.en: Open the suction valve according to the tank discharge plan; line up the manifold valve to the terminal.

Pump room'u ventile et, gas detection si.en: Ventilate the pump room; keep the gas detection system active.

Pompayı düşük rpm'de çalıştır, prime tam.en: Start the pump at low rpm; when priming is complete, increase the flow gradually.

Tank seviyesi ~%10'a düştüğünde strippin.en: When the tank level falls to ~10%, change over to the stripping pump; check with the vacuum-cleared lamp.

Hava emiyor, valf kapalı, impeller aşınm.en: Drawing air, valve closed, impeller worn

Suction line ve valfleri kontrol et, pri.en: Check the suction line and valves, prime, service the impeller.

Yatak yağı yetersiz, mekanik conta sızın.en: Insufficient bearing oil, mechanical seal leakage

Yağı kontrol et, mechanical seal değişti.en: Stop immediately, check the oil, replace the mechanical seal.

Sıvı seal sağla, conta değişimi yap..en: Provide a liquid seal; replace the seal.

Pump room'a girmeden önce O₂, LEL ve H₂S.en: Before entering the pump room, O₂, LEL and H₂S must be measured; SCBA must be used if necessary.

Statik biriktiren cargo ve boş tanka ilk.en: For static-accumulator cargoes and at the start of loading into an empty tank, a low line velocity is used until the inlet is covered; the exact velocity/height is taken from ISGOTT, the terminal and the cargo plan — 1 m/s is not applied blindly to every cargo.

Cargo ESD/remote stop istasyonlarının ye.en: The locations of the cargo ESD/remote stop stations and the equipment they affect are verified from the approved plan and the ship–shore checklist; the effect of an unwanted valve surge is assessed in advance.

Boşaltım sırasında trim ve heel sürekli.en: Trim and heel must be monitored continuously during discharge; the free surface moment must be taken into account.

Tank seviyesi belirli bir oranda boşaltı.en: After the tank has been discharged to a certain level, the COW pump is started.

Makine, tank içinde belirli açıda dönerk.en: As the machine rotates through set angles inside the tank, the jet of crude oil strikes the bulkheads and dissolves the sediment.

Çözünen tortu yükle birlikte stripping p.en: The dissolved sediment is transferred with the cargo by the stripping pump to the slop tank.

İkinci aşama (bottom wash) tank dibine o.en: The second stage (bottom wash) concentrates on the tank bottom; the ROB is minimised.

Top wash'i yalnız onaylı COW Manual'deki.en: Start the top wash only at the tank-specific ullage, machine pattern and point in the discharge sequence given in the approved COW Manual.

Bottom wash/stripping zamanını tank plan.en: Carry out the bottom wash/stripping timing according to the approved COW programme, with the tank plan, suction coverage and terminal discharge sequence.

Yıkama süresince hat basıncını ve makine.en: Monitor the line pressure and machine speed throughout the wash.

Yıkama sonrası tankı stripping ile boşal.en: After washing, strip the tank and keep it under pressure with the IGS.

Yıkama kayıtlarını COW Operations Manual.en: Enter the washing records in the COW Operations Manual and the Oil Record Book.

Pompa arızası, hat sızıntısı, makine tık.en: Pump failure, line leak, machine blocked

Pompa kontrol, hat sızıntı testi, makine.en: Check the pump, leak-test the line, dismantle and clean the machine.

Türbin kanadı tıkalı, hidrolik motor arı.en: Turbine blade blocked, hydraulic motor faulty

Makineyi sök, türbini temizle veya motor.en: Dismantle the machine; clean the turbine or replace the motor.

Tank O₂/IG basıncı limit dışı.en: Tank O₂/IG pressure outside the limits

IGS yetersiz, analizör/sampling hatası v.en: Insufficient IGS, analyser/sampling fault or tank leakage

COW'u derhal durdur; onaylı manual'deki.en: Stop COW immediately; re-establish the tank O₂ and supply O₂ limits, positive pressure and analyser accuracy given in the approved manual.

COW sırasında fixed/portable O₂ ölçümler.en: During COW, fixed/portable O₂ measurements are compared at the frequency in the approved manual; the stop criteria in the manual are applied before the tank approaches the 8% O₂ limit.

Yıkama makineleri için onaylı operasyone.en: The approved operational envelope for the washing machines must not be exceeded.

Statik şarj birikimini önlemek için yıka.en: The washing flow must be controlled to prevent the build-up of static charge.

Personel pump room'a girmeden önce H₂S ö.en: Personnel must measure H₂S before entering the pump room (especially with sour crude).

Radar gauge, tank tepesindeki anten 6–10.en: In a radar gauge, the antenna at the top of the tank transmits 6–10 GHz microwaves; the delay of the signal reflected from the liquid surface is converted into ullage.

Hidrostatik sensör tank dibindeki basınc.en: A hydrostatic sensor calculates the level by dividing the pressure at the bottom of the tank by the liquid density.

PT100 sıcaklık sensörü tankın 3 farklı y.en: PT100 temperature sensors give the average temperature at 3 different heights in the tank.

Sinyaller CCR (cargo control room) ekran.en: The signals are displayed graphically on the CCR (cargo control room) screen.

Yükleme/boşaltım öncesi radar gauge'ı ma.en: Before loading/discharging, cross-check the radar gauge with a manual UTI.

High level alarm test butonu ile çalışır.en: Verify that the high-level alarm works with its test button.

Ullage, sıcaklık ve trim'i CCR'da sürekl.en: Monitor the ullage, temperature and trim continuously in the CCR.

Inerted tank'a UTI sokmadan önce vapor l.en: Before inserting a UTI into an inerted tank, the vapour lock valve must be opened and static bonding ensured.

Anten kirli, vapor space yoğun buhar.en: Antenna dirty, dense vapour in the vapour space

Sensörü test et, hattı ölç, yedek devrey.en: Test the sensor, measure the line, bring the back-up into use.

Bağlantıyı sıkı, gerekirse PT100 değişti.en: Tighten the connection; replace the PT100 if necessary.

UTI manuel ölçümde statik bonding kablos.en: The static bonding cable must always be connected for manual UTI measurement.

Yükleme sırasında bağımsız overfill alar.en: The independent overfill alarm must be functional during loading.

Tank ullage planı ve sıcaklık logu shift.en: The tank ullage plan and temperature log must be kept for each shift.

Sensör kalibrasyon sertifikası periyodik.en: The sensor calibration certificate must be renewed periodically.

Hidrolik güç ünitesi (HPU), silindirleri.en: The hydraulic power unit (HPU) operates the cylinders and locking mechanisms.

Açma sırasında: kilitler açılır → kapak.en: When opening: the locks open → the cover rises → the cylinders fold the panel sideways/downwards.

Sızdırmazlık coaming çevresindeki rubber.en: Weathertightness is provided by the rubber gasket around the coaming; it is compressed as the cover closes.

Drainage channel sızan suyu over-board v.en: The drainage channel leads leaking water overboard or to the bilge.

Açmadan önce kapağın üstündeki yük ve bu.en: Before opening, any load and ice/snow on top of the cover must be removed.

HPU'yu çalıştır, basıncı set değere geti.en: Start the HPU and bring the pressure to the set value.

Kilitleri sırasıyla aç, kapak hareketi s.en: Open the locks in sequence; keep everyone clear while the cover is moving.

Kapatma sonrası gasket'in tam oturduğunu.en: After closing, check that the gasket is fully seated and tighten the locks.

Denize çıkmadan önce hose test ile sızdı.en: Verify weathertightness with a hose test before going to sea.

Coaming üzerinde tortu, hidrolik basınç.en: Debris on the coaming, low hydraulic pressure

Coaming temizle, HPU basıncı kontrol et..en: Clean the coaming; check the HPU pressure.

Gasket yenile, kompresyon bar düzelt..en: Renew the gasket; straighten the compression bar.

Sistemi havadan al, valf ve seal kontrol.en: Vent the system; check the valves and seals.

Açık kapak fırtınalı havada operasyon ya.en: Hatch covers must not be opened or operated in stormy weather.

Kapak üzerinde personel çalışacaksa kili.en: If personnel are to work on the cover, the locking safety (chock pin) must be fitted.

Periyodik gasket kontrolü ve hose/ultras.en: Records of periodic gasket checks and hose/ultrasonic tests must be kept.

Hatch cover load capacity stowage planın.en: The hatch cover load capacity must be taken into account in the stowage plan.

Twist-lock üst container'ın corner casti.en: The twistlock enters the corner casting of the upper container and locks when turned 90°.

Lashing rod'un alt ucu D-ring'e takılır,.en: The lower end of the lashing rod is attached to the D-ring and the upper end to the container corner; it is tightened with a turnbuckle.

Yükün eylemsizliği (acceleration × mass).en: The inertia of the cargo (acceleration × mass) must be less than the total MSL of the lashings.

CSM, geminin GM ve roll periyoduna göre.en: The CSM gives the lashing force calculation according to the ship's GM and roll period.

Yükleme öncesi tüm ekipman görsel kontro.en: All equipment is visually inspected before loading.

Stowage planına göre twist-lock'lar kont.en: Twistlocks are placed under the containers according to the stowage plan.

Container indirilip locked edildikten so.en: After the container has been landed and locked, the lashing rods are fitted.

Turnbuckle hand-tight + 1/2 tur ile sıkı.en: The turnbuckle is tightened hand-tight + 1/2 turn; slackness is checked daily at sea.

Heavy weather raporu sonrası lashing kon.en: After a heavy weather report, the lashing check is repeated.

Yedek twist-lock ile değiştir, arızalıyı.en: Replace with a spare twistlock; send the faulty one for servicing.

Locknut/wire ile emniyete al, periyodik.en: Secure with a locknut/wire; retighten periodically.

Lashing operasyonu sırasında baret, eldi.en: A hard hat, gloves and safety shoes are mandatory during lashing operations.

Yüksek seviyelere lashing eldiveni ile m.en: For the upper tiers, a mast climber/cherry picker must be used (with lashing gloves).

Aşırı sıkmaktan kaçın; turnbuckle thread.en: Avoid over-tightening; the turnbuckle thread will be damaged.

Heavy weather durumunda güverteye lashin.en: In heavy weather, going on deck to check lashings may be prohibited.

Plug bağlantısı yapıldığında container i.en: When the plug is connected, the PLC inside the container runs the compressor to bring the temperature to the set value.

Soğutucu gaz (R-134a, R-404A vb.) kompre.en: The refrigerant (R-134a, R-404A, etc.) is compressed in the compressor → condensed by outside air in the condenser → the pressure drops at the expansion valve → it cools the air inside the container in the evaporator.

Defrost cycle (otomatik) periyodik olara.en: The (automatic) defrost cycle periodically melts the ice on the evaporator.

RMS, alarmları gemi şebekesine ethernet/.en: The RMS transmits alarms to the ship's network via Ethernet/PLC.

Container'ı plug'a takmadan önce socket.en: Before plugging in the container, check the socket by measuring its voltage.

Set sıcaklık, vent ve hava değişim oranı.en: Set the temperature, vent and air exchange rate according to the manifest.

Günlük RMS kontrolü yap; alarm varsa yed.en: Check the RMS daily; if there is an alarm, connect to a spare socket.

Boşaltımdan önce sıcaklık logu çıktısını.en: Print out the temperature log before discharge.

Sigortayı reset et, kabloyu test et..en: Reset the fuse; test the cable.

Kondenseri temizle, gaz şarjını kontrol.en: Clean the condenser; check the gas charge.

Heater test, kontrol kartı kontrol..en: Test the heater; check the control board.

Toplam yük jeneratör kapasitesini aştı.en: Total load exceeded the generator capacity

Reefer'leri kademeli devreye al, PMS lim.en: Connect the reefers gradually; set the PMS limit.

Plug ve cable bağlantısı yapılırken eldi.en: Gloves and insulating footwear must be used when connecting plugs and cables.

IMDG sınıfı tehlikeli yük varsa reefer'l.en: If there are IMDG-class dangerous goods, the reefers must be distributed according to the segregation rules.

Yangın riski: reefer plug yangınları sık.en: Fire risk: reefer plug fires are common; the temperature of the fuse panels must be monitored.

RMS kayıtları konişmento (BL) için kanıt.en: RMS records are evidence for the bill of lading (B/L) and must be kept.

HPU hidrolik silindirleri besler; ramp m.en: The HPU supplies the hydraulic cylinders; the ramp opens on its hinges.

Locking pinler kapalı pozisyonda otomati.en: The locking pins lock automatically or manually in the closed position.

Weathertight gasket coaming üzerinde sız.en: The weathertight gasket on the coaming provides tightness.

Inclination ve closure switch sinyali br.en: The inclination and closure switch signals go to the bridge alarm system.

Açmadan önce trim/list kontrol et, ramp.en: Before opening, check the trim/list; the ramp end must land on the quay.

Kilitleri açıp HPU'yu devreye al; ramp'ı.en: Open the locks and start the HPU; lower the ramp slowly.

Yükleme sonrası ramp'ı kaldır, kilitle v.en: After loading, raise the ramp, lock it and check the tightness.

Closure indicator'ın 'closed' sinyali br.en: The 'closed' signal of the closure indicator must be shown on the bridge.

Denizde fırtınada ramp ekstra securing p.en: At sea in a storm, the ramp is secured with extra securing pins/wires.

HPU basıncı yok, kilit takılı, kontrol v.en: No HPU pressure, lock engaged, control valve faulty

HPU ve kilitleri kontrol et, valfi devre.en: Check the HPU and locks; try moving it manually with the valve bypassed.

Switch arızalı, kapak tam oturmamış.en: Switch faulty, door not fully seated

Switch test, kapak yeniden kapatma..en: Test the switch; close the door again.

Gasket yenile, kilit sık..en: Renew the gasket; tighten the locks.

Ramp altında personel/araç bulunduğunda.en: Movement is prohibited while there are persons/vehicles under the ramp.

Bow ramp/visor weathertight integrity'si.en: The weathertight integrity of the bow ramp/visor must always be verified before proceeding to sea.

Trim ve list ramp eğiminden ±2° aşmamalı.en: Trim and list must not exceed the ramp slope by more than ±2°.

Yıllık class survey kapsamında ramp yapı.en: A structural inspection of the ramp must be carried out as part of the annual class survey.

Hidrolik motor → ana tambur (hoist) → wi.en: Flow: hydraulic motor → main drum (hoist) → wire rope → block → hook.

Slewing (dönüş) hidrolik veya elektrik m.en: Slewing is provided by a hydraulic or electric motor and gearing.

Luffing silindiri bom açısını değiştirir.en: The luffing cylinder changes the jib angle (the SWL varies with the jib angle).

Limit switch'ler aşırı yük, aşırı yüksel.en: Limit switches provide protection against overload, overhoisting and end positions.

Vinci çalıştırmadan önce yağ seviyesi, t.en: Before operating the crane, check the oil level, the wire rope and the hook safety catch.

Yük ağırlığını SWL × açı tablosundan doğ.en: Verify the load weight against the SWL × angle table.

Slewing sırasında ani durdurmadan kaçın;.en: Avoid sudden stops while slewing; this prevents the load from swinging.

Tag line (rehber halat) ile yük dönüşü k.en: The turning of the load is controlled with a tag line.

Operasyon bitince bom kavrama bracket'in.en: When the operation is finished, the jib is placed in its cradle.

Hidrolik basınç düşük, valf bobin arızas.en: Low hydraulic pressure, valve coil fault

Pompa basıncını kontrol et, bobini değiş.en: Check the pump pressure; replace the coil.

Slewing bearing yağı kontrol, gerektiğin.en: Check the slewing bearing grease; renew it when necessary.

Halatı segment olarak inceleme, kriter a.en: Inspect the rope section by section; replace it if the criteria are exceeded.

Limit switch ayarı, mekanik mafsal kontr.en: Adjust the limit switch; check the mechanical linkage.

Yük altında veya salınım yörüngesinde pe.en: No personnel may be under the load or in its swinging path.

Wind, list/trim ve sea-state stop limitl.en: Apply the wind, list/trim and sea-state stop limits from the approved load chart/operating manual; a fixed 15 m/s and 5° is not a safe limit for all cranes/configurations.

Wire rope'u maker/ISO discard criteria i.en: Assess the wire rope visually and by measurement against the maker/ISO discard criteria; do not write classic MPI/UT for the rope as a routine habit, and lubricate according to the rope construction and the PMS.

Sertifikalı operatör + sinyalist ile çal.en: Work with a certified operator + signaller; hand signals must be standardised.

Yıkama makinesi yüksek basınçlı suyu tan.en: The washing machine sprays high-pressure water onto the tank walls.

Yıkama suyu tank dibinde toplanır; educt.en: The washing water collects at the bottom of the tank; the eductor draws it by the venturi effect and pumps it to the slop tank.

Slop ayrışma süresi sıcaklık, emülsiyon.en: The slop settling time is set by the temperature, emulsion and interface measurement; waiting a fixed 24 hours does not on its own prove the discharge quality.

Üstteki yağ tabakası bir sonraki yüke ka.en: The upper oil layer is mixed with the next cargo (load on top, LOT); the lower water is discharged under control with the ODME.

Yıkama programını cargo planına göre haz.en: Prepare the washing programme according to the cargo plan (hot/cold, chemicals, etc.).

İnertlenen tankta tank atmosferini ≤%8 O.en: In an inerted tank, keep the tank atmosphere at ≤8% O₂ and at positive pressure; monitor the ≤5% O₂ limit for the supply gas separately.

Yıkama makinesini approved cycle/program.en: Run the washing machine according to the approved cycle/programme, shadow diagram and coating/cargo restrictions; do not use an arbitrary 90° position.

Slop interface ve sample'ı doğrula; yaln.en: Verify the slop interface and sample; start a controlled discharge only if MARPOL Annex I Reg. 34, the ODME operational manual and the discharge criteria are fully met.

Tank gas free yapılmadan girişe izin ver.en: Do not allow entry until the tank is gas-free; issue a permit to enter.

Driving water basıncı düşük, nozül tıkal.en: Low driving water pressure, nozzle blocked

Pompa basıncı, nozül söküm temizlik..en: Check the pump pressure; dismantle and clean the nozzle.

Sökerek bakım, yatak değişimi..en: Dismantle for maintenance; replace the bearing.

Filtre temizliği, sensör kalibrasyon ve.en: Clean the filter; calibrate and test the sensor.

Tank içi giriş Enclosed Space Entry perm.en: Entry into a tank is made with an Enclosed Space Entry permit and the gas test results must be satisfactory.

Settling time, portable conductive/non-c.en: Verify the settling time, the use of portable conductive/non-conductive equipment and the water-mist/static precaution times from ISGOTT, the cargo SDS and the approved tank-cleaning procedure; a fixed 30 minutes is not sufficient for all operations.

ODME logu Oil Record Book'a işlenir; PSC.en: The ODME log is entered in the Oil Record Book; it is asked for in PSC inspections.

Sıcak yıkamada personel yanık önlemi (PP.en: During hot washing, personnel must take precautions against burns (PPE).

Ballast in: deniz suyu pompası → filtre.en: Ballasting: seawater pump → filter (40 µm) → UV reactor or EC unit → ballast tank.

Ballast out: tank → bypass filtre → UV (.en: Deballasting: tank → bypass filter → UV (again if required) → neutralisation (for EC) → overboard.

UV reaktörde lambalar yüksek yoğunluklu.en: In the UV reactor, the lamps produce high-intensity UV-C; a sensor monitors the intensity and transmittance.

EC ünitesinde elektrotlar deniz suyunu e.en: In the EC unit, electrodes electrolyse seawater; the TRO (Total Residual Oxidant) produced is kept at 2–10 mg/L.

Operasyon öncesi BWMS'i hazırla, lamba ı.en: Before the operation, prepare the BWMS and wait for the lamp warm-up time (UV systems).

Pompa başlat, akış BWMS rated capacity a.en: Start the pump; the flow must be kept below the BWMS rated capacity.

TRO/UV intensity sensörlerini izle; alar.en: Monitor the TRO/UV intensity sensors; in case of an alarm, do not switch to bypass mode — stop the operation.

Deballast sonunda nötralizasyon ünitesin.en: At the end of deballasting, run the neutralisation unit (EC systems) and verify that the overboard TRO is < 0.1 mg/L.

BWRB'a tarih, koordinat, hacim, yapılan.en: Enter the date, position, volume, operation carried out and system status in the BWRB.

Lamba ömrü dolmuş, kuvars kılıf kirli.en: Lamp life expired, quartz sleeve dirty

Lambaları değiştir, kuvars kılıfları tem.en: Replace the lamps; clean the quartz sleeves (acid wash).

Otomatik backflush devrede mi kontrol et.en: Check that the automatic backflush is working; clean manually.

Tuzluluk ölç, asit yıkama yap, elektrot.en: Measure the salinity, carry out an acid wash, check the electrodes.

Sistem bypass moduna geçti.en: System has switched to bypass mode

Operasyonu durdur, PSC bildirim ve servi.en: Stop the operation, notify PSC and call for service.

UV lambalarına çıplak gözle bakma (göz h.en: Do not look at UV lamps with the naked eye (eye damage); the lamps must be de-energised during maintenance.

EC ünitesinde hidrojen birikimi olabilir.en: Hydrogen may build up in the EC unit; the ventilation must always be working (explosion risk).

Kimyasal nötralizasyon ürünleri (sodyum.en: Chemical neutralisation products (sodium thiosulphate) must be stored according to the MSDS.

Sistem arızasında 'Contingency Measure'.en: In the event of a system failure, the 'contingency measures' procedure (notification of the port State, alternative port) is applied.

Chiller kompresörü gaz sıkıştırır → kond.en: The chiller compressor compresses the gas → the condenser is cooled by seawater (liquid) → expansion valve → evaporator (cools the chilled water).

Chilled water pompa ile AHU coil'lerine.en: The chilled water is pumped to the AHU coils; the coils cool the air flow and reduce its humidity.

AHU fanı şartlandırılmış havayı kanallar.en: The AHU fan delivers the conditioned air into the ducts; diffusers distribute it in the spaces.

Termostat oda sıcaklığını okur; chilled.en: The thermostat reads the room temperature and modulates the chilled water valve or damper.

Sezon başında chiller'ı start et; oil he.en: At the start of the season, start the chiller; switch on the oil heater 24 hours beforehand (compressor protection).

Deniz suyu hattı pump filter temizliği y.en: Clean the seawater line pump filter.

Chilled water pompa ve expansion tank se.en: Check the chilled water pump and the expansion tank level.

Filtreleri 1–3 ayda bir temizle/değiştir.en: Clean/replace the filters every 1–3 months; a blocked filter overloads the fan motor.

Yıllık leak test, oil analizi ve refrako.en: Annual leak test, oil analysis and glycol check with a refractometer.

Filtre tıkalı, gaz kaçağı, valf kapalı.en: Filter blocked, gas leak, valve closed

Filtre, gaz şarj kontrol, valf testi..en: Check the filter and gas charge; test the valve.

SW pompa, strainer kontrol; kondenser as.en: Check the SW pump and strainer; acid-wash the condenser.

Gaz kaçağı, expansion valf arızalı, evap.en: Gas leak, expansion valve faulty, evaporator dirty

Sızdırmazlık testi, valf bakım, evap tem.en: Leak test, valve maintenance, evaporator cleaning.

Drain pan temizliği, izolasyon onarımı..en: Clean the drain pan; repair the insulation.

Soğutucu gaz sızıntısında ortam ventile.en: In the event of a refrigerant leak, the space must be ventilated; high concentrations cause asphyxiation.

Chiller machinery space gaz dedektörüyle.en: The chiller machinery space must be protected by a gas detector (for R134a).

Bakım sırasında sistem boşaltma için 're.en: Use a recovery unit to empty the system during maintenance; the gas must not be released to the atmosphere.

Provision room'a giren personel için içe.en: For personnel entering a provision room, the door-opening handle on the inside must always work.

Pompa FWT'den suyu alır, basınç tankına.en: The pump takes water from the FWT and delivers it to the pressure tank; the air cushion is compressed and stores energy.

Musluklar açıldığında basınç tankından s.en: When taps are opened, water flows from the pressure tank and the pressure falls.

Stop basıncının (örn. 3 bar) altına düşü.en: When the pressure falls below the cut-in pressure (e.g. 3 bar), the pressure switch starts the pump; when it reaches the upper pressure (e.g. 5 bar), it stops it.

UV sterilizator akış sırasında suyu ster.en: The UV steriliser sterilises the water as it flows.

FWT seviyesini günlük kontrol et; hidrof.en: Check the FWT level daily; the hydrophore pump must not run dry (the mechanical seal will burn).

Basınç tankı ön havasını ayda bir kontro.en: Check the pressure tank pre-charge air once a month (with a pressure gauge, water side empty).

Klor dozaj veya UV lambasını çalışır tut.en: Keep the chlorine dosing or UV lamp working.

Pompa start/stop sıklığını izle; >6/dk i.en: Monitor the pump start/stop frequency; if it is >6 per minute, the tank pre-charge is low.

Pressure tank ön havası boş, kaçak var,.en: Pressure tank pre-charge empty, leak, pressure switch out of adjustment

Tank havası şarj, hat sızdırmazlık, pres.en: Recharge the tank air, check the lines for leaks, adjust the pressure switch.

Musluktan kesik kesik su.en: Intermittent water flow from the tap

Hava emiyor, basınç tankı membranı yırtı.en: Drawing air, pressure tank membrane torn

Suction line kontrol, membran değişim..en: Check the suction line; replace the membrane.

Calorifier rezistansı bozuk, termostat a.en: Calorifier heating element defective, thermostat faulty

Rezistans test, termostat değişim..en: Test the heating element; replace the thermostat.

Tank kirli, klor düşük, UV bozuk.en: Tank dirty, low chlorine, UV defective

Tank temizlik, klor şoku, UV lamba değiş.en: Clean the tank, shock-chlorinate, replace the UV lamp.

Tank inspeksiyonu enclosed space entry p.en: Tank inspection with an enclosed space entry permit and a gas (O₂) test.

Pres tank şarj havası kompresörden alınm.en: The pressure tank charge air must not be taken from the compressor (oil contamination); use pure N₂ or clean air.

FWT giriş hatlarında non-return valve sa.en: The non-return valves on the FWT inlet lines must be sound (risk of contamination).

Calorifier elektrik rezistansı kuruda en.en: The calorifier electric heating element must not be energised when dry (it will burn out).

Kompresör atmosferden hava çeker, 1. kad.en: The compressor draws air from the atmosphere, compresses it to 5–7 bar in the 1st stage and cools it in the intercooler.

2. kademede 30 bara çıkarılır, aftercool.en: In the 2nd stage it is raised to 30 bar, cooled in the aftercooler and the moisture separated.

Receiver'a basılır; tank dolduğunda unlo.en: It is delivered to the receiver; when the receiver is full the unloader operates or the compressor stops.

Dryer adsorpsiyon (silica gel) veya refr.en: The dryer removes water by adsorption (silica gel) or refrigeration.

Kompresör start öncesi yağ seviyesi, soğ.en: Before starting the compressor, check the oil level, cooling water and drains.

Otomatik mod: receiver tank basıncı düşt.en: Automatic mode: automatic start when the receiver pressure falls.

Drain'leri condensate yükü, auto-drain i.en: Check the drains according to the condensate load, the auto-drain function and the PMS/watch routine; lead oily condensate to a suitable collection system.

Start air valfi izolasyonu kontrol et; k.en: Check the isolation of the starting air valve; an accidental start may occur.

Inter/aftercooler temizliğini pressure d.en: Plan the cleaning of the inter/aftercoolers according to pressure drop, temperature approach, leak tests and the PMS condition trend.

Suction filter tıkalı, kafa contası, kap.en: Suction filter blocked, cylinder head gasket, broken valve plate

Filtre, kafa söküm, valf bakım..en: Filter, remove the head, valve maintenance.

Soğutma suyu yok, kondenser kirli, inter.en: No cooling water, condenser dirty, intercooler blocked

Emniyet valfi sızdırıyor, drain valfi aç.en: Safety valve leaking, drain valve open, line leak

Valf reseat, hatta sızdırmazlık testi..en: Reseat the valve; leak-test the line.

Desiccant değişim, regen heater kontrol..en: Replace the desiccant; check the regeneration heater.

Receiver tank üzerinde safety valve mutl.en: The safety valve on the receiver must always work; manual tests are carried out regularly.

Yüksek basınç hattında çatlak/sızıntıya.en: When approaching a crack/leak in a high-pressure line, do not expose your body (a high-velocity jet cuts).

Bakım öncesi tank tamamen depressurize e.en: Before maintenance, the receiver must be completely depressurised and isolation and lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) applied.

Yağlı kompresörde aşırı yağ taşkını patl.en: In an oil-lubricated compressor, excessive oil carry-over creates a risk of explosion; check the oil filter and separator regularly.

Yakıtlı kazanda brulor su yüzeyini ısıtı.en: In an oil-fired boiler, the burner heats the water; the water evaporates and dry steam is taken from the top.

Buhar kollektörden tüketicilere dağıtılı.en: Steam is distributed from the header to the consumers; it condenses as it gives up heat at the point of use.

Kondens steam trap üzerinden kondens hat.en: The condensate passes through a steam trap into the condensate line and returns to the hot well.

Feed water pompası hot well'den kazana b.en: The feed water pump delivers from the hot well to the boiler; the level controller keeps the drum level constant.

Kazanı çalıştırmadan önce su seviyesi (g.en: Before firing the boiler, check the water level (gauge glass) and test the safety valve.

Brulor yakıt valfini yavaş aç; alev tutu.en: Open the burner fuel valve slowly; check the ignition of the flame (flame eye).

Drum basıncı yükselirken çıkış valfini k.en: As the drum pressure rises, open the outlet valve gradually (to prevent thermal shock).

Operasyon sırasında pH, klorür, fosfat,.en: During operation, pH, chloride, phosphate and salinity tests are carried out daily.

Blow-down: kazan suyundaki çamur ve tuzu.en: Blowdown: surface and bottom blowdown to remove sludge and salts from the boiler water.

Yakıt soğuk, ignition arızası, fotosel k.en: Fuel cold, ignition fault, photocell dirty

HFO ısıt, ignition kontrol, fotosel temi.en: Heat the HFO, check the ignition, clean the photocell.

Kazan suyu kirli, yüksek TDS, alkalinity.en: Boiler water dirty, high TDS, high alkalinity

Blow-down yap, kimyasal dozaj kontrol..en: Blow down; check the chemical dosing.

Steam trap takılı kalmış, kondens hattın.en: Steam trap stuck, leak in the condensate line

Trap test, hat sızdırmazlık..en: Test the trap; leak-test the line.

Soot birikimi, düşük yük, alkali yakıt.en: Soot build-up, low load, alkaline fuel

Soot blow düzenli yap, yangın halinde st.en: Carry out soot blowing regularly; in a fire, use steam smothering or CO₂.

Buhar hattı çalıştırılırken yavaş ısıtıl.en: A steam line must be warmed up slowly when put into service; opening it suddenly causes water hammer (it can burst the pipe).

Safety valve manuel test düzenli yapılır.en: The safety valve is tested manually at regular intervals; a blocked safety valve is a disaster.

Sıcak yüzey yanığı için hatlar izole edi.en: Lines must be insulated against burns from hot surfaces; contact with bare hands is prohibited.

Boş çalışan kazan (low water) overheatin.en: A boiler running without water (low water) carries a risk of overheating and explosion; the level alarms must be kept sensitive.

Tehlike çağrısı DSC ile (kim, nerede, ne.en: A distress alert is sent automatically by DSC (who, where, what kind of distress) with a single button.

Sahil istasyonu / yakın gemiler DSC alar.en: Coast stations / nearby ships are alerted by the DSC alarm and receive the details on the voice channel.

MSI (NAVTEX, SafetyNET) otomatik olarak.en: MSI (NAVTEX, SafetyNET) automatically prints weather reports, NAVAREA warnings and SAR broadcasts.

EPIRB ve SART'ın aktivasyonu uydu/Radar.en: Activation of the EPIRB and SART directs search and rescue units by satellite/radar.

Vardiya başında battery, antenler, lamba.en: At the start of the watch, check the batteries, antennas, lamps and printer paper.

Günlük DSC self-test (test çağrısı sahil.en: Daily DSC self-test (an internal test, not a test call to the shore).

Live DSC test çağrısını Radio Log proced.en: Make a live DSC test call according to the Radio Log procedure, coast-station availability, flag guidance and the maker's instructions; if there is no coverage/acknowledgement, record the failed attempt and its cause — do not use a distress alert.

Aylık EPIRB self-test, SART self-test, b.en: Monthly EPIRB self-test, SART self-test, battery expiry check.

Radio log'a tüm test ve tehlike trafiği.en: All tests and distress traffic are recorded in the radio log.

GPS feed yok, MMSI girilmemiş, anten arı.en: No GPS feed, MMSI not entered, antenna fault

GPS bağlantı, MMSI kontrol, antenna VSWR.en: Check the GPS connection and the MMSI; measure the antenna VSWR.

Anten kopuk, kanal seçimi yanlış (518 kH.en: Antenna broken, wrong channel selection (518 kHz English), squelch too high

Antenna ve preamp test, frekans/lang aya.en: Test the antenna and preamplifier; set the frequency/language.

Şarj devresi arızalı, battery ömrü dolmu.en: Charging circuit faulty, battery life expired

Charger ölçüm, battery load test, gereki.en: Measure the charger, load-test the battery, replace if necessary.

Tehlike butonuna kazara basılırsa hemen.en: If the distress button is pressed by accident, a voice cancellation message is sent to the coast station immediately (DSC cancel).

EPIRB hidrostatik release ünitesi (HRU).en: The expiry date of the EPIRB hydrostatic release unit (HRU) must not have passed.

Telsiz odasında reserve power source ve.en: In the radio room, the reserve source of power and the batteries must be kept charged at all times.

Radyo arıza günlüğü ve onarım kayıtları.en: The radio fault log and repair records are requested in PSC inspections.

DSC çağrısı: sender MMSI, alıcı MMSI/all.en: DSC call: sender MMSI, recipient MMSI/all ships, category (distress/urgency/safety/routine), position, nature.

VHF DSC distress alert acknowledgement a.en: If no acknowledgement of a VHF DSC distress alert is received, the equipment may automatically repeat the attempt after about 3.5–4.5 minutes; this must not be confused with the 'five consecutive transmissions' of MF/HF formats, and the maker's display must be watched.

Distress alert sonrasında telsiz Ch 16'y.en: After a distress alert, the radio switches automatically to Ch 16 and a voice MAYDAY is expected.

Power on, GPS feed ve self-test kontrol..en: Check power on, GPS feed and self-test.

Ch 16 ve Ch 70 daima açık (silent watch).en: Ch 16 and Ch 70 always on (listening watch).

Çağrı için uygun channel/power seç, dinl.en: For a call, select a suitable channel/power, listen, press the PTT and speak briefly using SMCP/radio procedure; do not keep the carrier on unnecessarily.

Distress için nature/position/time otoma.en: For distress, check the automatic/manual nature/position/time data and hold the protected DISTRESS button pressed for the time marked on the equipment.

Test çağrısını gemi planı ve coast-stati.en: Make the test call according to the ship's plan and the coast station's instructions; enter the acknowledgement/failure result in the Radio Log.

Ayar test, hoparlör değişim..en: Test the settings; replace the loudspeaker.

Anten/connection korozyon, başka cihaz i.en: Antenna/connection corrosion, interference from other equipment

Anten konnektör temizlik, EMI kaynak izo.en: Clean the antenna connector; isolate the EMI source.

MMSI yok, GPS feed yok, Ch 70 başka ciha.en: No MMSI, no GPS feed, Ch 70 in use by another unit

MMSI ayar, GPS bağlantı, conflict çöz..en: Set the MMSI, connect the GPS, resolve the conflict.

Ch 16 sürekli dinlenmeli (silent watch)..en: Ch 16 must be monitored continuously (listening watch).

Yanlış DSC çağrısı: hemen Ch 16'da sesli.en: False DSC alert: immediately broadcast a voice cancellation on Ch 16 and record it in the log.

Anten/feedline sağlığını forward/reflect.en: Trend the antenna/feeder health with forward/reflected power or the maker's BIT; take the VSWR alarm and acceptance value from the manufacturer's manual; do not take unauthorised measurements on a live antenna line.

Frekans seçilir, ATU ground plane ile an.en: The frequency is selected; the ATU tunes the antenna to 50 Ω with the ground plane.

DSC modülü tehlike çağrısını dijital ola.en: The DSC module modulates the distress alert digitally (FSK).

Sahil veya gemi DSC alarmı ile uyarılır;.en: The shore or a ship is alerted by the DSC alarm; the MAYDAY is received on the voice channel.

NBDP mod: ARQ (otomatik tekrar isteği) i.en: NBDP mode: error-free telex exchange with ARQ (automatic repeat request).

Gemi pozisyonuna göre uygun band seç (ya.en: Select a suitable band according to the ship's position (MF for near, HF for far).

Self-test ve live DSC testini Radio Log.en: Carry out the self-test and the live DSC test according to the Radio Log procedure/maker's instructions; record coast-station availability and the acknowledgement received.

Distress: nature, position/time ve uygun.en: Distress: select the nature, position/time and the appropriate attempt; press the protected distress button for the time marked on the equipment and watch the DSC/voice follow-up display.

Ack alındıktan sonra voice frekansa geç.en: After the acknowledgement is received, change to the voice frequency and give the details.

Anten kopuk, ground bağlantısı zayıf, AT.en: Antenna broken, poor ground connection, ATU fault

Anten süreklilik, ground bond temizlik,.en: Check antenna continuity, clean the ground bond, service the ATU.

Final amplifier zayıflamış, anten verim.en: Final amplifier weakened, low antenna efficiency

PA test, anten VSWR ölçüm..en: Test the PA; measure the antenna VSWR.

Kağıt yenile, mekanik temizlik..en: Renew the paper; clean the mechanism.

Yüksek voltajlı PA modülü; servis sırası.en: High-voltage PA module; capacitors must be discharged during servicing.

Anten yakın çalışan personel için RF rad.en: RF radiation risk for personnel working near the antenna; keep clear during transmission.

Frekans çakışmasını önlemek için ITU pla.en: The ITU plan must be followed to avoid frequency conflicts.

GPS pozisyonu otomatik enjekte; mesajla.en: The GPS position is injected automatically and sent with the message.

Store-and-forward: gemi LES'e iletir, LE.en: Store-and-forward: the ship sends to the LES, the LES forwards to the recipient; it is not real-time.

Distress: tek tuş ile RCC'ye iletilir, a.en: Distress: sent to the RCC with a single button; an acknowledgement is received.

Login durumu ve LES seçimi günlük kontro.en: Check the log-in status and the LES selection daily.

EGC mesajları printer çıktısı veya scree.en: EGC messages are printed or logged on screen; check them every watch.

Position report otomatik; manuel test ay.en: Position reports are automatic; manual test once a month.

Distress test: gemi VHF'inden RCC'ye tel.en: Distress test: a live test is possible after informing the RCC (via the ship's VHF or by telephone).

Login yok, LES dışında, anten obstructio.en: Not logged in, outside the LES area, antenna obstruction

Login yap, LES seç, anten önündeki obstr.en: Log in, select the LES, remove the obstruction in front of the antenna.

Sarf yenile, port test..en: Renew the consumables; test the port.

GPS testi, kablo kontrol..en: Test the GPS; check the cable.

Mesaj iletim ücretli; uzun mesaj LES tar.en: Message transmission is charged; long messages may be expensive at the LES tariff.

EGC/MSI reception seçimini seyredilen NA.en: Set the EGC/MSI reception for the NAVAREA/METAREA and coastal warning areas being navigated; do not use settings that suppress mandatory distress/urgency and relevant area messages.

Antenna 360° serbest açıya sahip olmalı;.en: The antenna must have a clear 360° view; do not mount it behind a mast or funnel.

Su ile temas → switch kapanır → 50 sn iç.en: Contact with water → the switch closes → within 50 s the 406 MHz alert + 121.5 MHz homing transmission starts.

Cospas-Sarsat uyduları (LEO + GEO + MEO).en: Cospas-Sarsat satellites (LEO + GEO + MEO) receive the signal and pass it to the RCC.

RCC gemi sahibini ve son pozisyonu doğru.en: The RCC verifies the ship's owner and last position and activates SAR.

Aylık görsel inspeksiyon: bracket sağlam.en: Monthly visual inspection: bracket sound, expiry date checked, HRU sound.

Self-test'i maker'ın izin verdiği test p.en: Carry out the self-test within the test window/duration permitted by the maker; do not drain the battery by repeating the GNSS self-test unnecessarily, and record the displayed result.

Yıllık servis: yetkili tarafından batter.en: Annual service: battery, GPS and transmit power tested by an authorised person.

Gemi terk durumunda: bracket'tan al, su.en: When abandoning ship: take it from the bracket and throw it into the water, or activate it with the manual switch.

Servise gönder, gerekirse değişim..en: Send it for servicing; replace if necessary.

Suya düşmüş, manuel butona basılmış.en: Fallen into the water, manual button pressed

EPIRB'i çıkar, kapat (manuel switch off).en: Retrieve the EPIRB, switch it off (manual switch off), and report the cancellation to the RCC by telephone.

Yanlış alarm SAR kaynaklarını bağlar; te.en: A false alert ties up SAR resources; apply the test button/duration from the instructions on the beacon, and if there is a real activation, switch the beacon off and report the cancellation to the RCC at once with the identity/position.

EPIRB'i seyir köprüsünün dışına, suyun u.en: Mount the EPIRB outside the wheelhouse, where water can reach it (the HRU must work when abandoning ship).

Bracket etrafını boyama (HRU sıkışır)..en: Do not paint around the bracket (the HRU will jam).

AIS-SART aynı şekilde GPS pozisyonu ile.en: An AIS-SART similarly transmits periodic AIS messages with its GPS position.

Aylık görsel: bracket, switch, expiry ko.en: Monthly visual check: bracket, switch, expiry.

Aylık self-test: butona bas, LED + sesli.en: Monthly self-test: press the button; LED + audible alarm → OK.

Aktivasyon: switch açılır, 9 GHz pulse a.en: Activation: the switch is turned on; it replies when it detects a 9 GHz pulse.

Yüksek bir yere asılır (lifeboat tepe ve.en: It is hoisted high (on top of the lifeboat or on the mast inside the liferaft).

Radar ekranında görünmüyor.en: Not visible on the radar screen
