Çok alçak monte, 3 GHz radar kullanımı,.en: Mounted too low, use of a 3 GHz radar, SART not activated

Yüksek monte, X-band radar, switch kontr.en: Mount it high, use an X-band radar, check the switch.

Self-test'i yalnız maker işaretli süre/m.en: Carry out the self-test only for the time/in the mode marked by the maker; the Radar SART reply may be seen on nearby X-band displays, and the AIS-SART test message on AIS units.

Yanlış aktivasyonda hemen kapat, RCC'ye.en: In the event of a false activation, switch it off at once and report the cancellation to the RCC.

Test sırasında diğer geminin radar ekran.en: During a test, the SART may appear on another ship's radar screen; a warning is given.

Reset interval boyunca nöbetçinin reset.en: During the reset interval, the watchkeeper is expected to reset (manual button or motion sensor).

Reset alınmazsa bridge visual → bridge a.en: If no reset is received, the sequence bridge visual → bridge audible → remote second/third stage proceeds with the MSC.128(75) timing.

Gemi ECDIS, AIS gibi sistemlerden bilgi.en: It does not take information from the ship's ECDIS, AIS or similar systems; it works independently.

Vardiya başında BNWAS aktif olduğunu doğ.en: At the start of the watch, verify that the BNWAS is active.

Dormancy interval'i Master'ın protected.en: Verify the dormancy interval against the Master's protected setting and standing orders; do not go outside the 3–12 minute approval range.

Underway durumunda approved operational.en: When under way, verify on the panel and the alarm inhibit indicator that the approved operational mode is really active.

PMS testinde dormancy, bridge visual/aud.en: In the PMS test, verify with timing the dormancy, bridge visual/audible alarms, remote call locations, reset points and the power-failure alarm.

Hoparlör arıza, kablo bağlantı, ayar yan.en: Loudspeaker fault, cable connection, wrong setting

Hoparlör test, hat kontrol, ayar onar..en: Test the loudspeaker, check the line, correct the setting.

Reset switch arızalı, motion sensor takı.en: Reset switch faulty, motion sensor stuck

Switch test, sensor temizlik/değişim..en: Test the switch; clean/replace the sensor.

BNWAS'ı kalıcı devre dışı bırakmak SOLAS.en: Permanently disabling the BNWAS is a SOLAS violation; a serious PSC deficiency.

Reset için sahte düzenek (bantlı buton v.en: Fake reset devices (taped buttons, etc.) are prohibited.

Remote alarm location/sequence'i onaylı.en: Verify the remote alarm locations/sequence from the approved BNWAS plan; inform the Master, the bridge team and the crew affected before the test.

Tüm veri kaynakları VDR concentrator uni.en: All data sources are connected to the VDR concentrator unit.

Concentrator dahili memory'ye sürekli ya.en: The concentrator writes continuously to its internal memory (FIFO).

Kayıt aynı anda long-term medium ile ins.en: The recording is written at the same time to the long-term medium and the installed fixed/float-free capsule for the retention period in the performance standard.

Kazada save butonu basılırsa tüm memory.en: If the save button is pressed after an accident, the whole memory becomes write-protected.

Power, recording, source-fault ve UTC st.en: Check the power, recording, source-fault and UTC status in the maker/PMS routine; do not reset a fault and lose it.

Audio/source testini maker test mode ve.en: Carry out the audio/source test according to the maker's test mode and the APT/PMS, without disturbing the real bridge recording.

Capsule/locating device kontrolünü APT k.en: Check the capsule/locating device according to the APT scope, expiry and service instructions.

Kaza/olay sonrası Master/SMS talimatıyla.en: After an accident/incident, use the save/protect function on the Master's/SMS instruction; do not switch the equipment off arbitrarily, and preserve the data chain of custody.

Kablo, mikrofon arızası, audio level düş.en: Cable, microphone fault, low audio level

Mikrofon test, kablo kontrol, ayar..en: Test the microphone, check the cable, adjust.

Grabber test, kablo değiştir..en: Test the grabber; replace the cable.

VDR memory'ye doğrudan müdahale yasak; y.en: Direct interference with the VDR memory is prohibited; unauthorised personnel must not delete data.

Olay sonrası preservation, indirme ve te.en: After an incident, record the preservation, download and handover in accordance with company emergency/authority instructions; manage the risk of altering or overwriting the data without delay.

Capsule çevresini erişilebilir tut ve fi.en: Keep the area around the capsule accessible and verify its physical survival rating from its own type approval/marking; do not copy a single temperature/depth value from the internet.

Davit gravity tipi: brake bırakılır, dav.en: Gravity davit type: the brake is released, the davit swings out by gravity and the boat is lowered under control on the winch wire.

Free-fall: release handle çekilir, lifeb.en: Free-fall: the release handle is pulled and the lifeboat slides down the ramp into the water; it dives bow first on entry, then rises to the surface.

Release gear, normal tahliyede tekne wat.en: In a normal evacuation, the release gear is used for off-load release when the boat is waterborne and the falls are unloaded; the on-load capability is for emergencies/special cases, and misuse can be fatal.

Hydrostatic interlock, hook reset indica.en: The hydrostatic interlock, hook reset indicator and operating handle form a single safety chain; the reset/locked condition is verified physically on each hook according to the maker's instructions.

Embarkation: launch alarm → muster stati.en: Embarkation: launch alarm → muster station → the person in charge of the lifeboat manages boarding.

Davit/winch'i assigned operator ve coxsw.en: Operate the davit/winch within the chain of command of the assigned operator and coxswain; do not release the brake until the gripes, plug, painter, falls and lowering area checklist has been completed.

Tekne waterborne, falls unloaded ve hydr.en: Apply the approved off-load release procedure after verifying that the boat is waterborne, the falls are unloaded and the status of the hydrostatic interlock; cross-check the hook reset on both sides before recovery.

Free-fall launch'ta tüm kişiler numaralı.en: For a free-fall launch, everyone sits in a numbered seat in the maker-approved restraint/head support position; simulated/actual launches are made only under the approved drill procedure.

Fren balata aşınmış, ayar bozuk.en: Brake lining worn, out of adjustment

Balata değişim, fren ayarı..en: Replace the lining; adjust the brake.

Yağlama, sheave hizası, deniz suyu veya.en: Lubrication, sheave alignment, seawater or fatigue

Tekneyi kullanımdan çıkar; SOLAS III/20,.en: Take the boat out of service; inspect/renew the falls according to SOLAS III/20, the maker's discard criteria and the approved maintenance plan; do not apply a wrong practice such as 'turn end-for-end every 5 years'.

Battery zayıf, yakıt eski/su girmiş.en: Weak battery, old fuel/water in the fuel

Battery şarj, yakıt drain ve yenile..en: Charge the battery; drain and renew the fuel.

Hook bakım, hidrostatik mekanizma test..en: Maintain the hooks; test the hydrostatic mechanism.

Drill/bakım sırasında secondary safety d.en: During drills/maintenance, use the secondary safety device or fall prevention arrangement only as described in the maker's and MSC.402 procedures; do not interfere with a hook under live load.

Free-fall release sırasında baş ve boyun.en: During a free-fall release, the head and neck must be supported against the backrest; the PFD must be worn.

Davit altındaki bölgede personel olmasın.en: No personnel may be in the area under the davit (risk of falling if there is no limit switch).

Yağlama düzenli; korozyon ve sıkışma kaz.en: Lubricate regularly; corrosion and seizure lead to accidents.

Manuel: painter line gemiden serbest bır.en: Manual: the painter is secured to the ship, the raft is thrown overboard, and when the painter is pulled hard the CO₂ valve opens → the raft inflates.

Otomatik (HRU): su basıncı HRU'yu çalışt.en: Automatic (HRU): water pressure operates the HRU and releases the lashing; the container floats, the painter attached to the ship tightens and triggers inflation, and if the ship continues to sink the weak link breaks and frees the inflated raft from the ship.

Inflation/orientation süresi çevre ve ty.en: The inflation/orientation time depends on the environment and the type approval; if the raft inflates upside down, the marked righting strap/procedure is used.

Aylık görsel: canister sağlam, painter b.en: Monthly visual check: canister sound, painter attached, HRU expiry, lashing bracket sound.

Yıllık servis: yetkili istasyona gönder,.en: Annual service: send it to an authorised station and obtain a certificate.

Drill'de manuel atış simülasyonu (gerçek.en: In drills, simulate a manual launch (not a real deployment — it is expensive).

Manual launch'ta painter'ın gemiye doğru.en: In a manual launch, verify that the painter is attached to a strong point on the ship, throw the container clear of obstructions and pull the painter until the firing lanyard operates; if possible, board dry by the embarkation ladder/davit, and treat jumping into the sea as a last resort.

Liferaft konteyneri etrafında istif/eşya.en: No stowage/objects may be around the liferaft container; it must float free if the ship sinks.

HRU 'weak link' painter ile gemi arasınd.en: The HRU weak link is between the painter and the ship; when the ship sinks, the painter is pulled, the raft inflates and the weak link breaks (the raft is freed).

Pyrotechnic expiry tarihini item label/s.en: Track the pyrotechnic expiry date from the item label/service certificate; do not assume a fixed 5 years, and hand expired items over to the approved shore disposal chain.

Liferaft yıllık servis sertifikası gemid.en: The liferaft annual service certificate must be kept on board (PSC check).

Davit gravity ile veya hidrolik ile boat.en: The davit swings the boat out by gravity or hydraulically.

Single-fall davit ile hızlı iniş; suda q.en: Fast lowering with a single-fall davit; the fall is released with the quick-release hook in the water.

Motor start, mürettebat MOB veya raft'a.en: The engine is started and the crew heads for the MOB or the raft.

Recovery: boat altına horse-collar, hook.en: Recovery: the hook is connected (with the horse-collar/lifting strop where provided) and the boat is hoisted with the davit.

Vardiya başı: motor yakıt, battery, lash.en: At the start of the watch: check the engine fuel, battery, lashing and painter.

Launch alarm: 2 kişi rescue boat'a, davi.en: Launch alarm: 2 persons board the rescue boat, the davit operator opens the hydraulics and the boat is lowered into the water.

Suda motor start, görev yap, geri dön, h.en: Start the engine in the water, carry out the task, return, connect the hook and hoist with the davit.

Launch/manoeuvre drill ile annual/five-y.en: Carry out the launch/manoeuvring drill and the annual/five-yearly davit and release gear examinations/tests separately according to SOLAS III/19-20, MSC.402 and the maker's maintenance plan.

Yakıt eski, buji kirli, primer pump hata.en: Old fuel, dirty spark plug, primer pump fault

Yakıt yenile, buji temizlik, pump test..en: Renew the fuel, clean the spark plug, test the pump.

Yağ az, pompa zayıf, valf takılı.en: Low oil, weak pump, valve sticking

Yağ ekle, pompa servis, valf bakım..en: Add oil, service the pump, maintain the valve.

Boat altında personel olmamalı; düşme ri.en: No personnel may be under the boat; risk of falling.

Outboard motor egzozu CO içerir; uzun sü.en: Outboard motor exhaust contains CO; prolonged idle running must not be done in an enclosed space.

Recovery sırasında dalga koşullarına dik.en: Watch the wave conditions during recovery; a hook coming off can be fatal.

FRB/rescue-boat drill PPE'sini approved.en: Choose the PPE for FRB/rescue boat drills according to the approved boat manual, the risk assessment, water/weather conditions and the company procedure; verify the lifejackets and communication arrangements completely.

Deniz emniyetinin temel taşıdır. Yetersi.en: It is the cornerstone of safety at sea. Inadequate watchkeeping leads directly to collisions, groundings and loss of life. It is mandatory for maintaining safe operations under ISM Code Section 7.

Vardiya düzenini belirler, özel talimatl.en: Sets the watch arrangements, gives special instructions and is called to the bridge when necessary.

Vardiya süresince geminin güvenli seyri.en: Is fully responsible for the safe navigation of the ship during the watch.

Hava ve trafik koşullarına göre ayrı bir.en: A separate lookout is assigned according to the weather and traffic conditions. The OOW may be the sole lookout only in daylight, in open sea and in good visibility.

Manuel dümen gerektiğinde görev alır. Kı.en: Takes the helm when hand steering is required. Is kept continuously available in restricted waters.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2 – Vardiya tutma ilkele.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2 – Principles of watchkeeping

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 14 – Personel ve kö.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 14 – Ships' manning and bridge arrangements

ISM Kod Bölüm 7 – Gemi operasyonlarının.en: ISM Code Section 7 – Planning of shipboard operations

Pusula kursu ve autopilot ayarı kontrol.en: Compass course and autopilot setting checked

Sonraki waypoint mesafesi/ETA bilinir.en: Distance/ETA to the next waypoint known

Vardiya devrinde '5 dakika kuralı' uygul.en: The '5-minute rule' applies at the change of watch: the relieving officer stays on the bridge for at least 5 minutes to adjust to the dark and grasp the current situation. A hurried handover is never made.

Kısıtlı görüşte seyir için temel cihaz o.en: It is the basic instrument for navigation in restricted visibility, and its use for determining the risk of collision is required by COLREG Rule 7. Not using radar, or using it wrongly, is one of the main causes of marine accidents.

Radar/ARPA'yı etkin kullanır, hedefleri.en: Uses the radar/ARPA effectively, tracks targets and makes manoeuvring decisions when necessary.

Kısıtlı görüşte köprüüstüne gelir. CPA a.en: Comes to the bridge in restricted visibility. Sets the CPA alarm limits.

COLREG Kural 7 – Çatışma riski (Radar ku.en: COLREG Rule 7 – Risk of collision (use of radar)

COLREG Kural 19 – Kısıtlı görüşte seyir.en: COLREG Rule 19 – Conduct of vessels in restricted visibility

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19.2 – Seyir cihazl.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19.2 – Requirements for navigational equipment

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Radar ve ARPA yetkinli.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Radar and ARPA competence

Range/gain/clutter ayarları mevcut koşul.en: Range/gain/clutter settings suited to the conditions

Kısıtlı görüşte tek bir range'de kalmayı.en: In restricted visibility, do not stay on a single range. Switch regularly between the 6 NM and 12 NM ranges so that you miss neither close nor distant targets. Suppressing sea clutter completely makes small targets disappear.

COLREG, denizde çatışmaları önlemenin te.en: COLREG is the basic legal framework for preventing collisions at sea. A breach can result both in criminal liability and in the rejection of insurance claims.

COLREG kurallarını anlık olarak uygular,.en: Applies the COLREG rules in real time and makes manoeuvring decisions.

Karmaşık trafik durumlarında köprüüstüne.en: Comes to the bridge in complex traffic situations and makes the final decision.

Hedeflerin kerteriz değişimini raporlar..en: Reports changes in the bearings of targets.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 34 – Güvenli seyir.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 34 – Safe navigation

Radar kullanılarak çatışma riski değerle.en: Risk of collision assessed using radar (Rule 7)

Manevra yeterince erken ve belirgin yapı.en: Manoeuvre made in ample time and substantial (Rule 8)

COLREG kurallarını ezberlemek yetmez; he.en: Memorising the COLREG rules is not enough; you need to understand 'why' each rule exists. For example, the stand-on vessel's right to take action under Rule 17(a)(ii) applies only when the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2 Bölüm 3-1, kaptanın uy.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2 Part 3-1 clearly defines the situations in which the Master must be called. Failing to call the Master when required is gross negligence and leads to disciplinary/criminal liability.

Kaptanı uygun zamanda, yeterli bilgiyle.en: Calls the Master in good time and with sufficient information. Does not hesitate.

Night/standing orders ile çağrılma krite.en: Writes the calling criteria clearly in the night/standing orders. Comes to the bridge immediately when called.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2, Bölüm 3-1 – Kaptanın.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2, Part 3-1 – Informing the Master

ISM Kod Bölüm 5 – Kaptanın yetki ve soru.en: ISM Code Section 5 – Master's responsibility and authority

Kıyı/sığlık yaklaşması var mı?.en: Is the ship approaching the coast/shoals?

Makine/dümen arızası bildirildi mi?.en: Has an engine/steering failure been reported?

Distress/urgency mesajı alındı mı?.en: Has a distress/urgency message been received?

Night orders'ta belirtilen durum oluştu.en: Has a situation specified in the night orders arisen?

Altın kural: 'Tereddüt ettiğiniz anda ka.en: Golden rule: 'Call the Master the moment you are in doubt.' The Master will not be angry with you, but if an accident happens because you did not call, the consequences are severe. Even experienced officers never relax this rule.

Logbook'lar yasal belgelerdir ve mahkeme.en: Logbooks are legal documents and are admissible as evidence in court. They are among the documents most often checked in PSC inspections. Missing or incorrect entries are a reason for fines and detention of the ship.

Vardiyası süresince tüm kayıtları tutar..en: Keeps all records during the watch.

Günlük kontrol ve onay. Önemli olayların.en: Daily check and approval. Confirms that important events are recorded correctly.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 28 – Kayıt tutma yü.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 28 – Records of navigational activities

MARPOL Ek I, Kural 17 – Oil Record Book.en: MARPOL Annex I, Regulation 17 – Oil Record Book

MARPOL Ek V, Kural 10.3 – Garbage Record.en: MARPOL Annex V, Regulation 10.3 – Garbage Record Book

MLC 2006 – Çalışma saatleri kaydı.en: MLC 2006 – Records of hours of work

Saatlik mevki ve seyir bilgileri işlendi.en: Hourly position and navigation data entered

Logbook yazarken 'mahkemede okunabilecek.en: Write the logbook in the knowledge that it 'may be read in court'. Avoid vague expressions; use exact values instead of 'approximately' or 'about'. Times must always be given in 24-hour format and in UTC.

Pilot transfer sırasında düşme ve yarala.en: Falls and injuries during pilot transfer make it one of the highest-risk operations. SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 23 and IMO Res. A.1045(27) set the standards for pilot transfer arrangements.

Pilotla bilgi alışverişi, manevra soruml.en: Information exchange with the pilot, responsibility for manoeuvring, safety decisions.

Pilot merdiveni hazırlığı, güverte ekibi.en: Preparation of the pilot ladder, coordination of the deck crew.

Merdiven rigleme, güvenlik ekipmanları h.en: Rigging the ladder, preparing the safety equipment.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 23 – Pilot transfer.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 23 – Pilot transfer arrangements

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Pilot alma/bırakma yet.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in embarking/disembarking pilots

VHF ile pilot istasyonu ile temas kuruld.en: Contact made with the pilot station by VHF

Pilot merdiveni basamaklarını her kullan.en: Check the steps of the pilot ladder ONE BY ONE before every use. A cracked, loose or worn step can cause a fatal accident. With a freeboard of more than 9 metres, a combination arrangement (pilot ladder + accommodation ladder) is mandatory.

Kısıtlı sularda manevra alanı sınırlıdır.en: In restricted waters the room to manoeuvre is limited, the squat effect increases and traffic density is high. Most accidents happen in restricted waters.

Köprüüstünde bizzat bulunur. Tüm kararla.en: Is personally on the bridge. Bears the final responsibility for all decisions.

Mevki tespiti, radar gözetimi, trafik iz.en: Position fixing, radar monitoring, traffic monitoring.

Manuel dümen. Kurs talimatlarını tekrarl.en: Hand steering. Repeats and carries out the course orders.

Özellikle dar sularda bow lookout görevl.en: A bow lookout is assigned, especially in narrow waters.

İstanbul Boğazı geçişinde squat etkisi c.en: In the transit of the Istanbul Strait, the squat effect can become serious. At 12 knots, squat can reach 1.5 metres in shallow sections. Always include squat in your UKC calculation.

GMDSS, denizde can güvenliğinin son savu.en: The GMDSS is the last line of defence for safety of life at sea. It is mandatory for all Convention ships under SOLAS Chapter IV.

Distress çağrısı kararını verir. Genel a.en: Decides on the distress call. Decides on the general alarm and abandoning ship.

GMDSS cihazlarının bakımı ve operasyonu..en: Maintenance and operation of the GMDSS equipment. Must hold a GOC (General Operator's Certificate).

Vardiyada GMDSS cihazlarını izler. Alına.en: Monitors the GMDSS equipment during the watch. Responds to calls received in accordance with procedure.

STCW Kod A-IV/2 – GMDSS operatör yetkinl.en: STCW Code A-IV/2 – GMDSS operator competence

Inmarsat-C açık ve mesaj kontrolü yapılı.en: Inmarsat-C switched on and messages checked

Distress prosedürü köprüüstünde asılı.en: Distress procedure posted on the bridge

EPIRB'in HID (Hydrostatic Release) ünite.en: Always check the expiry date of the EPIRB's hydrostatic release unit (HRU). An expired HRU may prevent the EPIRB from floating free if the ship sinks. It is usually replaced every 2 years.

Deniz kazalarının %80'inden fazlasında i.en: The human factor plays a part in more than 80% of marine accidents. Bridge discipline is the most effective tool for minimising it.

Köprüüstü disiplin kurallarını belirler.en: Sets and enforces the bridge discipline rules. Leads by example.

Disiplin kurallarına uyar. Closed-loop i.en: Follows the discipline rules. Uses closed-loop communication. Embraces a challenge culture.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2 – Köprüüstü kaynak yön.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2 – Bridge resource management

ISM Kod Bölüm 7 – Gemide operasyonların.en: ISM Code Section 7 – Development of plans for shipboard operations

En tehlikeli an 'sıkıcı' anlardır. Açık.en: The most dangerous moments are the 'boring' ones. In open sea, in fine weather and light traffic, attention wanders. It is exactly then that the lookout slackens and danger goes unnoticed. Build a routine check cycle: every 15 minutes, scan the horizon, check the radar and verify the position.

Güncel olmayan haritayla seyir etmek kar.en: Navigating with charts that are not up to date can lead to grounding or striking unknown dangers. Chart corrections are checked meticulously in PSC inspections.

Tüm harita düzeltmelerinden birinci dere.en: Is primarily responsible for all chart corrections.

Haritaların güncel tutulduğunu denetler..en: Checks that the charts are kept up to date.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Navigational equipment and charts

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 27 – Haritaların gü.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 27 – Nautical charts and publications kept up to date

Son NtM bülteni tarih numarası kontrol e.en: Date/number of the latest NtM bulletin checked

Düzeltme kaydı harita üzerine işlendi.en: Correction record entered on the chart

Geçersiz haritalar (withdrawn) listeden.en: Withdrawn charts removed from the list

Harita düzeltmelerini biriktirmeyin. Her.en: Do not let chart corrections pile up. Do them regularly every week. When a PSC inspector picks a chart at random and looks at the last correction date, a delay of weeks is recorded as a serious deficiency.

ECDIS'in birincil seyir cihazı olarak ku.en: On ships where the ECDIS is the primary means of navigation, navigating with out-of-date ENCs can be as serious an offence as not using paper charts.

ECDIS güncelleme ve lisans yönetiminden.en: Is responsible for ECDIS updates and licence management.

ECDIS güncelliğini denetler..en: Checks that the ECDIS is up to date.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19.2.1.4 – ECDIS ge.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19.2.1.4 – ECDIS requirements

ECDIS yazılım versiyonu güncel.en: ECDIS software version up to date

ECDIS'te 'base display' modunda seyir et.en: Do not navigate with the ECDIS in 'base display' mode. Use the Standard or All display mode. In base display much critical information (depth contours, wrecks, restricted areas) is not shown.

NtM takibi yapılmadan harita düzeltmesi.en: Charts cannot be corrected without following the NtMs. They are the starting point of the whole updating chain.

NtM takibi ve uygulamasından sorumludur..en: Is responsible for following up and applying the NtMs.

Son NtM bülten numarası kaydedildi.en: Number of the latest NtM bulletin recorded

İlgili NtM'ler haritaya uygulandı.en: Relevant NtMs applied to the charts

NAVAREA uyarıları acil NtM niteliğindedi.en: NAVAREA warnings are of the nature of urgent NtMs and must be entered on the chart immediately as T (temporary). Ignoring NAVAREA warnings received by NAVTEX or Inmarsat-C SafetyNET means heading for a known danger with your eyes open.

Navigational warnings hayat kurtarır. NA.en: Navigational warnings save lives. NAVAREA, coastal and local warnings have different areas of coverage, and all of them must be monitored.

Tüm navigational warnings takibi ve hari.en: Following up all navigational warnings and plotting them on the charts.

Vardiya sırasında gelen uyarıların anınd.en: Reading and assessing warnings received during the watch immediately.

Rota üzerindeki uyarılar haritaya işlend.en: Warnings on the route plotted on the chart

NAVTEX'te bazı mesaj kategorileri varsay.en: Some message categories may be disabled by default on NAVTEX. In particular, military exercise warnings (category L) and aids-to-navigation failures (category A) must always be enabled.

Pusula hataları tespit edilmezse gemi ya.en: If compass errors are not detected, the ship steers the wrong course. If the gyro fails, the magnetic compass is used as a back-up; without knowing the deviation, the magnetic compass is of no use.

Düzenli gyro/manyetik pusula karşılaştır.en: Compares the gyro and magnetic compasses regularly and records the errors.

Her vardiyada en az bir gyro kontrolü ya.en: Checks the gyro at least once every watch.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Navigational equipment

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Pusula kullanımı yetki.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in the use of compasses

Gyro/manyetik karşılaştırması logbook'a.en: Gyro/magnetic comparison entered in the logbook

Gyro hatası aniden değişiyorsa (1° üzeri.en: If the gyro error changes suddenly (a shift of more than 1°), the gyrocompass may be faulty. In that case, inform the engine room and prepare to change over to the magnetic compass. Navigating by the magnetic compass without a deviation card is not safe.

Draft bilgisi UKC hesabında, stabilite d.en: Draft information is critical for the UKC calculation, the stability assessment and meeting port entry conditions. Position fixing is the basis of navigational safety.

Düzenli mevki tespiti ve haritaya işleme.en: Regular position fixing and plotting on the chart.

Draft okumaları ve draft survey koordina.en: Reading drafts and coordinating the draft survey.

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Mevki tespiti yetkinli.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Position fixing competence

Açık denizde saatlik, kıyısal sularda he.en: Hourly in open sea, every 15–30 minutes in coastal waters

Draft değerleri limandan ayrılırken kayı.en: Drafts recorded on departure from port

GPS'e körü körüne güvenmeyin. Her mevki.en: Do not trust the GPS blindly. Verify every position fix with at least one independent source (radar range, visual bearing). Do not forget to check the GPS antenna offset setting.

BNWAS, vardiya zabitinin köprüüstünde ak.en: The BNWAS verifies that the officer of the watch is active on the bridge and starts an alarm chain if not. The AIS enables ships to identify each other and reduces the risk of collision.

BNWAS'ın aktif çalışmasını sağlar. AIS v.en: Ensures that the BNWAS is active. Updates the AIS data.

AIS'in kapatılma kararı sadece master'ın.en: The decision to switch off the AIS rests only with the Master (on security grounds).

BNWAS aktif ve alarm zinciri çalışıyor.en: BNWAS active and alarm chain working

AIS dinamik verileri güncellendi (draft,.en: AIS dynamic data updated (draft, destination, ETA, navigational status)

AIS 'Navigational Status' alanını her du.en: Update the AIS 'Navigational Status' field at every change of status. If you anchor and do not change 'Under way using engine' to 'At anchor', other ships will think you are moving. It is also a parameter often checked by PSC.

Arızalı seyir cihazı, seyir emniyetini d.en: Defective navigational equipment directly threatens navigational safety. SOLAS Chapter V requires navigational equipment to be kept in working order.

Seyir cihazları bakım ve testlerin koord.en: Is responsible for coordinating the maintenance and testing of the navigational equipment.

Elektriksel arıza tespiti ve basit onarı.en: Electrical fault finding and simple repairs.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Carriage requirements for navigational equipment

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 25 – Cihazların bak.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 16 – Maintenance of equipment

IMO Res. A.694(17) – Seyir cihazları tes.en: IMO Res. A.694(17) – General requirements for shipborne radio equipment and electronic navigational aids

Tüm seyir cihazları çalışır durumda.en: All navigational equipment in working order

Radar manyetron ömrü genellikle 5.000-10.en: A radar magnetron usually lasts 5,000–10,000 hours. Monitor the signal level on the radar performance monitor (PM) regularly. A level below 50% indicates that the magnetron needs replacing.

Hatalı yük planı, aşırı stress, stabilit.en: A faulty cargo plan can lead to excessive stress, loss of stability, cargo damage and even the loss of the ship. It is governed by the ISM Code and SOLAS Chapters VI/VII.

Yük planının hazırlanması ve uygulanması.en: Is primarily responsible for preparing and carrying out the cargo plan.

Yük planını onaylar. Nihai sorumluluk ma.en: Approves the cargo plan. The final responsibility lies with the Master.

SOLAS Bölüm VI – Yük taşıma.en: SOLAS Chapter VI – Carriage of cargoes

SOLAS Bölüm VII – Tehlikeli yük taşıma.en: SOLAS Chapter VII – Carriage of dangerous goods

IMDG Code – Tehlikeli yük segregasyonu.en: IMDG Code – Segregation of dangerous goods

Loading computer'da stabilite kontrol ed.en: Stability checked on the loading computer

Loading computer sonuçlarına körü körüne.en: Do not trust the loading computer results blindly. A computer gives wrong results when wrong data are entered. Cross-check with tank soundings and draft readings. Especially on ships carrying heavy cargo, do not use the SF/BM check points without applying the corrections.

Yükleme/tahliye sırasında stabilite, muk.en: During loading/discharging, stability, strength and cargo safety must be monitored continuously. A faulty operation leads to cargo damage, loss of stability and injury to personnel.

Yükleme/tahliye operasyonunun genel koor.en: Overall coordination of the loading/discharging operation.

Sahada gözetim, sounding, draft okuma..en: Supervision on site, soundings, draft readings.

Operasyonun genel güvenliğinden nihai so.en: Ultimately responsible for the overall safety of the operation.

Yükleme hızını kontrol edemediğiniz duru.en: Do not compromise safety even when you cannot control the loading rate (pressure from the terminal). The Master's authority under SOLAS is a legal right: the Master always has the authority to reduce the loading rate or stop the operation.

Kuru yük gemilerinde yük miktarının beli.en: It is the most common method of determining the cargo quantity on dry cargo ships. It is accepted as legal evidence in resolving commercial disputes.

Draft survey'in koordinasyonu ve hesapla.en: Coordination and calculations of the draft survey.

Bağımsız doğrulama (gönderen/alıcı adına.en: Independent verification (on behalf of the shipper/receiver).

IMO MSC/Circ.1228 – Draft survey prosedü.en: Draft survey procedures (UNECE Code of Uniform Standards and Procedures for the Performance of Draught Surveys of Coal Cargoes; not IMO MSC/Circ.1228)

Constant son güncelleme tarihi kontrol e.en: Date of the last update of the constant checked

Draft okumasını sakin suda yapın. Dalga.en: Read the drafts in calm water. If there are waves, read for a few minutes and take the average. In the trim correction, the second trim correction (from the change of MCT) is often ignored, but it makes a significant difference at large trims.

Doğru sounding verileri stabilite hesabı.en: Correct sounding data are critical for the stability calculation, fuel planning and determining the cargo quantity. Wrong soundings lead to calculation errors and stability problems.

Balast ve kargo tanklarının sounding koo.en: Coordination of soundings of the ballast and cargo tanks.

Yakıt ve yağ tanklarının soundingleri..en: Soundings of the fuel and lubricating oil tanks.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Tank sounding düzenle.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Tank sounding arrangements

MARPOL Ek I – Yağlı suların izlenmesi.en: MARPOL Annex I – Monitoring of oily water

Sounding tape'i çekerken hızlı çekmeyin;.en: Do not pull the sounding tape up quickly; it causes wrong readings. Use sounding paste in oil tanks to make the reading clearer. Even if remote gauges are fitted, verify with a manual sounding at least once a week.

Cargo watch, kargo hasarının önlenmesi,.en: A cargo watch is essential to prevent cargo damage, ensure security and carry out the operation as planned.

Cargo watch düzenini belirler, denetler..en: Sets and supervises the cargo watch arrangements.

Cargo watch sırasında uyanık ve mobil ol.en: Stay alert and mobile during the cargo watch. Watching from one spot is ineffective. Make regular rounds and check all hatch openings, crane areas and the ship's sides.

Mooring, gemicilik mesleğinde en tehlike.en: Mooring is one of the most dangerous operations in seamanship. A parting rope/wire causes serious injury and death. The OCIMF MEG (Mooring Equipment Guidelines) standards must be followed.

Manevra sorumluluğu. Bağlama/çözme komut.en: Responsibility for the manoeuvre. Orders for making fast/letting go.

Baş veya kıç bağlama ekip şefi..en: Leader of the forward or aft mooring team.

Güverte ekibini yönetir, halat/tel opera.en: Manages the deck crew and coordinates the rope/wire operation.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 3-8 – Mooring dü.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 3-8 – Towing and mooring equipment

SNAP-BACK ZONE'DA ASLA DURMAYIN. Kopan b.en: NEVER STAND IN A SNAP-BACK ZONE. A parting mooring rope/wire carries enough energy to cut a human body in two. These zones are marked on deck with yellow/red lines. Keep clear of them whenever any line is under tension.

Su sızdıran hatch cover, kargo hasarı, s.en: A leaking hatch cover is one of the most common causes of cargo damage, loss of stability and ship losses. P&I clubs attribute a large share of cargo damage claims to hatch cover leakage.

Hatch cover operasyonunun genel sorumlul.en: Overall responsibility for the hatch cover operation.

Operasyonun fiili yönetimi ve bakım..en: Actual management of the operation and maintenance.

International Load Line Convention – Hat.en: International Load Line Convention – Hatch cover standards

IACS UR S21 – Hatch cover mukavemeti.en: IACS UR S21 – Hatch cover strength

Hose test yapıldı ve geçti.en: Hose test carried out and passed

Hatch cover gasket'lerini kargoya baslam.en: Check the hatch cover gaskets BEFORE cargo work starts. Once a damaged gasket is found, replacing it under time pressure is very difficult. Carry a spare stock of gaskets between ports. An ultrasonic test gives much more reliable results than a hose test.

Kargo hasarı tazminat talepleri P&I kulü.en: Cargo damage claims are one of the biggest cost items for P&I clubs. Correct documentation is vital in establishing the ship's liability.

Kargo hasar takibi ve belgelenmesinden s.en: Is responsible for following up and documenting cargo damage.

Sahada hasar tespiti ve fotoğraflama..en: Identifying and photographing damage on site.

Letter of Protest imzası ve P&I bildirim.en: Signing the Letter of Protest and notifying the P&I club.

Yükleme öncesi kargo durumu kontrol edil.en: Condition of the cargo checked before loading

Hasarlar Mate's Receipt'e işlendi.en: Damage entered on the Mate's Receipt

Mate's Receipt'e 'clean' (temiz) yazmak.en: Do not give in to pressure to sign the Mate's Receipt 'clean'. If the cargo is damaged, always add a remark. The wording 'apparent good order and condition' means that the ship accepts liability. This can later turn into a claim worth millions of dollars.

Denizde iş kazaları, karada endüstriyel.en: Occupational accidents at sea happen at several times the rate of industrial accidents ashore. Effective safety management minimises deaths and injuries.

ISM Kod kapsamında gemideki güvenliğin n.en: Has the final responsibility for safety on board under the ISM Code.

ILO C155 – İş güvenliği ve sağlığı sözle.en: ILO C155 – Occupational Safety and Health Convention

Risk assessment operasyon öncesi yapıldı.en: Risk assessment made before the operation

Near-miss raporu sisteme girildi.en: Near-miss report entered in the system

Near-miss raporlamayı teşvik edin, cezal.en: Encourage near-miss reporting; do not punish it. Every near miss is an accident that did not happen and a learning opportunity. According to Heinrich's pyramid, every serious accident is the result of 300 unsafe situations.

Denizde yangın, en tehlikeli acil duruml.en: Fire at sea is one of the most dangerous emergencies. Until help arrives, the crew must respond with their own resources. An equipment failure can end in disaster.

Yangın ekipmanlarının bakımı ve kontrol.en: Is responsible for the maintenance and inspection programme of the fire-fighting equipment.

Makine dairesi yangın sistemlerinin bakı.en: Maintenance of the engine room fire-fighting systems.

FSS Code – Yangın güvenlik sistemleri ko.en: FSS Code – International Code for Fire Safety Systems

STCW Kod A-VI/3 – İleri yangınla mücadel.en: STCW Code A-VI/3 – Advanced fire fighting

Fire hose ve lans çalışır durumda.en: Fire hoses and nozzles in working order

BA setleri tüpleri dolu, maskeleri temiz.en: BA set cylinders full, masks clean

BA (Breathing Apparatus) kullanmayı dril.en: Practise using BA (breathing apparatus) CONSTANTLY in drills. In a real fire, donning BA under adrenaline and stress is much harder. Every crew member must be able to move with BA in dark, smoke-filled conditions.

Abandon ship durumunda bu ekipmanlar hay.en: In an abandon ship situation, this equipment is the only difference between life and death. Poorly maintained equipment does not work when it is needed.

Can kurtarma araçlarının bakım programın.en: Is responsible for the maintenance programme of the life-saving appliances.

Drill organizasyonu ve etkinliğinin değe.en: Organising drills and assessing their effectiveness.

LSA Code – Can kurtarma gereçleri kodu.en: LSA Code – International Life-Saving Appliance Code

Immersion suit'ler sağlam ve yerinde.en: Immersion suits intact and in place

Lifeboat hook'ları (on-load release) den.en: Lifeboat on-load release hooks are among the most dangerous mechanisms in maritime history. Accidental opening during maintenance means DEATH. Hook maintenance must always be carried out by trained personnel with the safety pin fitted. Follow the IMO MSC.1/Circ.1206/Rev.2 guidance.

Periyodik kontroller, ekipman arızaların.en: Periodic checks allow equipment failures to be detected early and prevent 'detainable deficiencies' in PSC inspections.

Emniyet ekipmanı haftalık/aylık testleri.en: Coordinates the weekly/monthly tests of the safety equipment.

SOLAS Bölüm III, Kural 20 – Periyodik ba.en: SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 20 – Operational readiness, maintenance and inspections

SOLAS Bölüm II-2, Kural 14 – Yangın güve.en: SOLAS Chapter II-2, Regulation 14 – Fire safety tests

Testleri sadece 'kâğıt üzerinde' yapmayı.en: Do not carry out tests only 'on paper'. The PSC inspector will ask 'when was the last test?' and ask you to operate the equipment. Equipment that does not work + 'tested' in the records = a serious finding and possible detention.

Drill, mürettebatın acil durumlarda otom.en: Drills are the only way to make the crew respond automatically and correctly in emergencies. SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 19 requires drills at least once a month.

Drill emrini verir, performansı değerlen.en: Orders the drill and assesses performance.

Güverte ekip performansını denetler..en: Supervises the performance of the deck team.

Makine ekip performansını denetler..en: Supervises the performance of the engine-room team.

SOLAS III/19 – Drill ve eğitim gereklili.en: SOLAS III/19 – Drill and training requirements (monthly abandon ship and fire drills, enclosed space entry and rescue drills, launching of lifeboats and rescue boats)

SOLAS III/30.2 – Yolcu gemilerinde hafta.en: SOLAS III/30.2 – Weekly drills on passenger ships

ISPS Code A/13.4 – Güvenlik drilleri (en.en: ISPS Code A/13.4 – Security drills (at least every three months)

ISM Code 8 / şirket SMS'i – Oil spill (S.en: ISM Code 8 / company SMS – Additional scenarios such as oil spill (SOPEP), MOB and blackout

Aylık abandon ship drill'i yapıldı.en: Monthly abandon ship drill carried out

En az 2 ayda bir kapalı mahal giriş/kurt.en: Enclosed space entry/rescue drill at least every 2 months

En az 3 ayda bir filika suya indirildi v.en: Lifeboat launched and manoeuvred in the water at least every 3 months

Gemiye katılan personele en geç 2 hafta.en: LSA/FFE training given to personnel joining the ship within 2 weeks at the latest

Drill'leri her zaman aynı senaryoyla yap.en: Always running drills with the same scenario prepares the crew only for that scenario. Add challenging conditions such as night drills, bad-weather drills and injured-person scenarios. Real emergencies never come at a 'convenient' time.

Muster list, acil durumda kargaşayı önle.en: The muster list is the basic organisational tool that prevents confusion in an emergency. It is mandatory under SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 37.

Muster list'in hazırlanması ve onaylanma.en: Has the final responsibility for preparing and approving the muster list.

Muster list'in güncellenmesi ve asılması.en: Updating and posting the muster list.

SOLAS Bölüm III, Kural 37 – Muster list.en: SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 37 – Muster list and emergency instructions

STCW Kod A-VI/1 – Temel güvenlik eğitimi.en: STCW Code A-VI/1 – Basic safety training

Muster list güncel (son personel değişik.en: Muster list up to date (latest crew change reflected)

Alarm sinyalleri muster list'te açıklanm.en: Alarm signals explained on the muster list

Muster list'i sadece kağıt üzerinde tutm.en: Do not keep the muster list only on paper; make sure every crew member memorises THEIR OWN duty. Reading the list during a drill wastes time. Ideally, when the alarm sounds, everyone runs straight to their station.

ISM Kod uyumsuzluğu, DOC (Document of Co.en: ISM Code non-compliance can lead to the withdrawal of the DOC (Document of Compliance) and SMC (Safety Management Certificate). This means the ship is barred from trading.

Gemideki ISM sisteminin uygulanmasından.en: Has the final responsibility for implementing the ISM system on board.

ISM Code (IMO Res. A.741(18)) – Tüm bölü.en: ISM Code (IMO Res. A.741(18)) – All sections

SOLAS Bölüm IX – ISM Code uygulaması.en: SOLAS Chapter IX – Implementation of the ISM Code

SMS dokümanları son versiyon.en: SMS documents in the latest version

ISM kayıtlarını 'denetim için' değil, 'ö.en: Keep ISM records 'to learn', not 'for the audit'. Every non-conformity is a learning opportunity. A record closed without a real root cause analysis lets the same problem happen again.

ISPS Code, gemilerin terörizm ve sabotaj.en: The ISPS Code aims to protect ships against the threats of terrorism and sabotage. Non-compliance may lead to the ship being refused entry to port.

Gemide güvenliğin nihai sorumlusu..en: Has the final responsibility for security on board.

ISPS uygulamalarını koordine eder. Genel.en: Coordinates ISPS implementation. Usually an officer is designated.

ISPS Code – Part A (zorunlu) ve Part B (.en: ISPS Code – Part A (mandatory) and Part B (recommendatory)

SSAS butonunun yerini TÜM zabitler bilme.en: ALL officers must know where the SSAS button is, but it must have a protective cover so that it is not pressed by accident. The SSAS sends a silent signal in a real security threat; it is a way of calling for help without alerting the attackers.

Limanda gemi, dışarıdan gelecek tehditle.en: In port, the ship is vulnerable to external threats (theft, sabotage, stowaways, terrorism). The security watch deters and detects these threats.

Nöbet düzenini planlar ve denetler..en: Plans and supervises the watch arrangements.

Ziyaretçi defteri mevcut ve kullanılıyor.en: Visitors' log available and in use

Security watch nöbetinde uyanık kalın. G.en: Stay alert on security watch. The gangway watch can be boring at night, but stowaways usually board quietly at night. The discovery of a stowaway costs the ship thousands of dollars and causes serious legal problems.

Deniz ortamında korozyon kaçınılmazdır..en: Corrosion is unavoidable in the marine environment. Without regular painting and rust maintenance, structural strength is lost, the ship may be detained in PSC inspections and her value falls.

Boya ve bakım programının planlanmasında.en: Is responsible for planning the painting and maintenance programme.

Boya ekibini yönetir, malzeme kontrolü y.en: Manages the painting team and checks the materials.

Boya işlemini kuru ve ılık havada yapın..en: Paint in dry, mild weather. Do not paint when the relative humidity is above 85% or the surface temperature is not at least 3°C above the dew point; the paint will not adhere and will soon flake off, doubling the work.

Temiz güverte, kayma/düşme kazalarını ön.en: A clean deck prevents slips and falls, helps detect the onset of corrosion early and reflects the ship's general standard of maintenance.

Güverte yıkarken su hortumunu asla gözet.en: Never leave the water hose unattended while washing the deck; uncontrolled pressurised water can cause injury. Do not wash the deck in winter where there is a danger of freezing; ice makes the deck deadly slippery.

Kopan halat veya tel, personel için ölüm.en: A parting rope or wire is a deadly danger to personnel. If a worn rope/wire is not detected in time, a disaster can happen during mooring or cargo operations.

OCIMF MEG4 – Mooring halat/tel kriterler.en: OCIMF MEG4 – Criteria for mooring ropes/wires

Kopuk tel sayısı limit altında.en: Number of broken wires below the limit

ASLA tel halat ile sentetik halatı aynı.en: NEVER use a wire rope and a synthetic rope together on the same bollard or the same winch. Because their elasticity differs, the load is not shared equally; the stiffer wire rope takes most of the load and the risk of parting increases.

Yağlanmayan mekanik parçalar aşınır, ısı.en: Mechanical parts that are not lubricated wear, overheat and seize. A crane failure stops cargo operations; a winch failure endangers mooring safety.

Bakım kalitesini denetler..en: Supervises the quality of the maintenance.

Grease gun ile yağlarken aşırı yağlama y.en: Do not over-grease when using a grease gun. Excess grease can force the seals and cause leaks. Use the correct grease type (marine grade, water resistant); the wrong grease gives no protection against seawater.

Yetersiz güverte aydınlatması gece opera.en: Insufficient deck lighting increases the risk of accidents during night operations. It is also critical that deck lighting other than the navigation lights does not impair the OOW's night vision at sea.

Seyirde gereksiz ışıklar kapatıldı.en: Unnecessary lights switched off at sea

LED aydınlatmaya geçiş yapın. Geleneksel.en: Change over to LED lighting. Conventional halogen bulbs fail very quickly in the marine environment and use a lot of power. LEDs last 10 times longer and save energy.

Seyir fenerleri, geminin diğer gemiler t.en: Navigation lights are the basic means by which other ships recognise a ship (her type, heading and status). A defective or wrong light can lead directly to a collision.

Seyir fenerleri ve işaretlerin sorumlulu.en: Responsibility for the navigation lights and shapes.

Fener temizliği ve ampul değişimi..en: Cleaning the lights and replacing bulbs.

Fener devresi arıza tespiti..en: Fault finding in the navigation light circuits.

Fener paneli alarm testi yapıldı.en: Navigation light panel alarm test carried out

Fener arızası seyir sırasında acil durum.en: A navigation light failure at sea is an emergency. A set of spare (portable) lights must always be kept ready. Do not forget to test the 'fail-over to standby lamp' function of the light panel. On some older systems the automatic changeover may not work.

Plansız çalışma, verimsizlik, iş güvenli.en: Unplanned work leads to inefficiency, occupational safety risks and dissatisfaction among the crew. A good daily plan makes effective use of limited resources.

Günlük iş planını hazırlar ve onaylar..en: Prepares and approves the daily work plan.

İş planını güverte ekibine aktarır ve uy.en: Passes the work plan to the deck crew and manages its execution.

MLC 2006 – Çalışma saatleri düzenlemesi.en: MLC 2006 – Regulation of hours of work

İş güvenliği risk değerlendirmesi yapıld.en: Occupational safety risk assessment carried out

Çalışma saatleri MLC'ye uygun.en: Hours of work compliant with the MLC

Sabah toplantısını 5-10 dakikada tamamla.en: Finish the morning meeting in 5–10 minutes. Long meetings are inefficient. Stress the critical safety points, give clear tasks and ask 'any questions?'. Do not make plans that breach the hours of work/rest; an MLC breach is a PSC deficiency.

Doğru kişiyi doğru göreve atamak, hem em.en: Assigning the right person to the right task is critical for both safety and efficiency. Regular assessment of personnel competence is an ISM Code requirement.

Güverte personelinin yönetimi ve perform.en: Management and performance monitoring of the deck crew.

ISM Code, Bölüm 6 – Kaynaklar ve persone.en: ISM Code, Section 6 – Resources and personnel

Tecrübesiz personeli deneyimli personell.en: Pair inexperienced crew with experienced crew (buddy system). Do not give them tasks on their own. Every newcomer on board is a potential source of risk; carry out familiarisation training to really teach, not as a formality.

Disiplinsiz bir gemi, güvensiz bir gemid.en: An undisciplined ship is an unsafe ship. Establishing authority soundly directly affects both safety and team morale.

Gemideki disiplinin nihai sorumlusu..en: Has the final responsibility for discipline on board.

Güverte departmanı disiplinini izler..en: Monitors discipline in the deck department.

Makine departmanı disiplinini izler..en: Monitors discipline in the engine department.

Alkol/uyuşturucu politikası tüm personel.en: Alcohol/drug policy communicated to all personnel

Disiplin, korku ile değil SAYGI ile sağl.en: Discipline is achieved through RESPECT, not fear. Be fair, consistent and transparent. Apply the same rules to everyone. A good Master listens to the crew but does not hesitate when a decision is needed.

Denizde iş kazaları, karadaki endüstriye.en: Occupational accidents at sea happen at 2–3 times the rate of industrial accidents ashore. Effective occupational safety management saves lives.

İş güvenliği sisteminin koordinasyonu..en: Coordination of the occupational safety system.

İş sorumlusu.en: Person in charge of the work

Bosun/İş sorumlusu.en: Bosun/person in charge of the work

En tehlikeli düşünce 'bunu her zaman böy.en: The most dangerous thought is 'we always do it this way and nothing has happened'. Assess every job as if it were being done for the first time. Complacency is the biggest killer at sea.

STCW Kod A-VI/1 ve ISM Code kapsamında z.en: It is mandatory under STCW Code A-VI/1 and the ISM Code. When new personnel work without knowing the ship, the risk of accidents multiplies.

Familiarization training'in koordinasyon.en: Coordinating familiarisation training and keeping records.

Güverte personelinin görev tanıtımı..en: Introducing the deck crew to their duties.

Oryantasyonun tamamlandığını teyit eder..en: Confirms that the familiarisation has been completed.

Muster station ve görev kartı gösterildi.en: Muster station and duty card shown

Yeni personele gemideyi İLK GÜN tanıtın..en: Familiarise new crew with the ship on the FIRST DAY. If they cannot find their way in an emergency, they may lose their life. Never postpone familiarisation. Even crew who join at night must do the tour first thing the next morning at the latest.

Sürekli eğitim, yetkinliğin korunması ve.en: Continuous training is essential for maintaining and developing competence. STCW and the ISM Code require training to be planned and recorded.

Eğitim programının onayı ve genel soruml.en: Approval of and overall responsibility for the training programme.

Eğitimi sıkıcı yapmayın. Gerçek kaza rap.en: Do not make training boring. Use real accident reports (MAIB, NTSB) as discussion topics. The crew learn far more from real events. The question 'could this have happened to us?' is a powerful learning tool.

PSC denetiminde ciddi eksiklik (deficien.en: If a serious deficiency is found in a PSC inspection, the ship may be detained. This means commercial loss, higher insurance premiums and loss of the company's reputation.

PSC hazırlığının genel sorumlusu..en: Has overall responsibility for PSC preparation.

Güverte tarafı ekipman ve kayıt kontrolü.en: Check of deck equipment and records.

Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – PSC prosedürleri.en: Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – PSC procedures

IMO Res. A.1138(31) – PSC prosedürleri.en: IMO Res. A.1138(31) – Procedures for port State control (PSC)

Tüm SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW, MLC gereklilikl.en: All SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW and MLC requirements

Logbook'lar güncel ve düzgün tutulmuş.en: Logbooks up to date and properly kept

Çalışma saatleri kayıtları uygun.en: Hours of work records in order

PSC müfettişinin ilk izlenimi çok önemli.en: The PSC inspector's first impression is very important. A clean gangway, a tidy deck, a friendly welcome and documents ready reduce the likelihood of an 'expanded inspection'. If the first impression is bad, the inspector will check everything.

Logbook'lar yasal belgelerdir. Mahkemede.en: Logbooks are legal documents. They are used as evidence in court, in insurance claims and in PSC inspections.

Vardiya süresince Deck Log Book tutulmas.en: Keeping the Deck Log Book during the watch.

Oil Record Book Part II (kargo operasyon.en: Oil Record Book Part II (cargo operations, tankers) and the Cargo Record Book.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 28 – Kayıt tutma.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 28 – Records of navigational activities

Deck Log Book güncel ve imzalı.en: Deck Log Book up to date and signed

Oil Record Book güncel.en: Oil Record Book up to date

Garbage Record Book güncel.en: Garbage Record Book up to date

Oil Record Book'u doldurmaktan ASLA kaçı.en: NEVER avoid filling in the Oil Record Book. PSC inspectors pay special attention to the ORB. A blank page or inconsistent entry raises suspicion of a MARPOL violation and triggers an expanded inspection. The time and quantity of every operation must be clear.

Checklist, kritik adımların atlanmasını.en: A checklist is the most effective tool for preventing critical steps from being skipped. Adapted from the aviation industry, this system has a proven record in preventing marine accidents.

Kendi sorumluluk alanındaki checklist'le.en: Uses the checklists for their own area of responsibility.

Checklist'i 'tick box exercise' olarak y.en: Do not treat the checklist as a 'tick-box exercise'. Mark each item only after actually checking it. Skipping items because 'I already know' has caused accidents even in aviation. Checklist discipline saves lives.

Geçersiz sertifika, geminin seferden men.en: An invalid certificate means the ship is barred from trading. Certificates are checked meticulously by the flag State and PSC.

Tüm sertifikaların geçerliliğinden nihai.en: Has the final responsibility for the validity of all certificates.

Kendi alanlarına ilişkin sertifikaların.en: Follows up the certificates relating to their own areas.

SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line Convention – Se.en: SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line Convention – Certificate requirements

Sertifika geçerliliğini bir Excel tablos.en: Track certificate validity with a spreadsheet or calendar so that no survey comes as a surprise. It is particularly critical not to miss the annual endorsement windows (±3 months). A missed endorsement makes the certificate invalid.

Etkin raporlama, kara ile gemi arasındak.en: Effective reporting keeps communication between ship and shore working properly and ensures ISM Code compliance.

Tüm raporlamanın doğruluğu ve zamanlamas.en: Is responsible for the accuracy and timing of all reporting.

Voyage raporu sefer sonunda tamamlanıyor.en: Voyage report completed at the end of the voyage

Noon report'taki verilerin DOĞRU olduğun.en: Make sure the data in the noon report are CORRECT. Under-reporting fuel consumption to 'make it look good' leads to serious problems later (charter party disputes, CII calculation errors). Report the real data.

Kapatılmayan deficiency, follow-up inspe.en: A deficiency that is not closed increases the risk of a follow-up inspection and detention. The ship's risk profile also rises and inspections become more frequent.

Güverte tarafı deficiency takibi ve düze.en: Following up and rectifying deck-side deficiencies.

Makine tarafı deficiency takibi ve düzel.en: Following up and rectifying engine-side deficiencies.

Genel takip ve şirket ile koordinasyon..en: Overall follow-up and coordination with the company.

Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – Deficiency kodla.en: Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – Deficiency codes and procedures

Deficiency'yi sadece 'kapatmak' için değ.en: Work to really RECTIFY a deficiency, not just to 'close' it. If you make a superficial fix without a root cause analysis, the same deficiency will be written again at the next inspection. A repeated deficiency is a red flag for the inspector.

Yangın, geminin kaybına, personel ölümün.en: Fire can lead to the loss of the ship, the death of personnel and environmental disaster. A fast, organised response saves lives.

Genel alarm kararı, koordinasyon, dış il.en: Decision on the general alarm, coordination, external communications (MAYDAY if required).

Yangın ekibi liderliği, müdahale koordin.en: Leading the fire team, coordinating the response.

Yangın ekibi üyesi, BA seti ile müdahale.en: Member of the fire team, responds with a BA set.

STCW Kod A-VI/1 ve A-VI/3 – Yangınla müc.en: STCW Code A-VI/1 and A-VI/3 – Fire-fighting training

Yangın ekibi BA ile olay yerine gitti.en: Fire team proceeded to the scene with BA

Yangın ilk 5 dakikada söndürülmezse kont.en: If a fire is not extinguished in the first 5 minutes, the risk of it getting out of control multiplies. That is why the first response (the nearest extinguisher) is vital. Every crew member must know where the nearest extinguisher is and be able to use it. DO NOT enter a smoke-filled area without BA – CO poisoning kills within a few breaths.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 33.1 – Denizde tehl.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 33.1 – Rendering assistance to persons in distress at sea is mandatory under international law.

Manevra, koordinasyon, MRCC ile iletişim.en: Manoeuvring, coordination, communication with the MRCC.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 33.1 – Yardım yüküm.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 33.1 – Obligation to render assistance

STCW Kod A-VI/1 – Kişisel kurtarma tekni.en: STCW Code A-VI/1 – Personal survival techniques

Soğuk suda kurtarılan kişileri YATAY ola.en: Bring people rescued from cold water on board HORIZONTALLY. Lifting vertically can cause sudden cardiac arrest in a hypothermic casualty (circum-rescue collapse). Never forget this critical point in cold-water rescue.

Denize düşen kişinin hayatta kalma süres.en: The survival time of a person in the water depends on the water temperature. In cold water it is limited to minutes. A fast and correct response saves lives.

Can simidi atma, gözle takip..en: Throwing the lifebuoy, keeping the person in sight.

Williamson Turn: Dümen tam bir tarafa ba.en: Williamson turn: put the rudder hard over to one side → after 60° of turn, put the rudder hard over to the other side → when steadying on the reciprocal of the original course, put the rudder amidships. This manoeuvre brings the ship back along her original track. The initial turn is made towards the side the person fell from (fell from starboard → hard a-starboard).

Çatışma, su alma, yangın, çevre kirliliğ.en: A collision can lead to flooding, fire, pollution and loss of life. The right decisions in the first minutes determine the outcome.

Pompa operasyonu, makine durumu izleme..en: Pump operation, monitoring of the machinery.

COLREG Kural 8 – Çatışmayı önleme manevr.en: COLREG Rule 8 – Action to avoid collision

Deniz Hukuku – Çatışma sonrası sorumlulu.en: Maritime law – Responsibilities after a collision

Çatışma sonrası gemileri birbirinden HEM.en: Do NOT separate the ships IMMEDIATELY after a collision. Sometimes the other ship's bow is plugging your damaged area; once separated, flooding may speed up. The damage must be assessed first. Also, the VDR record of the incident is legal evidence – DO NOT tamper with the VDR.

Karaya oturma, gövde hasarı, çevre kirli.en: A grounding can lead to hull damage, pollution and loss of the ship. The wrong response (immediately going astern off) can increase the damage.

Makine durumu, yakıt transferi, pompa op.en: Machinery status, fuel transfer, pump operation.

Karaya oturduktan sonra ASLA ana makiney.en: After grounding, NEVER go full astern on the main engine. The propeller wash draws sand and mud from the seabed into the cooling water inlets (sea chest blockage), and the risk of propeller damage is high. Wait for the tide and professional assistance.

Abandon ship, son çare olarak uygulanır..en: Abandoning ship is the last resort. Many cases in maritime history show the fatal consequences of abandoning too early or too late.

Abandon ship kararı, son MAYDAY, en son.en: Decision to abandon ship, the last MAYDAY, last to leave.

Makine güvenliğe alma, son personel kont.en: Securing the machinery, final personnel check.

Tüm personel gemiyi terk etti.en: All personnel have left the ship

Denize atlamak ZORUNLU kalmadıkça yapılm.en: Do not jump into the sea unless you HAVE TO. Jumping from more than 5 metres above the water can cause serious injury. If you must jump: do not inflate an inflatable lifejacket (it can strike you under the chin), keep your feet down, hold your nose with one hand and grip the lifejacket with the other. Inflate it once in the water and swim away from the ship.

Denizde hastane yoktur. İlk yardım ve te.en: There is no hospital at sea. First aid and telemedicine (remote medical advice) save lives. Depending on the case, the ship's route may be changed or a helicopter evacuation requested.

Tıbbi kararlar (TMAS ile koordineli), ro.en: Medical decisions (in coordination with TMAS), change of route, decision on evacuation.

ILO C164 – Denizcilerin sağlık koruması.en: ILO C164 – Health protection of seafarers

IMO MSC/Circ.960 – Tıbbi ilk yardım kıla.en: IMO MSC/Circ.960 – Medical first aid guide

Her gemide en az bir kişi Medical First.en: Every ship must have at least one person trained in medical first aid (STCW). EVERYONE should be able to use the AED (automated external defibrillator); it is not complicated, the device gives spoken instructions. Defibrillation within the first 3 minutes of cardiac arrest raises the chance of survival to 70%.

Deniz kirliliği ağır para cezaları, gemi.en: Pollution of the sea leads to heavy fines, detention of the ship and loss of the company's reputation. Under MARPOL Annex I, all oil spills must be reported.

Oil spill müdahale koordinasyonu. SOPEP.en: Coordination of the oil spill response. Implementing the SOPEP.

Makine tarafı sızıntı kontrolü..en: Checking for leaks on the engine-room side.

MARPOL Ek I – Petrol kirliliğinin önlenm.en: MARPOL Annex I – Prevention of pollution by oil

OPRC Convention – Petrol kirliliğine haz.en: OPRC Convention – Oil pollution preparedness and response

SOPEP – Gemi Yağ Kirliliği Acil Planı.en: SOPEP – Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan

Sızıntı kaynağı tespit ve durduruldu.en: Source of the leak identified and stopped

Oil Record Book'a kayıt yapıldı.en: Entry made in the Oil Record Book

SOPEP'i okumadan rafa kaldırmayın. Oil s.en: Do not shelve the SOPEP without reading it. Searching for the contact list in a panic during an oil spill wastes time. Update the coastal State contact details in the SOPEP AT EVERY PORT ENTRY. Scupper plugs must always be in an accessible place.

Ana makine, geminin hareket yeteneğini s.en: The main engine is the essential equipment that gives the ship her ability to move. Its failure directly threatens navigational safety and can result in a blackout.

Ana makine operasyonunun genel sorumlulu.en: Overall responsibility for main engine operation.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Makine ve elektrik te.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Machinery and electrical installations

Exhaust temp silinderler arası fark kabu.en: Difference in exhaust temperature between cylinders acceptable

Exhaust temperature sapması (bir silindi.en: An exhaust temperature deviation (one cylinder 50°C+ different from the others) is an early warning: it points to an injector fault, a leaking valve or a piston ring problem. Ignoring it invites major damage.

Yardımcı makineler geminin elektrik, hav.en: Auxiliary machinery supplies the ship's electricity, air and water. Its failure leads to a blackout or the loss of critical systems.

Yardımcı makine bakım programının koordi.en: Coordination of the auxiliary machinery maintenance programme.

Yardımcı makinelerin bakımını ertelemeyi.en: Do not postpone auxiliary machinery maintenance. The 'it works, don't touch it' approach is one of the most dangerous attitudes at sea. Keep to the maintenance hours in the PMS; postponed maintenance brings the failure at the worst possible moment.

Balast operasyonu, stabilite ve yapısal.en: Ballast operations are directly related to stability and structural strength. A faulty ballast operation can lead to the loss of the ship. Biological invasion is also controlled under the BWM Convention.

Balast operasyonunun genel sorumluluğu..en: Overall responsibility for the ballast operation.

Stabilite hesabı ve balast planı onayı..en: Stability calculation and approval of the ballast plan.

Ballast Water Record Book dolduruldu.en: Ballast Water Record Book filled in

Balast operasyonunu ASLA gözetimsiz bıra.en: NEVER leave a ballast operation unattended. A tank overflow causes pollution and a deck safety hazard. Always allow for the slack tank (free surface) effect; partly filled tanks seriously reduce stability.

Bunkering sırasında yakıt sızıntısı, çev.en: Fuel spills during bunkering are one of the most common causes of pollution. Bunkering is subject to strict rules under MARPOL Annex I.

Bunkering operasyonunun genel sorumluluğ.en: Overall responsibility for the bunkering operation.

Manifold başında gözetim ve tank izleme..en: Supervision at the manifold and tank monitoring.

MARPOL Ek I – Yakıt sızıntısı önleme.en: MARPOL Annex I – Prevention of fuel spills

MARPOL Ek VI – Yakıt kalitesi (sülfür li.en: MARPOL Annex VI – Fuel quality (sulphur limit)

Bunkering sırasında ASLA gözetimsiz bıra.en: NEVER leave bunkering unattended. Someone must be at the manifold at all times. The thought 'no leak, no problem' is a recipe for disaster. Keep the fuel samples for 12 months – they are your legal evidence in a fuel quality dispute.

Jeneratör arızası blackout'a yol açar. B.en: A generator failure causes a blackout. A blackout means the loss of propulsion, steering, fire pumps and emergency systems. At sea this can be fatal.

Jeneratör operasyonunun planlanması ve k.en: Planning and coordination of generator operation.

Senkronizasyon sırasında synchroscope ib.en: During synchronisation, the synchroscope pointer must turn SLOWLY CLOCKWISE. Closing the breaker while it turns anticlockwise leads to a reverse power trip and damage to the generator. Do not rush; match the frequency gently.

Yakıt transferi sırasında taşma, sızıntı.en: Overflows, leaks and choosing the wrong tank during fuel transfer are among the most common causes of oil spills. They can result in a MARPOL violation and heavy fines.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Yakıt sistemi güvenli.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Safety of fuel systems

Tank kapasiteleri ve mevcut seviyeler ko.en: Tank capacities and present levels checked

Oil Record Book'a kaydedildi.en: Entered in the Oil Record Book

Yakıt transferini ASLA yatmadan önce baş.en: NEVER start a fuel transfer and leave it before going to bed. In an overflow the alarm may not work or may not be heard. A responsible person must be designated to monitor the transfer. Do not forget to close the scuppers.

Yağlama yetersizliği, yatak yanması, pis.en: Insufficient lubrication leads directly to bearing failure, piston seizure and machinery damage. A drop in LO pressure is one of the most critical alarms and requires immediate action.

Yağlama sistemi yönetimi ve analiz takib.en: Management of the lubrication system and follow-up of analyses.

Günlük kontroller, filtre temizliği, yağ.en: Daily checks, filter cleaning, topping up oil.

LO analizinde TBN (Total Base Number) de.en: In an LO analysis, a TBN (Total Base Number) below 20 shows that the oil's capacity to neutralise acids has decreased. This is critical with high-sulphur fuels; a low TBN leads to liner corrosion.

Yetersiz soğutma, aşırı ısınma, termal s.en: Insufficient cooling leads to overheating, thermal stress and machinery damage. If cooling water leaks into a cylinder, a hydraulic lock forms and the connecting rod may break.

Jacket water sıcaklığının ani yükselmesi.en: A sudden rise in jacket water temperature may indicate a thermostat fault, pump cavitation or an air lock. A falling expansion tank level indicates a leak; if the leak is into a cylinder, the consequences are disastrous.

Sintine yönetimi MARPOL Ek I'in en sıkı.en: Bilge management is the most strictly inspected subject of MARPOL Annex I. An OWS bypass or discharge of dirty bilge water can result in severe criminal penalties and imprisonment.

Sintine seviye takibi ve pompa operasyon.en: Monitoring bilge levels and operating the pumps.

MARPOL Ek I, Kural 14 – Yağlı su deşarjı.en: MARPOL Annex I, Regulations 14–15 – Oil filtering equipment and control of discharge of oil (15 ppm)

Oil Record Book Part I güncel.en: Oil Record Book Part I up to date

OWS'yi ASLA bypass etmeyin. 'Magic pipe'.en: NEVER bypass the OWS. The use of a 'magic pipe' has resulted in some of the heaviest penalties in maritime history. If detected in US ports, it leads to fines of millions of dollars and prison sentences. If the 15 ppm alarm is not working properly, do not use the system; discharge to a port reception facility.

Temizlenmemiş yakıt, enjektör tıkanması,.en: Uncleaned fuel leads to injector blockage, excessive wear and machinery damage. When cat fines (Al+Si) exceed 15 ppm, damage to liners and piston rings is unavoidable.

LO separator operasyonu ve sludge tank t.en: LO separator operation and sludge tank monitoring.

Separator'ü tam kapasitede çalıştırmayın.en: Do not run the separator at full capacity; running at 50–70% capacity improves separation efficiency dramatically. If there is a cat fines problem, connect two separators in series (purifier + clarifier). If the wrong gravity disc is selected, the oil–water interface shifts and no separation takes place.

Kazan patlaması denizcilik tarihinin en.en: Boiler explosions are among the deadliest accidents in maritime history. A low water level or a safety valve failure has disastrous consequences.

Kazan operasyonunun planlanması ve bakım.en: Planning of boiler operation and coordination of maintenance.

Günlük operasyon, su testi ve blowdown..en: Daily operation, water testing and blowdown.

Su seviyesi gauge glass ile kontrol edil.en: Water level checked with the gauge glass

Kazan su seviyesini ASLA gauge glass olm.en: NEVER monitor the boiler water level without the gauge glass. Electronic level indicators can fail. A spare glass must be ready in case the gauge glass bursts. It is vital not to skip the pre-purge; an accumulation of unburnt fuel leads to a furnace explosion.

Başlatma havası olmadan ana makine çalış.en: The main engine cannot be started without starting air. Lack of starting capacity in an emergency directly threatens the safety of the ship. Class rules, rather than SOLAS, require a capacity of at least 12 consecutive starts (reversible engines).

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Başlatma havası gerek.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Starting air requirements

Hava şişelerini drenaj etmeyi ihmal etme.en: Do not neglect draining the air receivers. Accumulated moisture enters the cylinders through the starting air line and causes corrosion and damage to the starting valves. Drain daily and always keep at least two air receivers full.

Pompalar geminin damar sistemidir. Yakıt.en: Pumps are the ship's circulatory system. The fuel, cooling, lubrication, ballast, bilge, fire and cargo systems all depend on pumps.

Pompa bakım programının planlanması..en: Planning of the pump maintenance programme.

PMS bakım kayıtları güncel.en: PMS maintenance records up to date

Santrifüj pompayı kuru çalıştırmak, mech.en: Running a centrifugal pump dry burns out the mechanical seal within seconds. Before starting the pump, make sure the suction valve is open and the pump has been vented. If you hear cavitation noise (like gravel), stop it immediately.

Elektrik arızası blackout'a yol açar. Bl.en: An electrical failure leads to a blackout. A blackout at sea means the loss of steering, radar, ECDIS and fire pumps.

Elektrik sistemi bakım ve arıza gidermes.en: Maintenance and fault finding of the electrical system.

Elektrik sistemi yönetim sorumluluğu..en: Responsibility for managing the electrical system.

Switchboard üzerinde çalışırken ASLA tek.en: NEVER work on a switchboard alone. Someone must be watching and must know where the emergency stop is. The risk of arc flash is life-threatening. Wear suitable PPE (arc flash suit, insulated gloves).

Modern gemilerin büyük çoğunluğu UMS (Un.en: Most modern ships are of the UMS (Unattended Machinery Space) class. An automation failure makes it necessary to keep the engine room under continuous watch and increases the workload of the crew.

Otomasyon sistemi genel sorumluluğu..en: Overall responsibility for the automation system.

Sensor, PLC ve kontrol sistemi bakımı..en: Maintenance of sensors, PLCs and control systems.

Alarm yorgunluğu (alarm fatigue) ciddi b.en: Alarm fatigue is a serious risk. Constantly sounding nuisance alarms cause a real critical alarm to be missed. Fix the root cause instead of suppressing unnecessary alarms. An 'accepted alarm' policy should be written under the ISM system.

Denizde yedek parça bulunamaz. Kritik bi.en: Spare parts cannot be found at sea. The lack of a critical spare part means a machinery failure that cannot be resolved, and off-hire.

Yedek parça bütçesi ve genel yönetim..en: Spare parts budget and overall management.

Envanter takibi ve sipariş koordinasyonu.en: Inventory control and coordination of orders.

IMPA katalog numaralarını doğru kullanın.en: Use the IMPA catalogue numbers correctly. A wrong part number means the wrong part arrives and weeks of waiting. Keep at least one extra set of critical spare parts (injectors, piston rings, gasket sets).

Engine Log Book, makine performansının t.en: The Engine Log Book is the history of machinery performance. It is a critical document in PSC inspections, failure analysis and legal disputes.

Engine Log Book'un doğruluğu ve kontrolü.en: Accuracy and checking of the Engine Log Book.

Vardiya süresince kayıtları tutar..en: Keeps the records during the watch.

C/E kontrolü ve imzası.en: Checked and signed by the C/E

Engine Log Book'taki exhaust temperature.en: Monitor the exhaust temperature data in the Engine Log Book as a trend. A gradual rise in one cylinder's temperature over weeks lets you detect injector wear or an exhaust valve leak early.

PMS, ISM Code Bölüm 10 gereği zorunludur.en: A PMS is mandatory under ISM Code Section 10. PMS records are examined in detail in PSC inspections. Missing or falsified records are a reason for deficiencies and detention.

Kendi sorumluluk alanlarındaki bakım işl.en: Carry out the maintenance in their own areas of responsibility and keep records.

Bakım programı güncel ve takip ediliyor.en: Maintenance programme up to date and being followed

PMS kayıtlarını 'yapmış gibi' doldurmak.en: Filling in PMS records 'as if done' is the most dangerous habit. PSC inspectors can verify by physical inspection whether maintenance recorded as 'done' in the PMS was really done. Falsified records are an ISM major non-conformity.

LO analizi erken arıza teşhisi sağlar (m.en: LO analysis allows early fault diagnosis (metal particles show bearing wear, water contamination shows a leak). FO analysis verifies that the fuel quality complies with MARPOL and ISO 8217.

Analiz programı ve sonuç değerlendirmesi.en: Analysis programme and evaluation of results.

MARPOL Ek VI – Yakıt sülfür limiti.en: MARPOL Annex VI – Fuel sulphur limit

LO numuneleri planlanan aralıkta alındı.en: LO samples taken at the planned intervals

FO numunesi her bunkering'de alındı.en: FO sample taken at every bunkering

Limit aşımı varsa aksiyon alındı.en: Action taken if a limit was exceeded

LO analizinde demir (Fe) partikül miktar.en: A sudden increase in iron (Fe) particles in an LO analysis is an early warning of bearing or liner wear. A rising trend shows that serious damage may occur soon. Monitor analysis results as a TREND; look at the trend, not at a single result.

Kirli makine dairesi yangın riskini artı.en: A dirty engine room increases the fire risk (oil deposits + hot surfaces = fire), makes leaks harder to detect and leaves a bad impression in PSC inspections.

Temiz makine dairesi = güvenli makine da.en: A clean engine room = a safe engine room. When a PSC inspector enters the engine room, the first impression is very important. A dirty, untidy engine room gives the impression that maintenance is poor too and triggers a detailed inspection. In addition, oil-soaked lagging on a hot exhaust manifold can catch fire.
