Blackout durumunda acil aydınlatma, seyi.en: In a blackout, the emergency generator, which supplies the emergency lighting, navigation lights, GMDSS, steering gear and fire pumps, is vital equipment. Under SOLAS it must come on line automatically within 45 seconds.

Emergency generator bakım ve test soruml.en: Responsibility for maintaining and testing the emergency generator.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 44 – Acil güç ka.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 43 – Emergency source of electrical power in cargo ships

Emergency generator testini GERÇEKTEN ya.en: REALLY test the emergency generator. A 'start and stop' is not enough in the weekly test; run it for at least 10 minutes and monitor the parameters. In the 6-monthly test, transfer real load to the emergency switchboard. Testing it only at no load does not prevent it from failing under load.

Dümen arızası, geminin manevra kabiliyet.en: A steering failure means the ship loses her manoeuvrability. SOLAS requires a steering test before every voyage, and it is checked in PSC inspections.

Steering gear bakım ve test sorumluluğu..en: Responsibility for maintaining and testing the steering gear.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 26 – Dümen testi ge.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 26 – Steering gear testing requirements

SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 29 – Steering ge.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 29 – Steering gear requirements

Steering gear odasını düzenli ziyaret ed.en: Visit the steering gear room regularly. A hydraulic oil leak can be seen before the pressure drops. If a small leak is repaired before it grows, loss of steering at sea is prevented. ALL officers must know the way to the steering gear room.

Makine dairesi, geminin en tehlikeli çal.en: The engine room is the most dangerous working area on the ship: high temperatures, pressurised systems, rotating parts, noise, chemicals and enclosed-space risks all come together.

Makine dairesi güvenliğinin genel soruml.en: Overall responsibility for engine room safety.

PTW düzenlendi (gerekli işler için).en: PTW issued (for jobs that require it)

İlk yardım malzemesi makine dairesinde m.en: First aid supplies available in the engine room

Lock-out/Tag-out hayat kurtarır. Bakım s.en: Lock-out/tag-out saves lives. The thought during maintenance that 'it will be done in a minute, no need to lock it' is the most common way hands and fingers are lost. Isolate the machinery, lock it and keep your own key in your pocket. DO NOT allow anyone else to remove the lock on your behalf.

Uluslararası deniz taşımacılığında can e.en: Sets the basic requirements for the safety of life in international shipping; covers standards for ship construction, equipment, operation and certification. First adopted in 1914 after the Titanic disaster, SOLAS is the most important convention in maritime history and is continually updated.

Gemilerden kaynaklanan deniz kirliliğini.en: Sets international standards for the prevention of marine pollution from ships; its six annexes regulate oil, noxious liquid substances, harmful substances in packaged form, sewage, garbage and air emissions. MARPOL 73/78 is the cornerstone of marine environmental protection.

MARPOL'ün kökeni 1954 OILPOL sözleşmesin.en: MARPOL has its origins in the 1954 OILPOL Convention. After the 1967 Torrey Canyon accident, IMO began preparing a comprehensive pollution prevention convention; the convention adopted in 1973 was combined with the 1978 Protocol and became known as MARPOL 73/78. Annex VI (air pollution) was added by the 1997 Protocol. Today its 6 annexes cover all types of pollution from ships.

Tüm uluslararası sefer yapan gemiler (bo.en: All ships on international voyages (subject to the relevant annexes regardless of size and type)

Ek I: 150 GT üzeri tankerler ve 400 GT ü.en: Annex I: oil tankers of 150 GT and above and other ships of 400 GT and above

Ek II: Zararlı sıvı madde taşıyan tüm ge.en: Annex II: all ships carrying noxious liquid substances

Ek III: Ambalajlı zararlı madde taşıyan.en: Annex III: ships carrying harmful substances in packaged form

Ek IV: 400 GT üzeri gemiler veya 15'ten.en: Annex IV: ships of 400 GT and above, or ships certified to carry more than 15 persons

Ek VI: 400 GT üzeri gemiler (EEXI/CII: 5.en: Annex VI: ships of 400 GT and above (CII: 5,000 GT and above)

Ek I: Petrol kirliliği – IOPP sertifikas.en: Annex I: oil pollution – IOPP Certificate, ORB, OWS (15 ppm), SOPEP, double-hull requirement for tankers

Ek II: Zararlı sıvı maddeler (NLS) – kat.en: Annex II: noxious liquid substances (NLS) – categorisation (X, Y, Z, OS), P&A Manual, Cargo Record Book

Ek III: Ambalajlı zararlı maddeler – IMD.en: Annex III: harmful substances in packaged form – marking and documentation with reference to the IMDG Code

Ek IV: Kanalizasyon – sewage treatment p.en: Annex IV: sewage – sewage treatment plant, discharge criteria (12 miles from land, 4 knots speed)

Ek V: Çöp yönetimi – Garbage Record Book.en: Annex V: garbage management – Garbage Record Book, Garbage Management Plan, discharge prohibitions and exceptions

Ek VI: Hava kirliliği – SOx limiti (%0.5.en: Annex VI: air pollution – SOx limit (0.50% global, 0.10% ECA), NOx Tier I-II-III, EEXI, CII, SEEMP

ORB Part I ve II, Cargo Record Book ve G.en: Keep complete ORB Part I and II, Cargo Record Book and Garbage Record Book entries

An ECA under Annex VI sets separate emission limits for SOx/particulate matter and/or NOx.

Bir deşarj kararı en az altı soruyu yanı.en: A discharge decision answers at least six questions: which annex/category the substance falls under, what status the ship and equipment have, whether the ship is en route, what the position/nearest land and special area status are, whether the treatment/comminution/monitoring requirements are met, and whether there is a stricter flag/port/company prohibition. A single distance figure does not replace this tree.

Safe operation means a correct suction/overboard valve line-up, a clean sample line, a calibrated alarm, seal/bypass integrity and tracking of the actual throughput. Testing only the alarm with fresh water does not on its own prove the oily water separation performance.

A tank balance cannot be negative; the quantity of sludge generated must bear a reasonable relationship to fuel consumption and purifier performance. Incineration, burning in the boiler or delivery ashore each require their own supporting evidence.

Crude Oil Washing, uygulanabilir tankerl.en: On applicable tankers, Crude Oil Washing is carried out with the approved COW Operations and Equipment Manual, inert gas conditions, a washing programme and competent personnel. A wrong tank sequence or an inadequate inert atmosphere combines the pollution risk with a fire/explosion risk.

ORB Part II cargo loading/unloading, int.en: ORB Part II records cargo loading/unloading, internal transfer, tank cleaning, ballast, slop and discharge operations. Cargo figures, the ullage report, terminal statement, ODME printout and slop soundings must be reconciled on the same timeline. A charter/terminal quantity difference is not a reason to change a MARPOL entry contrary to the facts.

Baş zabit cargo planında her residue/bal.en: Before the operation, the Chief Officer should mark on the cargo plan the source and destination tanks of each residue/ballast stream and the relevant ORB Part II code.

ODME printout'u gözden geçirmeden dosyal.en: Filing the ODME printout without reviewing it

Slop miktarını cargo outturn'a uydurmak.en: Adjusting the slop quantity to fit the cargo outturn

SOPEP; petrol kirliliği olayı veya tehdi.en: The SOPEP arranges, specifically for the ship, the reporting, on-board control, shore contacts and national/local coordination in an oil pollution incident or threat. Where appropriate, a combined plan covering Annex II can be used in SMPEP form. If the shore contact annexes are not up to date, the plan will not save time in an emergency.

İlk öncelik insan ve gemi emniyetidir; k.en: The first priority is the safety of people and the ship; stopping the source, tank transfer, scuppers/containment, overboard valve control and a safe deck response are planned simultaneously. The ship cannot decide on its own to use dispersants or chemicals; authorised shore approval and the environmental conditions are required.

Bildirimde tahminî miktar belirsiz olabi.en: The estimated quantity in the report may be uncertain; this is no reason to delay the initial report. The position, time, substance, incident, weather/sea, measures taken and assistance required are given and updated as they are confirmed. Evidence such as photographs, samples, logs and VDR/CCTV is preserved securely.

Tatbikat yalnız boom sermek değil; gerçe.en: A drill is not just deploying a boom; it should also test the simulated reporting and decision authority against the real shore contact list.

Kesin miktarı bekleyip ilk bildirimi gec.en: Delaying the initial report while waiting for the exact quantity

SOPEP içindeki eski telefon listesini ge.en: Treating the old telephone list in the SOPEP as valid

Machinery-space ve tanker kayıt rejimler.en: The machinery-space and tanker record regimes are separate.

15 ppm/ODME cihazı boru hattı ve kayıtla.en: The 15 ppm/ODME device is verified together with the piping and the records.

İlk kirlilik bildirimi erken yapılır, ve.en: The initial pollution report is made early and the data are updated later.

Annex II: dökme zararlı sıvı maddeler.en: Annex II: noxious liquid substances in bulk

Annex II, ürünün deniz çevresine tehlike.en: Annex II links the hazard of a product to the marine environment with the ship's tank/stripping capability and the port reception arrangements; no discharge decision can be made until the product name has been correctly established.

X, Y, Z ve Other Substances kategorileri.en: Categories X, Y, Z and Other Substances

Noxious Liquid Substances; Category X, Y.en: Noxious Liquid Substances are classified as Category X, Y, Z or Other Substances. X requires the strictest control because of the most serious hazard to marine resources/human health, while Y and Z represent decreasing but real hazard levels. Although OS fall outside these categories for Annex II purposes, they are not exempt from other MARPOL, SOLAS or local obligations.

Doğru product name ve pollution category.en: The correct product name and pollution category are verified through the IBC Code product list, the MEPC circular/list and the Certificate of Fitness. A trade name or SDS alone is not the authoritative carriage name. If the composition of a mixture changes, the category and carriage requirements are reassessed.

Prewash, stripping, ventilation veya rec.en: Whether prewash, stripping, ventilation or a reception facility is mandatory depends, besides the category, on high-viscosity/solidifying properties, the unloading port, special area and the approved procedure. A general 'pump it out beyond 12 miles' approach wrongly simplifies the Annex II decision tree.

Cargo plan her ürün için pollution categ.en: The cargo plan should include, for each product, columns for pollution category, tank, stripping limit, prewash/reception and discharge method.

Trade name ile kategori seçmek.en: Choosing the category by trade name

OS ürününü hiçbir çevre kuralına tabi de.en: Thinking an OS product is not subject to any environmental rule

Onaylı Procedures and Arrangements Manua.en: The approved Procedures and Arrangements Manual defines the unloading, stripping, tank washing, residue transfer and discharge method according to the ship's tank/piping geometry. Rather than a general Annex II summary, this ship-specific manual is the governing document for the valve line-up and sequence on site.

Efficient stripping, tankta kalan residu.en: Efficient stripping aims to reduce the residue remaining in the tank to the approved performance limit. The stripping result can be affected by pump/line condition, trim/list, temperature/viscosity and correct terminal back-pressure. Even if the sequence has been completed on paper, if there is high residue or line content, the prewash/reception decision changes.

Cargo Record Book; loading, internal tra.en: The Cargo Record Book records operations such as loading, internal transfer, unloading, prewash, tank cleaning, residue discharge and accidental discharge by tank and product. It must reconcile with the terminal prewash receipt, cargo figures, tank washing log and slop/reception quantity.

Baş zabit operasyon öncesi P&A Manual'da.en: Before the operation, the Chief Officer should go through the actual tank/line sequence in the P&A Manual with the team and the terminal in a toolbox briefing.

Önceki ürünün checklist'ini yeni ürüne k.en: Copying the checklist of the previous product to the new product

Stripping performansını yalnız pompa çal.en: Proving stripping performance only with a 'pump running' entry

Tahliye sonrası tankta beklenenden fazla.en: After discharge, more product than expected remains in the tank; the terminal does not want to accept a prewash and suggests the ship washes at sea.

Kategori, ürün özelliği, liman/reception.en: A decision to discharge at sea cannot be made until the category, product properties, port/reception and P&A Manual conditions are complete. A commercial refusal does not remove a legal obligation.

Operasyon durdurulur; bayrak/liman/şirke.en: The operation is stopped; a suitable reception/prewash solution is set up and documented with the flag/port/company and the terminal. The tank/line quantity and all communications are preserved in the Cargo Record Book supporting records.

Ürün adı ve pollution category kararın b.en: The product name and pollution category are the starting point of the decision.

P&A Manual gemiye özgü operasyon sırasın.en: The P&A Manual sets the ship-specific operational sequence.

Terminal kısıtı Annex II zorunluluğunu o.en: A terminal restriction does not remove an Annex II obligation.

Annex III: paketli zararlı maddeler ve I.en: Annex III: harmful substances in packaged form and the IMDG link

Annex III deniz kirletici maddeleri pack.en: Annex III controls marine pollutants in packaged forms of carriage such as packages, freight containers, portable tanks or road/rail tank wagons, through the detailed system of the IMDG Code.

Marine pollutant sınıflandırması, paketl.en: Marine pollutant classification, packaging and documentation

Bir maddenin harmful substance sayılması.en: Whether a substance is a harmful substance is determined by the marine pollutant criteria and lists in the IMDG Code. The UN number, proper shipping name, class/subsidiary risk, packing group and marine pollutant status are declared together. The SDS is a useful supporting document; it does not replace the signed dangerous goods transport document.

Package tipi, test/UN approval mark, qua.en: The package type, test/UN approval mark, quantity limit, closure and condition must suit the product. The marine pollutant mark, class label, UN number and cargo transport unit placards communicate the hazard correctly from the outside. A faded mark or one placed on the wrong surface makes the information invisible to the emergency team.

Dokümanda paket sayısı/tipi, toplam mikt.en: The document contains the number/type of packages, the total quantity and the correct shipping description; the shipper's declaration and the container/vehicle packing certificate document responsibility in the process. The manifest/stowage plan shows the location of dangerous goods on board in a way that is accessible in an emergency.

Yük kabulünde belge, dış paket işareti v.en: When accepting cargo, the document, the outer package marking and the planned stowage position should be checked on the same sample.

Marine pollutant mark'ı primary hazard l.en: Taking the marine pollutant mark for the primary hazard label

SDS ile eksik shipper declaration'ı kapa.en: Making up for a missing shipper's declaration with the SDS

Stowage, segregation, kayıp/hasar ve aci.en: Stowage, segregation, loss/damage and emergency response

IMDG stowage category, segregation group.en: IMDG stowage categories, segregation groups and provisions such as 'away from'/'separated from' limit the escalation of reactions, fire and toxic exposure. Relationships with foodstuffs, accommodation, heat sources and ignition sources are also checked. Even if the container planning software gives no warning, the current IMDG edition and the scope of the ship's Document of Compliance are verified.

Hasarlı/leaking package'da ilk hedef per.en: With a damaged/leaking package, the first aim is the safety of personnel and the ship. The area is isolated according to the EmS, MFAG, SDS and the company emergency plan, suitable PPE/monitoring is used and spreading overboard is prevented. Repacking or jettisoning is considered only with authority and under conditions of necessity; the incident and lost packages are reported through the appropriate channels.

Dangerous goods manifest, köprüüstü ve a.en: The dangerous goods manifest should be kept ready in a controlled arrangement that the bridge and emergency teams can reach before abandoning the ship.

Yazılımın kabulünü hukukî uygunluk onayı.en: Treating acceptance by the software as confirmation of legal compliance

Dökülen ürünü yıkayarak scupper'a yönlen.en: Washing spilled product towards the scuppers

Marine pollutant konteynerinde sızıntı.en: Leak from a marine pollutant container

Güverte turunda konteyner kapısından sıv.en: During a deck round, liquid is seen coming from a container door; the manifest lists the product as class 8 and a marine pollutant.

Yaklaşma, bilinmeyen buhar/reaksiyon ve.en: Approaching carries the risk of unknown vapour/reaction and spreading into the sea. Washing with water can escalate the environmental incident.

Alarm/alan izolasyonu, EmS/MFAG ve uzman.en: Alarm/area isolation is carried out and PPE/monitoring are selected with the EmS/MFAG and expert support; the scuppers are protected, the leak is safely contained and notifications to the Master/company/shore are started.

Annex III ayrıntılarını IMDG Code operas.en: The IMDG Code puts the details of Annex III into operation.

Belge, paket ve stow position aynı yükü.en: The document, the package and the stowage position must show the same cargo.

Sızıntıda personel güvenliği ile denize.en: In a leak, personnel safety and spreading into the sea are controlled together.

Annex IV: pis su sistemleri ve kontrollü.en: Annex IV: sewage systems and controlled discharge

Annex IV, sewage'ı onaylı arıtma tesisi,.en: Annex IV manages sewage with the options of an approved treatment plant, a comminuting/disinfecting system or a holding tank; the choice of system changes the discharge conditions and the record-keeping/operation on board.

Sewage tanımı, sertifika ve sistem bütün.en: Definition of sewage, certificate and system integrity

Sewage; toilet/urinal drenajı, medical p.en: Sewage covers drainage from toilets/urinals, medical premises and spaces containing living animals, and other waste waters mixed with these. Galley grey water alone may not be Annex IV sewage; however, when mixed with sewage it falls under the same regime, and local rules can impose separate, stricter limits on grey water.

ISPP Certificate, onaylı sewage treatmen.en: The ISPP Certificate shows the approved sewage treatment plant, comminuter/disinfector or holding tank arrangement. Treatment plant performance depends on correct aeration, biomass/chemical condition, blowers/pumps, alarms and the maker's operating envelope. A bypass valve, an overflow line or wrong chemical dosing makes the certified system ineffective.

Holding tank kapasitesi kişi sayısı, sef.en: Holding tank capacity is planned with the number of persons, voyage duration and actual generation. A reception facility or a legal discharge opportunity must be found before the tank is full. Silencing the high-level alarm does not replace an operational plan.

Başmühendis sewage flow'u, tank seviyesi.en: The Chief Engineer should monitor the sewage flow, tank level and plant condition against the voyage plan, and the Master the discharge position/permission conditions.

Grey water ve sewage hatlarını çizimden.en: Not verifying the grey water and sewage lines from the drawing

Treatment plant blower çalışıyorsa efflu.en: Assuming the effluent is acceptable because the treatment plant blower is running

Deşarj seçenekleri: arıtılmış, parçalanm.en: Discharge options: treated, comminuted/disinfected and untreated sewage

Onaylı sewage treatment plant uygun şeki.en: While an approved sewage treatment plant is operating properly, discharge is made in accordance with the plant's performance standard and the Annex IV conditions; it must not produce visible floating solids or discolouration of the surrounding water. If the treatment system is bypassed, this option cannot be used.

Comminuted ve disinfected sewage, onaylı.en: Comminuted and disinfected sewage may be discharged using an approved system at more than 3 nautical miles from the nearest land; sewage that is not comminuted/disinfected may generally be discharged at more than 12 nautical miles, while the ship is en route and at a suitable rate of discharge approved by the Administration. Pumping out the tank contents all at once or discharging while the ship is stopped does not meet the condition.

Passenger ships için belirli special are.en: For passenger ships, certain special area provisions and local no-discharge/reception rules may also apply. At the time of the discharge decision, the ship type, treatment status, position, speed/en route status, source tank and port instructions must be recorded together.

Sewage discharge checklist, plant valve.en: The sewage discharge checklist should turn the plant valve line-up and alarm status into a two-department permit with bridge confirmation of position/speed.

3/12 mil sayılarını tek koşul olarak ezb.en: Memorising the 3/12 mile figures as the only condition

Treatment plant arızasını loglamadan byp.en: Bypassing without logging a treatment plant failure

Liman çıkışından kısa süre sonra holding.en: Shortly after leaving port, the holding tank reaches the high-high alarm; the ship is not yet beyond 12 nautical miles.

Taşma riski ciddi olsa da bu durum planl.en: Although the risk of overflow is serious, this does not automatically justify an unplanned illegal discharge. The cause of the fault and the safe options are assessed quickly.

Üretim azaltılır, treatment/reception/tr.en: Generation is reduced and treatment/reception/transfer options and a safe solution on the route are investigated; the Master/company and, if necessary, the coastal authority are informed. If an emergency discharge really becomes necessary for the safety of life/the ship, the exception conditions and all evidence for the decision are recorded in detail.

Sewage'ın kaynağı ve karışımı doğru tanı.en: The source and mixture of the sewage are correctly identified.

Sistem sertifikası gerçek işletme kondis.en: The system certificate is supported by the actual operating condition.

Mesafe, en-route ve arıtma şartları birl.en: The distance, en route and treatment conditions are applied together.

Annex V: çöp kategorileri, yasaklar ve k.en: Annex V: garbage categories, prohibitions and record integrity

Annex V'nin varsayılan yaklaşımı çöpün d.en: The default approach of Annex V is that garbage is segregated and reduced on board, not at sea, and delivered to a shore reception facility; the limited discharge exceptions depend on the category and conditions.

Garbage tanımı, kategoriler ve plastik y.en: Definition of garbage, categories and the plastics prohibition

Garbage; domestic waste, operational was.en: Garbage covers categories such as domestic waste, operational waste, food waste, plastics, cargo residues, incinerator ashes, cooking oil, fishing gear and animal carcasses. Not every category has the same discharge options. Hazardous substances in e-waste or maintenance waste can also trigger other national/international waste rules.

Plastiklerin, synthetic ropes/nets, plas.en: The discharge into the sea of plastics, including synthetic ropes/nets, plastic garbage bags and incinerator ash containing plastic, is prohibited. A 'biodegradable' label does not automatically mean that the product is not a plastic under Annex V or that it can be discharged into the sea; the composition and the authoritative guidance are verified.

Food waste, cargo residue, cleaning agen.en: The distance, comminution, special area, HME status and en route conditions differ for food waste, cargo residues, cleaning agents/additives and animal carcasses. Mixed garbage is subject to the requirements of whichever component is stricter. Grinding garbage does not change its category or the plastics prohibition.

Çöp istasyonunda kategori renkleri GMP/G.en: At the garbage station, the category colours must be the same as the GMP/GRB codes; when mixed waste arises, the stricter category must be clearly applied.

Biodegradable plastiği denize atılabilir.en: Thinking biodegradable plastic can be discharged into the sea

Comminuter kullanınca bütün food packagi.en: Counting all food packaging as food waste because a comminuter is used

Garbage Management Plan toplama, separat.en: The Garbage Management Plan describes the collection, separation, processing, storage, discharge and reception process, the persons responsible and the equipment on board. Placards show crew and passengers the applicable prohibitions in an understandable language. The plan must match the ship's actual compactor, grinder, incinerator and storage arrangements.

Garbage Record Book; denize deşarj, rece.en: The Garbage Record Book records events such as discharge into the sea, delivery to a reception facility, incineration, accidental loss/discharge and loss of fishing gear with category, quantity, time and position. The volume estimation method must be consistent and reasonably balanced with receipts, the storage inventory and the incinerator log.

Port reception facility yetersizse bu du.en: An inadequate port reception facility does not give permission for random discharge at sea. The inadequacy is taken through the Master/company to the appropriate IMO/port reporting mechanism; the ship's storage capacity and the plan for the next suitable port are updated. The licence and delivery chain of the waste contractor are verified according to local rules.

Baş zabit/çevre zabiti weekly garbage ba.en: The Chief Officer/environmental officer should monitor generation, storage, incineration and receipt quantities by category with a weekly garbage balance.

Teslim fişindeki toplam miktarı kategori.en: Entering the total quantity on the delivery receipt into the GRB without separating the categories

Reception facility reddini kaydetmeden a.en: Storing waste unsafely on deck without recording the reception facility's refusal

Tahliye sonrası hold wash water planlanı.en: After discharge, hold wash water is planned; the shipper cannot document that the cargo residue is not harmful to the marine environment.

HME status bilinmeden Annex V deşarj ist.en: An Annex V discharge exception cannot be assumed while the HME status is unknown. The cleaning agent and special area status must also be determined separately.

Denize deşarj yapılmaz; shipper declarat.en: No discharge into the sea is made; the shipper's declaration and the product criteria are verified. If compliance cannot be proven, the residue/wash water is kept on board or delivered to a reception facility and recorded in the GRB under the correct category.

Karışık çöp daha sıkı bileşenin rejimine.en: Mixed garbage falls under the regime of the stricter component.

Plastik yasağı öğütme veya biodegradable.en: The plastics prohibition is not lifted by grinding or a biodegradable claim.

GRB miktarı fiziksel depolama ve receipt.en: The GRB quantity reconciles with the physical storage and receipts.

Annex VI: hava kirliliği, yakıt uygunluğ.en: Annex VI: air pollution, fuel compliance and energy efficiency

Annex VI, baca emisyonlarından ozon taba.en: Annex VI brings together technical and operational controls ranging from funnel emissions to ozone-depleting substances, and from the fuel quality chain to the ship's carbon intensity.

SOx/PM, fuel oil quality, BDN ve numune.en: SOx/PM, fuel oil quality, the BDN and the sample chain

SOx ve particulate matter kontrolü yakıt.en: SOx and particulate matter are controlled through the sulphur content of the fuel or an approved equivalent arrangement. The global limit and the ECA limit differ; according to its position, the tank used and the system volume, the ship must complete the change-over before the ECA boundary. If an exhaust gas cleaning system is used, the approval, monitoring, washwater/residue and malfunction procedures apply.

Bunker Delivery Note teslim edilen yakıt.en: The Bunker Delivery Note carries the mandatory information on the fuel delivered and the supplier's declaration; the representative MARPOL delivered sample is protected with a chain of seal, label, signature and retention. Onboard samples and in-use samples serve different verification purposes. The sample seal number must match the BDN and the ship's records.

Off-spec şüphesi yalnız laboratuvar yüzd.en: Suspected off-spec fuel is not just a laboratory percentage. Tank segregation, supplier notification, the flag/port report, Fuel Oil Non-Availability Report conditions and safe fuel management are assessed. A FONAR does not provide an automatic exemption; it documents the reasonable efforts the ship made to obtain compliant fuel.

Bunker checklist, BDN/sample seal/tank t.en: The bunker checklist should link the BDN/sample seal/tank allocation and the ECA change-over calculation in a single traceable file.

BDN uygun olduğu için kullanılan tankı d.en: Not verifying the tank in use because the BDN is compliant

FONAR'ı düşük sülfür sınırından genel mu.en: Thinking a FONAR is a general exemption from the low sulphur limit

ECA sınırında change-over gecikmesi.en: Delayed change-over at the ECA boundary

Beklenenden güçlü akıntı gemiyi ECA sını.en: A stronger than expected current brings the ship to the ECA boundary early; there is still high-sulphur fuel in the system.

Valfi sınırda çevirmek, service system i.en: Turning the valve at the boundary does not mean the contents of the service system are compliant in time. The planning calculation should have been updated with the actual speed/flow.

Emniyetli navigasyon korunarak change-ov.en: While maintaining safe navigation, the change-over is completed in the shortest safe time and the Master/company and the required authorities are informed; the time/position/tank/quantity and reason are recorded transparently and the planning procedure is corrected.

Marine diesel engine NOx uygunluğu; engi.en: NOx compliance of a marine diesel engine depends on the engine's construction/major conversion status, rated power/speed, the applicable Tier, the EIAPP Certificate and the approved Technical File. If the parameter check method is used, component/setting/seal records are kept; an unauthorised turbocharger, injector or timing change can invalidate certificate compliance.

Ozone-depleting substances içeren sistem.en: For systems containing ozone-depleting substances, the prohibition on deliberate emissions, the equipment/ODS Record Book, recharging/servicing and the shore disposal chain are managed. Prohibitions on new installations and exceptions are verified according to the substance/equipment date. A refrigerant leak is not only a maintenance issue but a MARPOL record and emission event.

VOC tanker gereklilikleri port designati.en: VOC requirements for tankers are managed with the port designation and the approved VOC Management Plan; shipboard incineration with the approved incinerator, prohibited substances, operating temperature and records. Improper burning of waste such as PVC or certain chemical/contaminated packaging can create toxic emissions and ash management problems.

Başmühendis, critical engine components.en: When accepting spare parts, the Chief Engineer should compare the critical engine components with the list of allowable components/settings in the Technical File.

EIAPP varsa her motor modifikasyonunu uy.en: Considering every engine modification acceptable because there is an EIAPP

Refrigerant eklemeyi leak repair olmadan.en: Treating refrigerant top-up as normal consumption without a leak repair

EEDI/EEXI, CII, SEEMP ve IMO DCS veri bü.en: EEDI/EEXI, CII, SEEMP and IMO DCS data integrity

EEDI yeni gemi tasarım verimliliğini, EE.en: EEDI measures the design efficiency of a new ship, EEXI the technical efficiency level of an existing ship and CII the annual operational carbon intensity; they are different instruments. Attained/required values and ship applicability are verified separately. EEXI compliance may include an approved technical arrangement such as engine power limitation; an override is used only under a defined safety condition and with a record.

SEEMP Part I operasyonel iyileştirme pla.en: SEEMP Part I contains the operational improvement plan, Part II the fuel oil consumption data collection methodology and Part III the CII implementation plan and the required corrective action approach. The CII rating A-E shows annual performance; a poor rating is managed through its root causes, such as routing, waiting, hull/propeller, weather routing, trim and commercial planning, rather than a one-off speed reduction.

IMO DCS/CII verisi noon report, bunker d.en: IMO DCS/CII data are made up of noon reports, bunker deliveries, tank soundings, flowmeters, distance/time and cargo capacity inputs. Manual corrections, sensor gaps, off-hire or voyage boundary rules must be handled with a documented methodology. A verified report does not mean that an unexplained change in the raw data is automatically correct.

Gemi ve kıyı ekibi aylık fuel-distance-h.en: The ship and shore teams should carry out a monthly fuel-distance-hours reconciliation; a difference found at the end of the year should not be closed with a retrospective estimate.

EEXI ile CII'yi aynı performans gösterge.en: Thinking EEXI and CII are the same performance indicator

CII için emniyetli sefer planı veya maki.en: Applying pressure for CII that would breach a safe voyage plan or machinery limits

Yakıt uygunluğu belgeden tanka ve bacaya.en: Fuel compliance is traced from the document to the tank and the funnel.

NOx uygunluğu engine konfigürasyonunun T.en: NOx compliance is the faithfulness of the engine configuration to the Technical File.

Enerji verisi ham kaynaktan doğrulanmış.en: Energy data must be auditable from the raw source to the verified report.

Kirlilik olayı, istisnalar, bildirim ve.en: Pollution incidents, exceptions, reporting and cross-annex evidence management

MARPOL'un amacı kural dışı deşarjı kayıt.en: The aim of MARPOL is not to erase an illegal discharge from the records, but to prevent it, limit the damage when it happens, report early and learn from the incident at system level.

İstisnalar dar yorumlanır: gemi/can emni.en: Exceptions are interpreted narrowly: safety of the ship/life and damage cases

Annexlerde can veya gemi emniyeti için z.en: The annexes can contain certain exceptions for a discharge necessary for the safety of life or the ship and for pollution after damage to the ship/equipment. These do not cover a normal capacity planning error or lack of maintenance. For the damage exception, conditions such as all reasonable precautions having been taken to prevent/minimise the damage and the absence of intentional or reckless conduct by the owner/master are important.

Acil durumda önce hayat ve gemi emniyeti.en: In an emergency, the safety of life and the ship is protected first, but the environmental impact remains part of the decision. A contemporaneous log shows why there was no other option, what quantity was released when and where, which mitigating measures were applied and who was informed.

Bir sistemin tank kapasitesi düzenli ola.en: If a system's tank capacity is regularly insufficient, this is not an unexpected emergency but a failure of voyage/capacity management. The company should correct the root cause through the reception facility plan, the waste generation rate and equipment reliability.

Acil deşarj karar formu, karar yetkisi v.en: The emergency discharge decision form should speed up the decision authority and reporting; it should not be used to produce a legal justification afterwards.

Her arızayı otomatik force majeure sayma.en: Treating every failure automatically as force majeure

Olay küçük diye kıyı bildirimini tamamen.en: Skipping the shore report entirely because the incident is small

Protocol I raporu ve ilk saatlerde kanıt.en: The Protocol I report and preserving evidence in the first hours

MARPOL Protocol I, harmful substances iç.en: MARPOL Protocol I supports the reporting, without delay and through the appropriate channels, of incidents involving harmful substances to the nearest coastal State. The initial report can clearly mark uncertain data as an 'estimate'; what matters is the early warning and follow-up reports as the data are confirmed.

Olay yeri emniyetli hale getirildikten s.en: After the scene has been made safe, the logbook, record books, alarm/event log, valve positions, tank soundings, samples, CCTV/VDR and communication records are preserved. Personnel are asked to give separate factual statements; creating a shared story or altering past records destroys credibility.

Şirket emergency response, P&I/charter v.en: Company emergency response, P&I/charter and legal communications support the operational response; the Master must not delay the mandatory shore report while waiting for commercial approval. The flag, the coastal/port State and other relevant authorities can be informed in parallel according to the type of incident.

SOPEP/SMPEP contact appendix her sefer b.en: The SOPEP/SMPEP contact appendix should be checked before each voyage area; if the real numbers will not be called in a drill, their accuracy should be confirmed by another safe method.

İlk raporu yüzde yüz kesin veri gelene k.en: Holding back the initial report until one hundred per cent certain data are available

Olay sonrası record book sayfasını temiz.en: Replacing a record book page with a clean copy after the incident

2026 kayıp konteyner bildirimi ve MARPOL.en: 2026 lost container reporting and the MARPOL link

1 Ocak 2026 SOLAS değişiklikleri denize.en: The SOLAS amendments of 1 January 2026 strengthened the reporting of containers lost overboard. The main legal basis is SOLAS safety of navigation; however, a lost container can have MARPOL implications such as marine pollutants/dangerous goods, plastics and packaging, or fuel/chemical leakage. A SOLAS report therefore does not replace an environmental incident assessment.

The incident report should explain not only the number of boxes lost overboard but why the barriers failed.

Şirket acil durum planı, lost container.en: The company emergency plan should distribute the lost container data to the SOLAS navigational warning and MARPOL pollution report streams under a single incident identity.

Güçlü MARPOL uyumu, her record book'u ay.en: Strong MARPOL compliance controls the flow of substances on board from the source to the final route, rather than filing each record book separately.

Her atık/emisyon akışı beş düğümle incel.en: Each waste/emission stream can be examined with five nodes: where it was generated, which tank/container held it, which equipment processed it, where it went and which record proves it. For oily bilge, the chain bilge well–holding tank–OWS–overboard/reception–ORB can be set up; for garbage, source station–storage–compactor/incinerator–shore/discharge–GRB.

Mass-balance, yasa dışı bir yolu kanıtla.en: A mass balance makes an inconsistency visible before proving an illegal route. The opening/closing tank quantities, generation, transfers and disposal are balanced in the same unit and with reliable measurements. Density, tank tables, unpumpable quantities and measurement error can be explained; an unexplained difference is investigated.

Cross-annex kontrol, aynı olayın farklı.en: A cross-annex check compares the different records of the same event. The bunker quantity must be consistent in the BDN/ORB/fuel report and Annex VI DCS; incinerated garbage in the GRB/incinerator log/fuel and ash storage. Separating one system as the 'environmental officer' file and the other as the 'engine' file can hide a common error.

The ESP introduces additional structural assessment requirements beyond the standard class survey.

The ISM Code is the safety management system standard developed after the Herald of Free Enterprise (1987) and Scandinavian Star (1990) disasters. The SMC is issued separately for each ship, while the DOC (Document of Compliance) covers the company.

It is a comprehensive 'super convention' that brought together 68 earlier ILO conventions and recommendations. Together with SOLAS, MARPOL and STCW, it is regarded as one of the four basic conventions of shipping. The MLC Certificate and DMLC are mandatory on all ships of 500 GT and above on international voyages.

ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for O.en: ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for Oil Tankers and Terminals) is published jointly by OCIMF (Oil Companies International Marine Forum), ICS (International Chamber of Shipping) and IAPH (International Association of Ports and Harbors). Its origin lies in combining the Tanker Safety Guide and terminal safety guides of the 1970s. It is not a mandatory IMO convention, but an industry guide regarded in practice as the global standard; it turns regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL and the IGS requirements into practical operations. The latest edition is the 6th Edition published in 2020 (ISGOTT 6), notable for its human factors, ship-shore communication and updated Ship-Shore Safety Checklist (SSSCL) approach.

Özel alanı dikkate almamak.en: Not taking the special area into account

ECA'ya girişte yakıt değişiminin tamamla.en: How do you verify that the fuel change-over has been completed on entering an ECA?

Sadece valf çevirme saati.en: Only the time the valve was turned

Teslim edilen deniz yakıtının özellik ve.en: The Bunker Delivery Note, documenting the properties and quantity of the marine fuel delivered.

MLC'nin beş başlığını gemiadamının işe g.en: Reading the five titles of the MLC as a life cycle, from the seafarer's recruitment to repatriation and the right to complain

Bayrakta tanımlanan yetkili kişi.en: Authorised person designated by the flag

SEA kopyasının gemiadamında bulunduğunu.en: Verify that the seafarer has a copy of the SEA

Financial security belgesinin erişilebil.en: Check that the financial security document is accessible and valid

Çalışma veya dinlenme sınırları bayrak u.en: Limits on hours of work or rest must be monitored according to flag requirements; the posted schedule and individual records must reflect actual operations, and the seafarer must be given an endorsed copy.

Aşırı çalışma hem çalışma hakkı ihlali h.en: Excessive work is both a breach of labour rights and a risk to navigational/machinery safety; the same incident can be examined under two separate compliance dimensions together with STCW.

Rastgele günleri logbook ve work/rest ka.en: Match random days with the logbook and the work/rest record

Gemiadamının kaydı görüp onayladığını do.en: Verify that the seafarer has seen and endorsed the record

Sistematik fazla mesai için manning ve i.en: Reassess manning and the work plan for systematic overtime

Kayıtların kalıp olarak tekrarlanması, p.en: Records repeated as a pattern, not matching personnel's actual working hours, or changed after a complaint

Yaşam, sağlık, iaşe ve şikâyet mekanizma.en: Living conditions, health, food and the complaint mechanism

Konaklama, gıda/su, gemide sağlık ve güv.en: Accommodation, food/water, health and safety on board, medical care and the complaint procedure must be maintained through physical condition, regular inspections and accessible records.

MLC uygunluğu sadece sertifika dosyası d.en: MLC compliance is not just a certificate file; it is visible in the cabins, galley, hospital and safe working arrangements the crew live with every day.

Rastgele yaşam mahallerini kayıtlarla bi.en: Walk through random living spaces together with the records

Gemiadamına şikâyeti gemi içinde ve dışa.en: Ask the seafarer to whom they would make a complaint on board and ashore

Düzeltici faaliyetlerin misilleme olmada.en: Verify that corrective actions were closed without victimisation

Denetim günü temizlenen mahaller, tekrar.en: Spaces cleaned on inspection day, recurring hygiene/pest problems, or personnel not knowing the complaint channel

SEA'nızın bir kopyası sizde mi ve ücret/.en: Do you have a copy of your SEA, and can you explain your wage/leave/repatriation conditions?

Gemiadamı belgeyi erişilebilir biçimde g.en: The seafarer should be able to show the document in an accessible way and explain the basic conditions in their own words.

Belge yalnız kaptanda.en: Document held only by the Master

Fiilî ücretle sözleşme farkı.en: Difference between actual wages and the agreement

Şikâyetinizi kaptanı atlayarak kime ve n.en: To whom and how can you make a complaint bypassing the Master?

Personel, misillemeye karşı koruma dâhil.en: Personnel should know the on-board steps, including protection against victimisation, and the flag/shore contact details.

Şikâyet edenin cezalandırılacağı algısı.en: Perception that the complainant will be punished

Son accommodation veya galley kontrolünd.en: What finding came up in the last accommodation or galley inspection, and how was it closed?

Kayıt, fiziksel bulgu, sorumlu, son tari.en: The record should show the physical finding, the person responsible, the deadline and the follow-up check.

Fiilî durumla uyumsuz kayıt.en: Record inconsistent with the actual condition

Gemiadamı ile armatör/işveren arasındaki.en: The Seafarers' Employment Agreement, which sets the working conditions between the seafarer and the shipowner/employer.

Bayrak gerekleri ile şirketin bunları ge.en: The Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance, showing the flag requirements and how the company applies them continuously on board.

Toplu iş sözleşmesi; SEA tarafından atıf.en: Collective bargaining agreement; may form part of the working conditions when referred to in the SEA.

Belirli koşullarda gemiadamının masrafla.en: The right, under certain conditions, of the seafarer to return to their country/an agreed destination at no cost to them.

D-1 değişim standardı ile D-2 performans.en: Distinguishing the D-1 exchange standard from the D-2 performance standard and the regime applicable to the ship

Ballast Water Management Plan, Record Bo.en: Managing the Ballast Water Management Plan, Record Book, Certificate and BWMS operation as a single chain of evidence

Bypass, contingency, uptake/discharge ve.en: Recording bypass, contingency, uptake/discharge and sediment operations completely

Port State örneklemesinde ekipman, kayıt.en: Explaining that equipment, records and crew competence are assessed together in port State sampling

Onaylı Ballast Water Management Plan gem.en: The approved Ballast Water Management Plan must match the ship's actual piping and BWMS; every ballast operation must be recorded in the Record Book and the applicable certificate kept valid.

Kopya/genel plan, gemideki valf sırası v.en: A copied/generic plan that does not meet the valve sequence or treatment limits on board is not reliable in an emergency and contradicts the actual system during an inspection.

Plan üzerindeki tank/valf/sampling point.en: Verify the tank/valve/sampling points on the plan on site

BWRB'yi ballast log ve tank soundingleri.en: Reconcile the BWRB with the ballast log and tank soundings

Certificate ve type-approval limitationl.en: Check the certificate and the type-approval limitations

Planın sister ship kopyası olması veya k.en: The plan being a sister ship copy, or the records not matching tank movements/BWMS trends

BWMS'in treatment limitleri içinde işlet.en: Operating the BWMS within its treatment limits

BWMS; type-approval ve üretici limitleri.en: The BWMS must be operated within the type-approval and maker's limits, with correct flow/UV dose or chemical parameters; alarms, bypass and failure conditions must be managed according to the procedure.

Bypass valfi ve alarm geçmişini incele.en: Examine the bypass valve and the alarm history

Arıza halinde port/flag/company bildirim.en: Have the port/flag/company notification and contingency steps explained in case of failure

Alarmın resetlenip nedeninin araştırılma.en: Resetting an alarm without investigating the cause, an unrecorded bypass, or defeating the treatment to increase the flow rate

BWM Convention Sections C-D ve ilgili IM.en: BWM Convention Article 9, Regulation B-5 and the related IMO Guidelines (G1, G2) and guidance on contingency measures

Numune alma noktaları erişilebilir tutul.en: Sampling points must be kept accessible; in case of BWMS non-compliance or failure, the approved contingency measures and communication with the port must be applied; sediment must be managed in a planned way.

Arıza anında doğaçlama deşarj kararı, bi.en: An improvised discharge decision at the time of a failure increases the biological and legal risk. Predetermined options must be coordinated with the port State in good time.

Sampling point erişimini ve etiketini ko.en: Check the access to and labelling of the sampling points

Arıza senaryosunu liman gereklilikleriyl.en: Work through a failure scenario at the table against the port requirements

Sediment faaliyetini tank bakım ve tesli.en: Match sediment activities with tank maintenance and delivery records

Arıza limana geç bildirilmesi, örnekleme.en: Late reporting of a failure to the port, an inaccessible sampling point, or sediment disposal left unrecorded

Son ballast discharge sırasında BWMS'in.en: How do you show that the BWMS operated within limits that meet D-2 during the last ballast discharge?

Operasyon kaydı, trend/alarmlar, debi ve.en: The operation record, trends/alarms, flow rate and treatment parameters, calibration and the BWRB entry must be shown together.

BWMS limana varmadan arızalanırsa hangi.en: If the BWMS fails before arriving in port, in what order do you act?

Operasyonu emniyete alma, kaptan/şirket.en: Making the operation safe, notifying the Master/company, the BWMP contingency options, prior coordination with the port State and a complete record should be described.

Numune nereden ve emniyetli biçimde nası.en: Where and how is a sample taken safely?

Personel sampling pointi sahada göstereb.en: Personnel should be able to show the sampling point on site and explain the access/pressure risk and the conditions for a representative sample.

Belirlenen koşullarda ballast suyu değiş.en: The exchange standard that reduces the transfer of organisms by exchanging ballast water under specified conditions.

Deşarj edilen ballast suyunda canlı orga.en: The performance standard for viable organisms and indicator microbes in discharged ballast water.

Ballast suyunu D-2 standardına ulaşmak a.en: The Ballast Water Management System, which treats ballast water to achieve the D-2 standard.

Suyun treatment prosesinin tamamı veya b.en: Routing water so that it does not pass through all or part of the treatment process; every use must be justified and recorded.

SMS'i doküman klasörü değil, riskleri ko.en: Assessing the SMS not as a document folder but as a living management system that controls risks

Şirket-kaptan-departman zincirinde yetki.en: Distinguishing authority, reporting and shore support responsibilities in the company-Master-department chain

Non-conformity, near miss, audit ve mana.en: Turning non-conformity, near-miss, audit and management review data into continual improvement

Kritik ekipman bakımında arıza, geçici t.en: Setting up the chain of failure, temporary measures, redundancy and verification in the maintenance of critical equipment

SMS prosedürleri geminin operasyonuna uy.en: SMS procedures must suit the ship's operations, be accessible and be under controlled revision; personnel must be able to understand and apply the procedures relating to their own work.

Aşırı genel veya kopyalanmış prosedür, s.en: An overly general or copied procedure does not control the risk on site. An audit focuses on consistency with practice more than on the existence of the document.

Prosedür ile gerçek ekipman/iş akışını s.en: Compare the procedure with the actual equipment/workflow on site

Rastgele personele kendi kritik görevini.en: Have random personnel explain their own critical task with a scenario

Prosedürün sister ship veya eski ekipman.en: The procedure belonging to a sister ship or old equipment; personnel having only signed it and being unable to apply its content

Rutin olmayan ve yüksek riskli işler; te.en: Non-routine and high-risk jobs must be planned specifically for the job, taking into account the hazards, barriers, person responsible, stop-work criteria and changing conditions.

Genel risk assessment formu, işi yapan e.en: A generic risk assessment form does not prevent an accident unless it builds a shared mental model for the team doing the work.

İşi yöneten zabit/mühendis.en: Officer/engineer in charge of the job

Tehlike-bariyer-sorumlu ilişkisini ekipt.en: Hear the hazard-barrier-person responsible relationship from the team

Koşul değiştiğinde dynamic risk assessme.en: Verify that a dynamic risk assessment is carried out when conditions change

Permit kapanışında izolasyonların ve sis.en: At permit close-out, check that the isolations and the system have been returned to normal

İş adı değiştirilmiş standart form, gerç.en: A standard form with only the job name changed, the actual isolation differing from the form, or the stop-work authority not being known

Kaza, near miss, non-conformity ve kriti.en: Accidents, near misses, non-conformities and critical equipment failures must be reported and closed with root cause, corrective/preventive action and an effectiveness check.

Bulgunun yalnız kapatılması aynı olayın.en: Simply closing a finding does not prevent the same event from recurring. For the management system to learn, the cause and the barrier failure must be fed back to the fleet.

Faaliyetin yalnız tamamlanmasını değil t.en: Verify that the action has reduced the risk of recurrence, not just that it has been completed

Kritik arızada geçici tedbir ve shore su.en: In a critical failure, check the temporary measures and the shore support approval

Benzer gemilere lesson learned yayıldığı.en: Verify that the lessons learned have been spread to similar ships

Semptomu onarıp kök nedeni kapatmamak; g.en: Repairing the symptom without closing the root cause; postponing overdue work without justification; punishing near-miss reporting

Son near miss hangi SMS değişikliğine ve.en: Which SMS change or barrier strengthening did the last near miss lead to?

Olay, kök neden, faaliyet, sorumlu, son.en: The event, root cause, action, person responsible, deadline, effectiveness check and fleet feedback should be shown.

Bu kritik ekipman arızası açıkken gemi n.en: Why is the ship considered safe while this critical equipment failure is open?

Risk, yedeklilik, geçici kontrol, bayrak.en: The risk, redundancy, temporary controls, flag/class/company notification and the permanent repair plan should be explained.

DPA'ya hangi durumda doğrudan ulaşırsını.en: In what situation do you contact the DPA directly?

Personel emniyet/çevre konusunda shore m.en: Personnel should know the situations in which they need shore management support on safety/environmental matters and the current means of communication.

DPA'nın kim olduğunun bilinmemesi.en: Not knowing who the DPA is

İletişimin yalnız kaptan üzerinden mümkü.en: Thinking communication is possible only through the Master

Şirket ve geminin emniyet/çevre politika.en: The structured Safety Management System that implements the company's and the ship's safety/environmental policy.

Gemi ile en üst yönetim arasında doğruda.en: The Designated Person Ashore, who provides a direct link between the ship and the highest level of management and ensures adequate shore support.

Belirlenmiş bir gerekliliğin karşılanmad.en: An observed situation showing that a specified requirement has not been met.

Bir şartın uygulanıp uygulanmadığını gös.en: A verifiable record, observation or statement showing whether a requirement has been applied.

Safety ile security arasındaki farkı ve.en: Explaining the difference between safety and security and the mandatory structure of the SOLAS XI-2/ISPS relationship

Security level değişikliğini access cont.en: Turning a security level change into access control, restricted areas and watch arrangements

SSO-CSO-PFSO iletişim zinciri ile Declar.en: Assessing the SSO-CSO-PFSO communication chain and the need for a Declaration of Security

SSP'nin gizliliğini korurken mürettebatı.en: Ensuring that the crew know their own duties while protecting the confidentiality of the SSP

Gemi, bildirilen security level için SSP.en: For the security level notified, the ship must apply without delay the access, visitor, baggage, stores and restricted area controls defined in the SSP.

Security level bir tabela değildir; pers.en: A security level is not a sign; it must produce a measurable change in personnel, watches, frequency of checks and physical barriers.

Mevcut level için açık erişim noktaların.en: Compare the open access points for the current level with the SSP

Rastgele ziyaretçi kaydını kimlik/refaka.en: Follow a random visitor record through the identification/escort/exit chain

Restricted area kilit ve devriyesini sah.en: Verify restricted area locks and patrols on site

Security level değiştiği halde manning,.en: Manning, patrols or access control not changing although the security level has changed

Onaylı SSP kontrollü ve korunmuş tutulma.en: The approved SSP must be kept controlled and protected; the SSO, CSO and ship's personnel must know their own authority/duties, incident reporting and the confidentiality limits relating to the SSAS.

Planın gizli olması personelin görevini.en: The confidentiality of the plan does not mean that personnel do not know their duties; only sensitive details are protected on a need-to-know basis.

Plan revizyonu ve onay durumunu kontrol.en: Check the plan revision and approval status

Personelin kendi level-specific görevini.en: Ask personnel to explain their own level-specific duties

Güvenlik olayında CSO/PFSO ve otorite bi.en: Verify the order of notification to the CSO/PFSO and authorities in a security incident

SSP'nin kontrolsüz kopyalanması veya giz.en: Uncontrolled copying of the SSP, or personnel being left unaware of basic duties on grounds of confidentiality

Tatbikat, DoS ve güvenlik olayına müdaha.en: Drills, DoS and response to a security incident

Drill/exercise programı farklı tehditler.en: The drill/exercise programme should test different threats and interfaces; where necessary, ship-port or ship-ship responsibilities should be clearly divided with a Declaration of Security.

İki tarafın aynı işi yaptığını varsaymas.en: Gaps where a check is carried out by no one create a security risk just as much as both parties assuming they are doing the same job.

PFSO ve ilgili gemi temsilcisi.en: PFSO and the ship representative concerned

Tatbikatın alarmdan raporlamaya kadar za.en: Evaluate the timeline of the drill from the alarm to reporting

DoS'ta her kontrolün sorumlusunu ve süre.en: In the DoS, verify the person responsible for and the duration of each check

Önceki güvenlik bulgusunun kapanış etkin.en: Test the effectiveness of the close-out of the previous security finding

Tatbikatların aynı senaryoyla kâğıt üzer.en: Drills repeated on paper with the same scenario, or a DoS signed while the actual responsibilities are not applied

Security Level 2 ilan edilirse ilk 30 da.en: If Security Level 2 is declared, what changes in the first 30 minutes?

Gemiye özgü SSP önlemleri; access point,.en: The ship-specific SSP measures should be described in terms of access points, patrols, searches, stores and the persons responsible for communications.

Level tanımını söyleyip somut değişiklik.en: Stating the level definition but being unable to show a concrete change

Bu limanda Declaration of Security neden.en: Why is a Declaration of Security necessary, or not necessary, in this port?

Risk, level farkı, tesis durumu, önceki.en: The risk, the difference in levels, the status of the facility, previous incidents and the Administration/SSP criteria should be taken into account.

Her limanda otomatik aynı cevap.en: The same automatic answer in every port

Şüpheli paket bulduğunuzda ilk eylemleri.en: What are your first actions when you find a suspicious package?

Dokunmama/alanı izole etme, güvenli bild.en: Not touching it/isolating the area, safe reporting, the SSP chain and waiting for expert instructions should be described specifically for the ship.

Gemi güvenlik değerlendirmesine dayanan,.en: The approved Ship Security Plan, based on the ship security assessment.

SSP'nin gemide uygulanmasından sorumlu S.en: The Ship Security Officer, responsible for implementing the SSP on board.

Belirli bir arayüzde güvenlik sorumluluk.en: The Declaration of Security, in which security responsibilities at a particular interface are divided between the parties.

Yetkisiz erişime karşı özel kontrol uygu.en: An area of the ship where special controls are applied against unauthorised access.

PSC'nin bayrak devleti sorumluluğunun ye.en: Explaining that PSC does not replace flag State responsibility but is a second layer of verification

Initial inspection, clear grounds, more.en: Distinguishing the initial inspection, clear grounds, more detailed inspection and detention stages

Belge, fiziksel durum, kayıt ve müretteb.en: Combining documents, physical condition, records and crew competence into the same compliance story

Bulguya hızlı kozmetik cevap yerine kök.en: Preparing evidence of root cause and sustainable close-out instead of a quick cosmetic response to a finding

Denetim öncesi kanıt bütünlüğü.en: Integrity of evidence before the inspection

IMO Procedures for Port State Control ve.en: IMO Procedures for Port State Control and the applicable MoU regime

Sertifika/record of equipment, logbook,.en: Certificates/records of equipment, logbooks, planned maintenance, physical equipment and crew statements must be consistent with each other.

PSC'de en güçlü hazırlık kalın bir dosya.en: The strongest preparation for PSC is not a thick file but records that show the same reality as the actual condition of the ship.

Son PSC/flag/class bulgularını ve tekrar.en: Review the latest PSC/flag/class findings and the risk of recurrence

Kritik ekipmanı kayıt sahibinden bağımsı.en: Test critical equipment independently of the person who keeps its records

Rastgele kayıtları logbook, sayaç ve per.en: Cross-check random records with logbooks, meters and personnel statements

Denetim için oluşturulmuş ayrı dosyanın.en: A separate file created for the inspection contradicting the actual PMS, logs or physical condition

Clear grounds oluşmasını önleme ve doğru.en: Preventing clear grounds from arising and responding to them correctly

Eksik belge, kötü genel durum, alarm/eki.en: As indications such as missing documents, poor general condition, alarm/equipment failure or the crew being unable to demonstrate basic operations can trigger a more detailed inspection, the first contact must be handled professionally and transparently.

Bir eksikliği gizlemeye çalışmak güveni.en: Trying to hide a deficiency makes trust and the scope of the inspection worse. The risk management and official notification of a known failure must be ready.

Belge ve escort sorumlularını önceden be.en: Designate the persons responsible for documents and escort in advance

Bilinen arızanın statü, tedbir ve onarım.en: Present the status, measures and repair plan of a known failure from a single source

Personelin ezber değil kendi görevini gö.en: Verify that personnel can demonstrate their own duties rather than a memorised answer

Denetçiye farklı kişilerden çelişkili bi.en: The inspector being given conflicting information by different people, or a known failure being hidden

Her bulgu; immediate correction, root ca.en: Every finding must be handled with immediate correction, root cause, extent analysis and preventive action; where necessary, flag/class approval and a follow-up inspection must be completed.

Tek ekipmanı onarmak, sistemik neden diğ.en: Repairing a single item of equipment does not prevent a repeat finding if the systemic cause remains in other similar equipment or procedures.

Aynı kök nedenden etkilenebilecek diğer.en: Check other equipment that may be affected by the same root cause

Kapanışın otorite beklentisini karşıladı.en: Verify that the close-out meets the authority's expectations

Fleet-wide lesson learned ve prosedür/PM.en: Assess a fleet-wide lesson learned and a procedure/PMS change

Yalnız fotoğraf veya servis fişi sunup k.en: Presenting only a photograph or service receipt without showing evidence of root cause, extent and prevention of recurrence

Son PSC veya iç denetim bulgusunun tekra.en: How do you prove that the last PSC or internal audit finding has not recurred?

Kök neden, filo/gemi kapsamı, CAPA, soru.en: The root cause, fleet/ship extent, CAPA, person responsible/date and verification of effectiveness should be shown.

Açık durumdaki bu arızayı neden denize e.en: Why do you not consider this open failure an obstacle to seaworthiness?

Uygulanabilir kural, risk, yedeklilik, g.en: The applicable rule, risk, redundancy, temporary measures, official approval and permanent repair plan should be presented.

Tek kişiye bağlı kontrol.en: Control dependent on a single person

Rastgele seçilen personel acil durum gör.en: Can randomly selected personnel demonstrate their emergency duty and equipment?

Muster görevi, alarm, toplanma yeri, PPE.en: The muster duty, alarm, assembly station, PPE, communications and first actions should be demonstrated specifically for the ship.

Ezberlenmiş ama sahada gösterilemeyen ce.en: An answer memorised but not demonstrable on site

Sertifika, genel durum ve temel uyum gös.en: The initial assessment of certificates, general condition and basic compliance indicators.

Clear grounds bulunduğunda belirli alanl.en: An inspection whose scope is extended in specific areas when clear grounds are found.

Eksiklikler gemiyi, kişileri veya çevrey.en: Preventing the ship from sailing when deficiencies clearly endanger the ship, persons or the environment.

PSC bulgusunun konu ve gerekli eylemle s.en: The coding that records a PSC finding in a standard way by subject and required action.

Tehlikeli yükü UN number, proper shippin.en: Identifying a dangerous cargo by UN number, proper shipping name, class/division, packing group and subsidiary risk

Doküman, ambalaj/IBC/tank, markalama/eti.en: Verifying the chain of documents, packaging/IBC/tank, marking/labelling, placards and stowage/segregation

Container/vehicle packing certificate il.en: Explaining the boundary of responsibility between the container/vehicle packing certificate and the ship's loading plan

EmS ve MFAG bilgisini gerçek bir sızıntı.en: Using EmS and MFAG information in a real leak/fire scenario

A comprehensive review of the framework is planned for 2026, and changes to the CII calculation methodology are expected.

EU ETS 2005'te endüstriyel sektörler içi.en: The EU ETS, launched in 2005 for industrial sectors, is the world's largest carbon trading system. The maritime sector was included in the system in 2024 under the 'Fit for 55' package. The EU MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification) regulation has collected maritime emission data since 2018 and formed the infrastructure for the EU ETS. It is the first non-IMO regional regulation to include shipping.

Unlike the EU ETS, it sets a limit on the greenhouse gas intensity of fuel instead of carbon pricing (a fuel standard approach). The regulation aims to accelerate the transition to alternative fuels and is the first Well-to-Wake regulation in the maritime sector.

This strategy is the reflection of the Paris Climate Agreement in the maritime sector. Shipping is responsible for about 2.5-3% of global CO₂ emissions. To reach these targets, IMO is developing both technical (fuel standard) and market-based (carbon pricing) measures.

With 27 member States (all EU coastal States + Canada, Iceland, Norway, Russia, UK; Russia's membership has been suspended since 2022), it covers some of the busiest shipping areas in the world. The NIR (New Inspection Regime) was introduced in 2011, creating a risk-based targeting system. About 18,000 inspections are carried out every year.
